title_en: Intelligent autonomous and semi-autonomous variable altitude vehicle deployment system and method
abstract_en: A damage response system for deploying autonomous vehicles and providing services to a disaster-impacted location is disclosed. The system includes a damage detection module and a deployment manager. In response to information about a disaster at a specific location, the system will determine the extent of the damage and generate a curated selection of autonomous vehicles to travel to the location. The autonomous vehicles will be automatically selected based on their capacity to handle specific tasks that are needed based on the damage assessment performed by the damage detection module. The selected autonomous vehicles can then be automatically dispatched to the impacted area.

title_en: Method and system for automatically generating a damage assessment report using actual measurement information of the recovery area and market price fluctuations of materials and labor costs
title_ko: 복구 면적의 실측정보, 재료 및 인건비의 시장 가격 변동을 이용한 손해사정 결과보고서 자동 생성 방법 및 시스템
abstract_ko: 본 개시의 일 실시예에 따른, 피해면적 실측정보 및 복구면적 실측정보를 기반으로 자동으로 보험금 견적을 산출하는 방법은 사용자 단말에서 피해 발생 건축물의 주소가 입력됨에 따라 상기 주소가 손해 산정 서버에 전송되고, 상기 주소에 해당하는 건축물의 평형 타입의 도면이 상기 손해 산정 서버에서 확인되고 상기 평형 타입의 도면이 상기 사용자 단말에 표시되는 단계, 상기 사용자 단말에 표시된 상기 평형 타입의 도면에서 피해 발생 영역이 선택되는 단계, 상기 손해 산정 서버에서 상기 피해 발생 영역에 대한 피해면적 실측정보 및 복구면적 실측정보가 연산되고, 상기 손해 산정 서버에 저장된 재료비 데이터, 인건비 데이터 및 상기 복구면적 실측정보에 기반하여 복구 비용이 산출되는 단계 및 상기 손해 산정 서버에서 상기 복구 비용에 대한 견적서를 생성하는 단계를 포함할 수 있다.

title_en: Earthquake damage predicting device, earthquake damage prediction method, and earthquake damage prediction program
abstract_en: <P>PROBLEM TO BE SOLVED: To provide an earthquake damage predicting device, an earthquake damage prediction method, and an earthquake damage prediction program, capable of predicting with high accuracy damaged situation of buildings due to earthquakes.  <P>SOLUTION: A plurality of earthquake waves in a region, where the building which is an object of damage estimation is built, are generated in each of a plurality of magnitudes by changing the phase by using random numbers (step 200), and response analysis by a building model by using the plurality of generated earthquake waves is performed (steps 202, 204). Then, the damage state of each member used in the building is derived (steps 206, 208), and the damage degree to the building caused by the earthquake motion is predicted, based on the damage state (steps 210-218), and the prediction result is outputted (step 220).  <P>COPYRIGHT: (C)2007,JPO&INPIT

title_en: Information update method and the real-time automatic update system for disaster damage investigation using wireless communication technology and web-gis
title_ko: 무선통신과 웹-지아이에스를 이용한 재해피해조사 실시간자동화 업데이트 시스템 및 그 운영방법
abstract_en: A system for automatically updating disaster damage investigation in real-time by using wireless communication and a web-GIS, and an operation method thereof are provided to quickly make a disaster prevention/restoration plan by automatically processing/uploading data received from various investigation equipment to a homepage and a bulletin board in connection with the web-GIS. A field equipment end(110) comprises portable damage investigation equipment capturing picture, moving picture, and sound data of a disaster area, obtaining coordinates of the disaster area, and receiving measurement from each measurer, and an ultra high speed wireless Internet modem transmitting data recombined and completed in the portable damage investigation equipment to a damage investigation information reception server(120). The damage investigation information reception server analyzes the received data by comparing the received data with basic damage data, registers the data to a disaster database, and transmits the data to a web server(130) and a web-GIS server(140) by classifying and converting the data into a protocol corresponding to each server.
abstract_ko: 본 발명은 무선통신과 웹-지아이에스를 이용한 재해피해조사 실시간 자동화 업데이트 시스템 및 그 운영방법에 관한 것으로, 각종 자연재해에 의해 발생한 인명피해 및 자연물, 인공물 등의 각종 피해에 대한 재해피해조사를 시행할 시에 디지털카메라, GPS, 음성녹음기 및 무선 초고속 통신장비 등의 장비를 이용하여 각 피해규모 산정의 객관성 확보와 과학적 근거를 확보하고 조사 과정을 신속하고 정확하게 할 수 있는 조사장비를 구비하고, 조사된 결과를 정리 및 입력하여 저장하고 가공하는 각종 데이터 작업과, 정리된 데이터를 각 서버단으로 전송하여 정해진 유형에 맞는 정보의 형태로 실시간으로 자동 가공하고 홈페이지 메인페이지, 게시판에 게시함은 물론 표준화된 재해 대장 형태로 가공하여 웹페이지를 생성하고, 발생 지점 좌표 등을 통해 Web-GIS 상에 피해 발생 지점 등록 및 그 속성을 표출하며, 이러한 홈페이지, 재해대장, Web-GIS 등을 연계하여 신속하게 각종 정보를 검색하고 확인할 수 있도록 함으로써 신속한 피해복구 대책 수립과 방재 정책 수립을 진행을 지원할 수 있고, 일반 인터넷상에 재해조사의 각종 정보를 게시함으로써 방재 및 재해복구 대책의 투명성을 확보하여 대민 정책 신뢰도를 제고할 수 있도록 지원하는 무선통신과 웹-GIS를 이용한 재해피해조사 실시간 자동화 업데이트 시스템 및 그 운영방법을 제공함에 그 목적이 있다.

title_en: Earthquake damage estimation device, method, and program
abstract_en: <P>PROBLEM TO BE SOLVED: To provide an earthquake damage estimation device, method and program, capable of easily and precisely predicting a business interruption period, without requiring an expert knowledge as to restoration work.  <P>SOLUTION: The device derives the business interruption period due to an earthquake damage of a building, by a CPU 22, assuming that a business is continued when a loss factor indicating a ratio of a restoration cost to a replacement value of the building is a prescribed rate or less, and assuming that the business is reopened at the time when the loss factor comes to the prescribed rate according to a progress of the restoration work for the building, when the loss factor exceeds the prescribed rate.  <P>COPYRIGHT: (C)2008,JPO&INPIT

title_en: Method of estimating earthquake damage in evaluation objective point
abstract_en: <P>PROBLEM TO BE SOLVED: To provide a precise and fine method of estimating earthquake damage in an evaluation objective point.  <P>SOLUTION: This earthquake damage estimation method in the evaluation objective point acquires earthquake motion data from at least three portions of earthquake observation points, in real time, Fourier-transforms the acquired earthquake motion data, estimates a frequency characteristic of a ground, using a ground transmission characteristic of each earthquake observation point formed preliminarily into a database, calculates the frequency characteristic of the ground surrounded by the respective earthquake observation points, estimates a frequency characteristic of a ground surface, at semi-real time, using a ground transmission characteristic of the evaluation objective point formed preliminarily into the database, and estimates a damage of the earthquake at semi-real time, using the frequency characteristic in the evaluation objective point.  <P>COPYRIGHT: (C)2009,JPO&INPIT

title_en: Assembled anti-vibration movable house
abstract_en: The utility model relates to an assembled anti-seismic mobile room, which is formed from assembling frame type wall body plates of a steel-wood structure, a roof board, connectors and damping bases, wherein a frame which comprises a frontispiece plate, a front and a rear cladding wall plates and the roof board is welded by a square steel pipe, the damping bases are arranged on the bottoms of upright posts, wooden plates are nailed on the outer side of the frame, waterproof and thermal insulating compound bricks or compound tiles are pasted on the outer side of the wooden plates, ground beams are arranged on the bottom of the wall plates, and a damping slide groove is arranged between the foundation. The product can be produced in batches in factories or can be separated or decorated in the inner in advance, and the room can be built through the rapid assembly after being transported in a scene, thereby long-term residence of affected households is saved, and the room can be disassembled if necessary when relocating and is rebuilt in another area, since each of the upright posts is provided with the damping base, thereby the room can not be crashed in big earthquakes, and the device has very strong anti-seismic capacity, is suitably being used as a temporary or long-term living room in a seismic-prone area or a building in a disaster saving scene, such as a temporary headquarter, a clinic, a material warehouse and the like.

title_en: Apparatus for estimating earthquake damage of cable, and method and program thereof
abstract_en: <P>PROBLEM TO BE SOLVED: To accurately predict the damage of a cable held in a pipeline.  <P>SOLUTION: The cable damage estimating apparatus, upon the input of assumed earthquake information, selects a joint detachment amount occurrence ratio table which predicts the displacement of an underground pipeline corresponding to topography and geology of a place where an underground cable is buried, and the seismic intensity and liquefaction rank of the place, from an underground pipeline database 24, selects a cable disaster area table which measures the presence of disaster of the cable according to the displacement amount of the cable, from a cable database 23, and compares the joint detachment amount occurrence ratio table with the cable disaster area table to compute the disaster rate of the cable.  <P>COPYRIGHT: (C)2009,JPO&INPIT

title_en: Apparatus, method, and program for estimating disaster damage
abstract_en: <P>PROBLEM TO BE SOLVED: To promptly and accurately estimate damage after the occurrence of a disaster.  <P>SOLUTION: An immediate-post-disaster damage estimating part 15a estimates the seismic intensity distribution throughout an object area based on immediate-post-disaster information and earthquake disaster history information, and estimates the damage occurrence ratio of supporting structures immediately after the occurrence of an earthquake disaster based on the estimated seismic intensity distribution, blackout information confirmed throughout the object area, a damage ratio function, and a predetermined network structure. A damage estimation updating part 15b updates the damage ratio function based on earthquake disaster information updated after the occurrence of the earthquake disaster and damage information on the supporting structures confirmed in an already inspected area, and thus, updates estimation of the damage occurrence ratio of the supporting structures in the predetermined network structure in a not-yet-inspected area. An earthquake damage estimation map producing part 15c produces an earthquake damage estimation map estimated by the immediate-post-disaster damage estimating part 15a and the damage estimation updating part 15b, and displays it on a monitor.  <P>COPYRIGHT: (C)2009,JPO&INPIT

title_en: Earthquake damage estimation method and earthquake damage estimation system of structure
abstract_en: <P>PROBLEM TO BE SOLVED: To accurately, simply and easily estimate the earthquake damage of a structure.  <P>SOLUTION: An earthquake damage estimation system 1 includes an earthquake analyzer 2 for analyzing detection data from sensor devices S1-S12 installed in model buildings M1-M3 when an earthquake occurs, and generating earthquake damage data of the model buildings. The model buildings are categorized as a plurality of model types based on a predetermined category index. The earthquake analyzer includes: a data storage section 12 for storing the earthquake damage data of the model buildings; and an earthquake damage estimation section 13 for selecting the earthquake damage data of the model building belonging to the same model type as a similar building Ei requiring the estimation of the earthquake damage as the earthquake damage data of the similar building from the data stored in the data storage section. An estimation result of the earthquake damage of the model buildings can be utilized by the other similar structure.  <P>COPYRIGHT: (C)2009,JPO&INPIT

title_en: Real-time earthquake damage estimation method for elevated bridge and its apparatus
abstract_en: <P>PROBLEM TO BE SOLVED: To provide a real-time earthquake damage estimation method for an elevated bridge and its apparatus for appropriately estimating earthquake damage in accordance with the elevated bridge.  <P>SOLUTION: The real-time earthquake damage estimation method for the elevated bridge includes a first seismometer 3 placed at the upper part of the elevated bridge 1 and a second seismometer 4 placed at the lower part of the elevated bridge 1. The earthquake damage of the elevated bridge 1 is estimated in real time on the basis of information from the first seismometer 3 and the second seismometer 4.  <P>COPYRIGHT: (C)2009,JPO&INPIT

title_en: Real-time earthquake damage estimation method by shaking of elevated bridge and its apparatus
abstract_en: <P>PROBLEM TO BE SOLVED: To provide a real-time earthquake damage estimation method by the shaking of an elevated bridge and its apparatus in simple configuration for appropriately estimating earthquake damage in accordance with the elevated bridge.  <P>SOLUTION: The real-time earthquake damage estimation method by the shaking of the elevated bridge includes a seismometer 3 placed at the upper part of the elevated bridge 1 and performs earthquake damage estimation by the shaking of the elevated bridge 1 in real time on the basis of information from the seismometer 3. The information from the seismometer 3 is a peak frequency of a bridge-axial-orthogonal direction/bridge-axial direction spectrum ratio.  <P>COPYRIGHT: (C)2009,JPO&INPIT

title_en: Real-time earthquake damage estimation method by shaking mode of elevated bridge and its apparatus
abstract_en: <P>PROBLEM TO BE SOLVED: To provide a real-time earthquake damage estimation method by the shaking of an elevated bridge and its apparatus for appropriately estimating earthquake damage in accordance with an elevated bridge.  <P>SOLUTION: The real-time earthquake damage estimation method for the elevated bridge includes a first seismometer 3 placed at the upper part of the elevated bridge 1 and a second seismometer 4 placed at the lower part of the elevated bridge 1. By subtracting a second displacement waveform output from the second seismometer 4 from a first displacement waveform output from the first seismometer 3, the displacement waveform of the shaking of the elevated bridge 1 itself is determined, thereby performing earthquake damage estimation for the elevated bridge 1 in real time.  <P>COPYRIGHT: (C)2009,JPO&INPIT

title_en: Earthquake alarm device
abstract_en: <P>PROBLEM TO BE SOLVED: To provide an earthquake alarm device for activating a main device circuit by a chime sound of an earthquake prompt announcement through radio waves, and outputting successive relevant information (magnitude, place, damage estimation, and the like) broadcasted from a broadcast station.  <P>SOLUTION: The device comprising a receiver always receiving a broadcasting wave; a sound means for generating a sound signal on the basis of a broadcasting wave received by the receiver; a display means generating a visual alarm when an alarm is detected; and an output control means for transmitting an output signal to an external device, when the alarm is detected, includes at least a signal analysis means for analyzing a sound wave input from the broadcasting wave to determine whether or not the chime sound broadcasted in earthquake information from the broadcasting station exists in the sound wave; and an alarm control means for determining the existence of an emergency earthquake prompt announcement when the chime sound is detected, turning on a main power source for a certain time period and controlling the sound means, the display means and the output control means.  <P>COPYRIGHT: (C)2010,JPO&INPIT

title_en: Earthquake damage estimating device and earthquake damage estimation program
abstract_en: <P>PROBLEM TO BE SOLVED: To provide an earthquake damage estimating device and its program for simply performing high-accuracy estimation on the state of a damage to a building caused by an earthquake.  <P>SOLUTION: A CPU 22 thereinto inputs, through a keyboard 14, etc., construction position information signifying the construction position of a building which is an estimating object on an earthquake damage and building kind information signifying the kind of the building. The CPU 22 acquires: response spectrum information signifying an acceleration response spectrum as to an earthquake motion of a ground surface corresponding to the assortment of ground in the construction position signified by the position information; and performance information signifying earthquake resisting performance corresponding to the kind of the building signified by the kind information. The CPU 22 generates adapted seismic-wave information by adapting reference seismic-wave information to the response spectrum, with the seismic-wave information signifying a reference seismic wave serving as a reference of a seismic wave used for earthquake damage estimation and the response spectrum being signified by the spectrum information. Based on the performance information and the seismic-wave information, the CPU 22 prepares earthquake damage estimation information making it possible to estimate the state of damage to the building caused by the earthquake motion which is an estimating object of earthquake damage to display the estimation information by means of a display 18.  <P>COPYRIGHT: (C)2010,JPO&INPIT

title_en: Comprehensive disaster prevention information system and disaster information server
abstract_en: <P>PROBLEM TO BE SOLVED: To provide a comprehensive disaster prevention information for increasing the accuracy of information to be calculated from damage information received from a terminal.  <P>SOLUTION: This comprehensive disaster prevention information system includes: a seismic intensity information distribution device; a terminal; a communication network; and a disaster information server. The seismic information distribution device transmits the measured seismic information of a predetermined spot to the disaster information server, and the terminal transmits damage report information including the location information acquired by a GPS or the like and information showing the damage caused by an earthquake to the disaster information server, and the disaster information server calculates estimated seismic information and damage prediction information for each of blocks obtained by dividing a region as the object of management into a plurality of pieces by using the measured seismic information received from the seismic information distribution device, and calculates priority for every block by using the received damage report information, the calculated estimated seismic information and damage prediction information, and outputs the damage report information, the estimated seismic information, the damage prediction information and priority by associating them with each other for every block.  <P>COPYRIGHT: (C)2010,JPO&INPIT

title_en: Disaster information collection and supporting method and system
abstract_en: The invention discloses a disaster information collection and supporting method and a system thereof. The system comprises an information collection device and an information processing device, wherein the information collection device is used for collecting disaster scene information, transmitting the disaster scene information and receiving decision information; and the information processing device is connected with the information collection device and is used for receiving and analyzing the disaster scene information and transmitting the decision information to the information collection device according to analysis results. The invention can realize the rapid collection of disaster information on the disaster scene and the transmission of the disaster information of the remote information processing device through a wireless network of the Internet, provide the detailed and all-round real-time information service for the real-time analysis, emergency recue, damage assessment, decision support and integrated handling of the disaster, and facilitate the establishment of the detailed, comprehensive and accurate disaster relief decision.

title_en: Management system for billing and payment(isurance others damage part)
title_ko: 손해보험 기타피해물의 청구 및 지급에 대한 실시간 관리 시스템

title_en: Systems, Methods, and Computer Program Products for Facilitating a Disaster Recovery Effort to Repair and Restore Service Provider Networks Affected by a Disaster
abstract_en: Systems, methods, and computer program products are for processing damage survey information associated with a disaster event. According to one aspect, a method for processing damage survey information associated with a disaster event includes in response to the disaster event, receiving, at a disaster recovery system (DRS), the damage survey information. In some embodiments, the damage survey information includes an area of impact that defines an area in which at least one physical plant was damaged in the disaster event and a physical plant type identifier (PPTI) for each physical plant damaged in the disaster event. Each PPTI identifies a physical plant type of a plurality of physical plant types. The method also includes analyzing the damage survey information to determine to which of a plurality of disaster recovery dispatch units (DRDUs) the DRS should route the damage survey information and routing the damage survey information to the appropriate DRDUs.

title_en: Preventing miscalculation of earthquake insurance damage report and loss ratio calculation basis record or the like using personal computer software, and controlling investigation case management
abstract_en: PROBLEM TO BE SOLVED: To minimize miscalculation and case management, in preparing an earthquake insurance damage report.SOLUTION: In order to prevent miscalculation in printout paper for an earthquake insurance damage report or the like, investigation case management is managed by software using a personal computer. A person in charge of field investigation inputs data according to an instruction from the software in the personal computer, and a loss ratio or the like is calculated and printed out as a result. As for an existing earthquake insurance damage report or the like, the person who has investigated the disaster stricken site or the like writes the result in a predetermined column in a report or the like by handwriting, and affixes the address, name and seal or the like of the person in charge of investigation to the report, and submits it.

title_en: Power grid wind damage early warning system based on micro-landform wind field distribution and typhoon superimposed effect
abstract_en: The invention relates to a power grid wind damage early warning system based on micro-landform wind field distribution and typhoon superimposed effect, belonging to the field of prevention, reduction and control of natural disaster for a power grid. The power grid wind damage early warning system comprises a weather data acquisition sub-system, a wind damage and wind speed forecasting computer sub-system, a power grid early warning information processing computer sub-system, a power grid wind damage estimation processing computer sub-system and an information issuing sub-system, and each above sub-system is orderly in signal electrical connections. The power grid wind damage early warning system is capable of acquiring timed weather data of meteorological stations in a region covered by the power grid, performing standard pretreatment, then, establishing a gale statistical diagnosis model and a numerical model by means of theory modeling and numerical simulation, analyzing influence degree of the gale on main lines, iron towers and transformer substations, and issuing a related gale early warning information report based on related rules for gale early warning grades, wherein the related rules are specified by the Meteorological Office. And the power grid wind damage early warning system has the advantages of high precision, excellent accuracy, quick real-time response speed and the like, and can provide decision support for gale damage prevention and power grid planning.

abstract_en: The invention provides a kind of earthquake damage assessment system, this system comprises: earthquake information acquisition device, for obtaining the earthquake information of seismic region; Ring focus population distribution two-dimensional mesh trrellis diagram generating apparatus, for generating ring focus population distribution two-dimensional mesh trrellis diagram; Earthquake radius region population calculation element, for being n region by ring focus population distribution two-dimensional grid diagram root, and calculates the population in n region in each region respectively; First earthquake apparatus for evaluating, evaluates the first casualties numerical value P in this region for the distance in n the region that earthquake information and earthquake radius region population calculation element divide between each region and focus.There is the problem of larger hysteresis quality in the data publication that the present invention just can estimate the casualties numerical value because earthquake disaster causes after solving in correlation technique and needing to obtain many-sided relevant information and cause, reaches the technique effect of the estimation seismic region population number of casualties in time.

title_en: Property loss assessment method in earthquake
Structural damage estimation based on measurements of rotations
abstract_en: Structural damage to a building is assessed based on measurement of point rotations using MEMS accelerometer sensors attached to structural columns of a building. The measured point rotations are wirelessly transmitted to a central unit which estimates residual drifts of the structural columns using a model of plastic deformation of the columns that incorporates empirically predetermined structural parameters of the columns such as a height of a column plastic bending point or a column curvature coefficient. The structural damage to the building is then estimated by determining a damage state from performance-based earthquake engineering performance thresholds that relate residual drift to damage. In some embodiments, multiple sensors are attached to each structural column of the building and measure corresponding point rotations at multiple points along the height of the column.

title_en: The method for deciding disability grade of industrial accident automatically and paying disability benefits
title_ko: 산업재해 장해등급 자동판정 및 장해급여 지급 방법
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a method for automatically determining an industrial accident disability level and providing disability money capable of comprising a disability money registration information transmitting step for enabling a money registration terminal to transmit disability money registration information including the name, the resident registration number, the accident date, and the healing date of a victim to a labor insurance server; a disability information receiving step for enabling the labor insurance server to receive disability information for a disability part of a victim from a money registration terminal; a human body disability level calculating step for enabling the labor insurance server to calculate a disability level of the victim based on the disability information and the information of a disability level based database; a disability level determining step for enabling the labor insurance server to determining the disability level based on the disability level; a disability money determining step for enabling the labor insurance server to determine the disability money according to the disability level and store disability money determination information including the disability money and the victim information in a giving requesting database; and a disability money giving requesting step for enabling the labor insurance server to request the giving of the disability money according to the disability money determination information of the giving requesting database to a transmission agent and enabling the transmission agent to request the giving of the disability money to a firm banking server. [Reference numerals] (S10) Step for transmitting disability money registration information;(S20) Step for confirming victim registration qualification;(S30) Step for receiving disability information;(S40) Step for calculating a disability level for each body part;(S50) Step for determining the disability level;(S60) Step for determining the disability money;(S70) Step for confirming unfair money;(S80) Step for requesting the disability money;(S90) Step for transmitting result information for the disability money
abstract_ko: 본 발명은 급여 신청 단말기가 재해자의 성명, 주민번호, 재해일자 및 치유일자를 포함하는 장해급여 신청 정보를 노동보험 서버로 전송하는 장해급여 신청 정보 전송단계, 노동보험 서버가 급여 신청 단말기로부터 재해자의 신체부위별로 장해 부위에 대하여 장해 정보를 수신하는 장해 정보 수신단계, 노동보험 서버가 장해 정보와 장해등급 기초 데이터베이스의 정보에 기초하여 재해자의 장해 부위별로 장해급호를 산정하는 신체부위별 장해급호 산정단계, 노동보험 서버가 장해 부위별로 산정된 장해급호를 모두 반영하여 장해등급을 판정하는 장해등급 판정단계, 노동보험 서버가 장해등급에 따라 장해급여를 결정하고 장해급여와 재해자 정보를 포함하는 장해급여 결정 정보를 지급 의뢰 데이터베이스에 저장하는 장해급여 결정단계, 및 노동보험 서버가 전송 에이전트로 지급 의뢰 데이터베이스의 장해급여 결정 정보에 따른 장해급여의 지급을 의뢰하고, 전송 에이전트가 펌뱅킹 서버로 장해급여의 지급을 요청하는 장해급여 지급 요청단계를 포함하는 산업재해 장해등급 자동판정 및 장해급여 지급 방법을 개시한다.

title_en: Reinforced concrete frame structure entirety seismic Damage level evaluation method based on equivalent SDOF system
abstract_en: Reinforced concrete frame structure entirety seismic Damage level evaluation method based on equivalent SDOF system, relating to seismic Damage assessment technology field, the present invention is in order to realize can evaluation structure entirety seismic Damage level fast and accurately in the STRONG MOTION DATA utilizing structure to obtain after the earthquake.System with several degrees of freedom structure is equivalent to single-degree-of-freedom system structure, the system with several degrees of freedom with N shell is equivalent to a single-degree-of-freedom system, single-degree-of-freedom system mass M e For system with several degrees of freedom gross mass；Solve equivalent SDOF system maximal acceleration effect under shock effect in the same manner；Solve equivalent SDOF system ductility factor under shock effect in the same manner；Damage index calculates；Structural Damage Assessment.Instant invention overcomes and there is error and take time and effort based on physical parameter and result such as easily dissipates at the shortcoming greatly based on modal parameter change lesion assessment, it is achieved simply, qualitative assessment structural earthquake level of damage fast and effectively.

title_en: Construction damage assessment method based on single post-earthquake POLSAR image
abstract_en: A construction damage assessment method based on a single post-earthquake POLSAR image comprises the following steps: noise removal, survey region extraction and partitioning are performed on an original POLSAR image; non-construction areas are detected; constructions with an NCCC greater than a set threshold are classified as a collapsed construction class, constructions with an NCCC smaller than or equal to the set threshold are classified as a non-collapsed construction class, and pre-assessment is performed; when a homogeneity textural feature HOM of a block which belongs to certain serious damage class is greater than or equal to a preset HOM texture threshold, the block is changed to belong to a medium damage class; a final damage degree classification result is subjected to precision evaluation. According to the construction damage assessment method, detection and evaluation of collapsed constructions are performed through only single post-earthquake perfect-polarization SAR data, evaluation precision is improved, and dependence on pre-earthquake data of disaster monitoring in the prior art is reduced.

title_en: System and method for disaster damage investigation based on mobile
title_ko: 모바일 기반 재난피해 조사시스템 및 방법
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a disaster damage investigation system based on a mobile and a method thereof and, more specifically, to a disaster damage investigation system based on a mobile (for example, a smart phone) linked with a national disaster management system (NDMS) and a method thereof. For this, the present invention provides a disaster damage investigation system based on a mobile including: an investigator terminal; a mobile server which receives damage investigation information of a disaster region collected through the investigator terminal, and stores and manages additional information included in the disaster investigation information in an additional information DB; a relay DB which receives and stores the damage investigation information provided from the mobile server; and a disaster management server which verifies a disaster register of the damage investigation information stored in the relay DB periodically through a scheduler, and then stores and manages the verified disaster investigation information in a main DB. Therefore, according to the present invention, time and costs can be reduced, by collecting the damage investigation information (including disaster information and additional information) using a portable and public mobile (for example, a smart phone), and then transmitting and registering the damage investigation information in the main DB of the NDMS. [Reference numerals] (AA) National administrative computer network; (BB) Damage investigation system; (CC) National disaster management system (NDMS)
abstract_ko:
본 발명은 모바일 기반 재난피해 조사시스템 및 방법에 관한 것으로, 상세하게는 국가재난관리시스템(National Disaster Management System, NDMS)과 연계된 모바일(예컨대, 스마트폰)을 기반으로 하는 재난피해 조사시스템 및 그 방법에 관한 것이다.  
이를 위해 본 발명은 조사자 단말기와, 상기 조사자 단말기를 통해 수집된 재난지역의 피해조사정보를 제공받고, 상기 피해조사정보에 포함된 부가정보를 부가정보 DB에 저장 및 관리하는 모바일서버와, 상기 모바일서버로부터 제공되는 상기 피해조사정보를 제공받아 저장하는 중계 DB와, 상기 중계 DB에 저장된 상기 피해조사정보의 재해대장을 스케줄러를 통해 주기적으로 검증한 후 검증된 피해조사정보를 메인 DB에 저장 및 관리하는 재난관리서버를 포함하는 모바일 기반 재난피해 조사시스템을 제공한다. 
 따라서, 본 발명에 따르면, 휴대가 간편하고 대중적으로 보급된 모바일(예컨대, 스마트폰)을 이용하여 피해조사정보(재해정보 및 부가정보 포함)를 수집하여 국가재난관리시스템의 메인 DB에 전송 및 등록함으로써 시간과 비용을 절감할 수 있다.

title_en: Cannon launched aerial observation sub munition and the observation method thereof
title_ko: 포탄발사식 관측자탄 및 이를 이용한 관측방법
abstract_en: Disclosed are a propulsion device storage unit (112) where a propulsion device, which can be projected and stood by rotation movement, is stored; a middle cover plate (113), which fixes the propulsion device storage unit to be rotated; an observation submunition (100), which includes a flight control circuit arranged below the middle cover plate; and an observation method using the same. The present invention relates to an unmanned aerial unit with a cannonball firing-type, which is designed to be fitted to various air observation missions, such as natural disaster exploration, military reconnaissance, and battle damage assessment (BDA). The present invention successfully achieves a motor paragliding method for rapidly developing the unmanned aerial unit and making the unit reach a target area after the unit is developed and discharged in deceleration from a complete round, thereby maintaining an effective observation height for a long time by making the aerial unit endure turning flight. An operation motor (127), which has the roles of a specific vertically-protruding rotation supporter and a fixing jaw thereof, enables a large-caliber propeller with more than maximum diameter of the observation submunition (100) to be mounted, thereby maintaining real turning flight skills for pulling a parafoil and moving the parafoil forwards. Therefore, the operation motor can largely extend effective observation time.
abstract_ko:
회전운동에 의해 돌출 기립 가능한 추진장치가 수납된 추진장치수납부(112)와; 이를 회전 가능하도록 고정하는 중간덮개판(113)과; 그 아래쪽에 배치되는 비행제어회로를 포함하는 관측자탄(100)및 이를 이용한 관측방법이 개시된다. 
본 발명은 자연재해탐사나 군사 정찰 및 전투피해평가(BDA) 등 각종 항공관측 임무에 적합하도록 설계된 포탄발사식 무인 항공유닛에 관한 것으로서, 완성탄에서 감속전개 방출된 후 신속 전개되며 목표지점까지 도달하여 선회비행 체공에 의해 유효 관측고도를 장시간 유지할 수 있는 모터패러글라이더 방식을 훌륭히 구현하고 있으며 특유의 수직돌출 회전지지대와 그 고정턱 역할을 겸하는 조종모터(127)는 관측자탄(100)의 최대직경을 능가하는 대구경 프로펠러의 장착을 가능하게 하여 패러포일을 끌고 앞으로 나아가는 실질적인 선회비행 능력을 보유할 수 있으며 이는 곧 유효관측시간을 크게 연장시켜 주는 효과가 있다.

title_en: A kind of flood geoanalysis assesses the construction method of dynamic model
abstract_en: The construction method of dynamic model is assessed the present invention relates to disaster information management domain, more particularly to a kind of flood geoanalysis, including：The primary data in region to be analyzed is gathered, is stored after compression into the lightweight spatial database for creating；Primary data is transferred, the analysis of flood inundation model for building is initialized, final flood inundation on tracks area areal map and depth of water classification figure are obtained using seed point spread algorithm；The data input flood Loss Assessment Technique Mathematical Modeling and flood risk assessment Mathematical Modeling of final flood inundation on tracks area areal map and depth of water classification figure after by integration are calculated, and obtain each village economy damaed cordition in flood storage and detention basin and potential disaster-stricken risk after flood inundation on tracks.The present invention constructs function admirable, the Spatial Database Systems of stable and reliable operation and analysis of flood inundation model, optimize the organization and management method of image raster data, the flood inundation on tracks situation of flood storage and detention basin under specified criteria is more intuitively presented, and consequential loss evaluation function is provided.

title_en: Disaster mitigation and recovery system and method
abstract_en: A computer-based system where mobile computing devices, including, but not limited to, cell phones, smart phones, tablet computers, netbook and notebook computers, and laptop computers, are used in the field to map and record individual damage assessments of a possible disaster area. GPS technology may be used in conjunction with local databases and mapping programs to map specific locations and associate location data with assessments. The assessments are reported through a data network to an administrative application, which may reside on one or more computing devices, tablet computers, or network servers.

title_en: Drought loss model building method
abstract_en: The invention provides a drought loss model building method. The method comprises the steps that crops are considered as main computing objects of drought loss, the average soil water content of soil layers with the thickness ranging from 0 to 100 cm in a typical region unit is determined as a disaster-inducing factor and introduced into a drought loss function; according to the soil field water capacity, the capillary pipe breakage water content and the wilting coefficient, the soil water content corresponding to inflection points of an S curve of the drought loss function in the typical region unit is calculated; according to field survey data and historical statistic data of the typical unit, actual agricultural drought loss of the typical region unit is obtained, through combination with all critical values of the soil water content, the maximum agricultural drought loss rate of the typical unit is determined, and a drought loss function model is established through extension towards similar units. By means of the method, an existing drought loss assessment method is simplified, and the estimation result is more accurate; according to parameter systems corresponding to different regions in the function, the extendibility of existing parameters in similar regions and renewability of the existing parameters at the same zone time are achieved.

title_en: Damage estimation device and damage estimation method
abstract_en: PROBLEM TO BE SOLVED: To provide a damage estimation device and a damage estimation method that can accurately estimate a disaster-stricken area in a safety confirmation system.SOLUTION: A damage estimation device 3 includes: a storage unit 34 for storing scheduled positions per time band of every unit of a plurality of communication devices; information request means 351 for requesting safety information and positional information from the plurality of communication devices; information extraction means 352 for taking out safety information and positional information received from the plurality of communication devices; position estimation means 353 for estimating that the scheduled position at current time of a communication device from which its safety information and positional information were not received within a certain time is the current position of the communication device; and damage level calculation means 354 for calculating a damage level per area by use of the safety information received from communication devices of which the current positions indicated in the positional information are included in the area and the number of communication devices of which the current positions estimated by the position estimation means are included in the area.

title_en: Damage estimation device and damage estimation method
abstract_en: PROBLEM TO BE SOLVED: To provide a damage estimation device and a damage estimation method that can accurately estimate a disaster-stricken area in a safety confirmation system.SOLUTION: A damage estimation device 3 includes: a storage unit 34 for storing a specified position of a group to which users belong per unit of a plurality of communication devices; information request means 351 for requesting safety information and positional information; information extraction means 352 for taking out received safety information and positional information; position estimation means 353 for estimating that the specified position is the current position of a communication device if in and out information on a user of the communication device from which its safety information and positional information were not received within a certain time indicates that its user is at the specified position; and damage level calculation means 354 for calculating a damage level per area by use of the safety information received from communication devices of which the current positions indicated in the positional information are included in the area and the number of communication devices of which the estimated current positions are included in the area.

title_en: Vehicular-based earthquake early warning and damage assessment
abstract_en: The systems, methods and articles described herein are directed to a cloud based server which can access and retrieve data for dynamically calculating and generating information relating to an earthquake (or other hazard event), including damage and injury caused by the earthquake. In addition, the information relating to the earthquake can be distributed to one or more cloud connected vehicles and external sources, such as for either providing early warning or assistance with emergency response. Related apparatus, systems, techniques and articles are also described.

title_en: Building quantity of goods produced Damage assessment method based on remote sensing multispectral image
abstract_en: The invention discloses a kind of building quantity of goods produced Damage assessment method based on remote sensing multispectral image.First pretreatment can be done to the multidate multi-spectral remote sensing image after calamity before calamity, then two-value mask image is obtained using the change detecting method based on random walk, before using two-value mask image to calamity, image does target detection to extract building, finally provides building quantity of goods produced Damage assessment result.The present invention can quickly, accurately, automatically detect building quantity of goods produced damage situation, provide strong data to support for the condition of a disaster assessment, Disaster relief countermeasure work.

title_en: Electric ceramic material electrical device seismic reliability determining method
abstract_en: The invention relates to an electric ceramic material electrical device seismic reliability determining method. The method includes the steps of determining the distribution function of the bending strength of an electric ceramic material; correcting the distribution function of the bending strength of the electric ceramic material; determining the seismic capacity of an electrical device; determining the reliability of the electrical device; drawing a vulnerability curve chart of the electrical device. Compared with a traditional electrical device seismic reliability calculation method, the electric ceramic material electrical device seismic reliability determining method is more practical, more reasonable and capable of providing technical support for relief work, such as disaster prediction, damage assessment and contingency plan developing.
assignees: STATE GRID CORP CHINA;CHINA ELECTRIC POWER RES INST

title_en: Crop disaster situation loss assessment method based on remote-sensing sampling
abstract_en: The invention discloses a crop disaster situation loss assessment method based on remote-sensing sampling, which comprises the steps of: (1) acquiring remote-sensing data and pre-processing the remote-sensing data; (2) designing a remote-sensing sampling scheme; (3) investigating disaster situation of a sampled quadrat; (4) and estimating total area of affected crops and affected crop area of each grade, and carrying out precision analysis and assessment. The crop disaster situation loss assessment method based on remote-sensing sampling is high in efficiency of disaster situation loss assessment at low investigation cost, and can provide a basis for the comparison of disaster situation degrees between different disaster types and different regions.

title_en: Power grid icing disaster emergency disposal method
abstract_en: The invention discloses a power grid icing disaster emergency disposal method comprising the following steps: acquiring the degree and range of power grid icing of a plurality of different iced regions; respectively carrying out personal safety and loss assessment, power grid safety and loss assessment, equipment safety and loss assessment, social impact goal assessment, material cost assessment and emergency team manpower cost assessment in power grid icing disaster emergency disposal; setting power grid icing disaster emergency disposal constraint conditions based on the currently available power grid icing disaster disposal material reserves and the number of emergency teams and according to the upper limit of power grid icing disaster loss control; and working out a power grid icing disaster emergency disposal scheme according to an emergency disposal mathematical model. By adopting the method, a power grid icing disaster emergency disposal scheme can be obtained efficiently and quickly, and the efficiency and benefit of power grid icing disaster disposal can be improved effectively. The method plays an important role in deploying power grid anti-icing measures and guaranteeing the running reliability of the power grid, and has the advantages of clear thinking, convenient operation and high practicability.
assignees: STATE GRID CORP CHINA;STATE GRID HUNAN ELECTRIC POWER CO;DISASTER PREVENTION & REDUCTION CT OF STATE GRID HUNAN ELECTRIC POWER CO

title_en: System for managing policy insurance and method therof
title_ko: 정책보험 운영시스템 및 그의 정책보험 운영방법
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a policy insurance operating system and a policy insurance operating system thereof. The system comprises: an application target facility information processing device which transmits insurance application information about an application target facility and notifies accident information when an accident occurs about a corresponding application target facility; a self-governing body information processing device, a central department information processing device, and an insurance company information processing device which receive insurance information, a pre-investigation result, and accident information of the application target facility to register and manage the application target facility; a loss assessment institution information processing device which investigates an accident; and a policy insurance operation information processing device which notifies the accident investigation result to the application target facility company information processing device.
abstract_ko: 본 발명은 가입대상시설에 대한 보험가입 정보를 전송하고, 해당 가입대상시설에 대한 사고발생시 사고발생정보를 통보하는 가입대상시설 정보처리장치, 가입대상시설의 보험가입내역을 통보받아 가입대상시설에 따라 등록, 관리하며, 가입대상시설에 대한 사전조사결과를 통보받아 가입대상시설에 따라 등록, 관리하며, 가입대상시설에 대한 사고발생정보를 통보받아 가입대상시설에 따라 등록, 관리하는 지방자치단체 정보처리장치, 가입대상시설의 보험가입내역을 통보받아 가입대상시설에 따라 등록, 관리하며, 가입대상시설에 대한 사전조사결과를 통보받아 가입대상시설에 따라 등록, 관리하며, 가입대상시설에 대한 사고발생정보를 통보받아 가입대상시설에 따라 등록, 관리하는 중앙부처 정보처리장치, 가입대상시설의 보험가입내역을 통보받아 가입대상시설에 따라 등록, 관리하며, 가입대상시설에 대한 사전조사결과를 통보받아 가입대상시설에 따라 등록, 관리하며, 가입대상시설에 대한 사고발생정보를 통보받아 가입대상시설에 따라 등록 관리하는 보험회사 정보처리장치, 가입대상시설에 대한 사전조사 여부를 통보받아 사전조사가 수행될 수 있도록 하는 사전조사기관 정보처리장치, 가입대상시설에 대한 사고발생정보를 통보받고, 사고조사 의뢰를 받아 사고조사가 수행될 수 있도록 하는 손해사정기관 정보처리장치 및, 상기 가입대상시설 정보처리장치로부터 보험가입 정보를 전송받아 보험가입내역정보를 지방자치단체 정보처리장치와 중앙부처 정보처리장치 및 보험회사 정보처리장치로 전달하고, 상기 가입대상시설에 대한 보험가입에 따라 사전조사 여부를 사전조사기관 정보처리장치에 통보하고, 사전조사결과를 가입대상시설 정보처리장치와 지방자치단체 정보처리장치 그리고 중앙부처 정보처리장치 및 보험회사 정보처리장치로 통보하고, 상기 가입대상시설 정보처리장치로부터 사고발생정보를 통보받아 상기 지방자치단체 정보처리장치와 중앙부처 정보처리장치 그리고 보험회사 정보처리장치와 손해사정기관 정보처리장치로 전달하고, 사고조사결과를 상기 가입대상시설 정보처리장치로 통보하는 정책보험 운영정보처리장치를 포함하여 이루어지는 것을 특징으로 하는 정책보험 운영시스템에 관한 것으로, 정부(지방자치단체 포함)가 각종 재해 또는 위험으로부터 국민을 보호하기위해 의무적으로 보험을 가입하도록 하는 정책보험에 대한 효율적인 운영 시스템을 제공할 수 있다.

title_en: Flood protection agreed value payout and linear pay website & mobile application
abstract_en: The present invention is a web-based mobile application, which would serve as a marketplace for agreed value and linear payout flood and other disaster-loss reimbursement protection system. The web application would integrate information about risk and disaster insurance products, including details relating to pricing, coverage and providers, from multiple providers into a single source on an online platform enabling risk-financing customers to compare and purchase risk-financing products entirely online. The web application would expedite the marketing and sale of flood and other disaster risk financing policies by insurance providers by creating a user-friendly, efficient marketplace for the listing and purchase of flood insurance. The web application would list policies guaranteeing a pre-agreed payout based on pre-determined metrics—for instance, in the case of flood hazards, a water-elevation function factoring in high water probability data and building structure elevation—saving both insurers and customers the time and money spent on building inspection and damage estimation.

title_en: Building damage assessment method based on instrument seismic intensity
abstract_en: The invention discloses a building damage assessment method based on instrument seismic intensity, and the method comprises the following steps: step1, local main building kinds are combined, and area of various buildings is collected and counted; step2, a damage ratio of various buildings influenced by VI to XII degree seismic intensity is counted and extracted from local historical seismic examples; step3, interpolation is performed on the damage ratio obtained from step2 to obtain a damage ratio of various buildings influenced by 5.0 to 12.0 degree instrument seismic intensity, and a various buildings vulnerability database is established; step4, after a destructive earthquake happens, local instrument seismic intensity is calculated according to seismic oscillation record measured by earthquake observation instruments; step5, according to the instrument seismic intensity in step4, querying is performed in the various buildings vulnerability database in step3, so that the corresponding damage ratios of various buildings are obtained, the area of various buildings in step1 is combined, and the various buildings damage area is obtained at last; According to the invention, based on the actual measured instrument seismic intensity, the local site effect is considered, and the instrument seismic intensity which is accurate to one decimal place has better continuity than an influence field.
assignees: EMERGENCY COMMAND AND PUBLIC EDUCATION CENTER EARTHQUAKE ADMINISTRATION OF FUJIAN

title_en: Emergency material reservation optimization system
abstract_en: The invention discloses an emergency material reservation optimization system. The system comprises an emergency material module, an emergency event module, an emergency material demand model, an emergency material demand estimation module, an emergency material reservation optimization module and a front-end display control module. According to the system, the optimization calculation is carried out for demands of resources required by multi-response-level emergency events; and meanwhile, an optimization policy of a distributed joint reservation mechanism is given, coordinated transfer of material supply between post-disaster regional cabins (a primary cabin and a secondary cabin) and first-aid kits is guided, accurate and efficient emergency material reservation schemes (including warehouse and first-aid kit reservation schemes) can be output, reserved materials in warehouses and the first-aid kits are ensured to meet emergency needs, and the emergency material reservation management level is remarkably improved. Therefore, repeated reservation and reservation deficiency in emergency material reservation are avoided and the efficiency effect of emergency resource guarantee is enhanced.

title_en: Decision making system corresponding to volcanic disaster
title_ko: 화산재해 대응 의사결정 지원 시스템
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a decision-making support system for coping with a volcano disaster. A decision-making process of the decision-making support system for coping with a volcano disaster comprises: a simulation module including an algorithm through which a decision maker selects the most similar scenario in a scenario database during a volcanic eruption; a disaster current condition module of showing spatial information through a GIS system by using the result obtained through the algorithm; a module extracting damage estimation information from a disaster prediction and disaster estimation database, and statistically analyzing the same; and a module for the decision maker to establish a response strategy based on a situation response database, thereby quickly and accurately coping with a volcano disaster.
abstract_ko:
본 발명은 화산 재해 발생시 효과적인 대응을 할 수 있도록 화산 폭발에 따른 화산재의 확산 시뮬레이션을 수행하고 수행된 시뮬레이션 결과물을 보정하여 화산재해에 신속하게 대응하는 의사결정 지원 시스템에 대한 것으로, 상기한 본 발명의 화산재해 대응 의사결정 지원 시스템은 a) 화산 폭발 시 의사결정권자가 시나리오 데이터베이스에서 가장 유사한 시나리오를 선택하는 알고리즘을 포함한 시뮬레이션 모듈; b) 알고리즘을 통해 나온 결과를 GIS 시스템을 통해 공간정보를 보여주는 재해현황 모듈; c) 재해예측, 재해추정 데이터베이스에서 피해추정정보를 추출해 통계/분석하는 모듈; 및 d) 의사결정권자가 상황대응 데이터베이스를 토대로 대응전략을 구축하는 모듈로 구성되는 화산재해 대응 의사결정 지원 시스템의 의사결정 과정 프로세스로 구성됨을 특징으로 한다. 
상기와 같이 구성되는 본 발명의 화산재해 대응 의사결정 지원 시스템은 다양한 폭발 유형과 기상 상태에 대한 화산재 확산 시뮬레이션 결과를 데이터베이스로 구축하고, 화산재해 발생 초기에 유사한 모델링을 검색하여 대응 시스템에 즉시 적용하는 방법을 제시하여 상기한 종래의 문제점을 해결하였으며, 이와 동시에 현재 기상상태에 대한 확산 시뮬레이션을 수행하여 완료되는 시점에 시스템에 우선 적용된 유사 모델링 결과를 대체하여 실측 모델링 결과로 전환하도록 하여 재해발생 초기 피해 예측을 위한 대기 시간이 없어지고, 실측 모델링이 완료되면 보다 정확한 예측 결과로 재해 대응 업무를 연속해서 수행할 수 있어 신속하고 정확한 화산 재해 대응 업무를 가능하게 하였다.

title_en: Geospatial information fusion systems for natural disaster research
title_ko: 자연재해 피해조사를 위한 지형공간정보 융합시스템
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a geospatial information fusion system for natural disaster damage research. The geospatial information fusion system for natural disaster damage research includes: an aerial photograph DB (115); a land registration map DB (120); a topographic map DB (130); a search unit (135); a map image composition unit (140) programmed to compose lot number boundary lines of a disaster trace image, an aerial photograph image, and a land registration image and installed in a computer; a damage location extraction unit (145); a damage scale extraction unit (150); a field survey information acquisition unit (155); a damage calculation unit (160); and a geospatial fusion server (100).
abstract_ko:
본 발명은 자연재해 피해조사를 위한 지형공간정보 융합시스템에 관한 것으로서, 더욱 상세하게는 지형공간 정보를 이용하여 자연재해 피해조사를 수행하여 실시간으로 피해 위치 및 규모를 객관적이고 정량적으로 파악하여 신속한 복구 계획 수립을 위한 기초 자료 및 피해액 산정의 자료료 활용할 수 있는 자연재해 피해조사를 위한 지형공간정보 융합시스템에 관한 것이다. 
본 발명인 자연재해 피해조사를 위한 지형공간정보 융합시스템은, 
좌표가 적용된 항공사진 이미지를 저장하는 항공사진디비(115)와,

상기 검색부에 의해 디비들에서 검색한 동일 지역 이미지에서, 지형도 이미지의 재해흔적이미지와, 항공사진 이미지와, 지적도 이미지의 지번 경계선을 합성하도록 프로그램되어 컴퓨터에 설치되는 맵이미지합성부(140)와, 
재해 정보 혹은 재난 정보를 토대로 피해 위치를 추출하기 위한 피해위치추출부(145)와, 
상기 지번 경계선을 토대로 지번별 피해 규모를 추출하기 위한 피해규모추출부(150)와, 
현장조사원단말기(200)에서 제공한 현장 조사 정보를 획득하기 위한 현장조사정보획득부(155)와, 
상기 지번별 피해 규모와 현장 조사 정보를 토대로 피해액을 산정하기 위한 피해액산정부(160)를 포함하여 구성되는 지형공간융합서버(100);를 포함하여 구성되는 것을 특징으로 한다. 
본 발명을 통해 위성영상과 지적도를 융합한 새로운 형태의 자연재해 피해지도맵을 사용하여 지형에 대한 이해를 높이고, 피해 규모에 대한 정량적 조사를 동시에 수행할 수 있는 효과를 제공하게 된다. 
또한, 정량화된 피해 조사 구축으로 재해 담당자 업무경감 및 재난관리 역량 강화를 제공하게 되며, 대민 서비스와 연계하여 재해관련 정보를 제공하여 국민 편의성을 제고하게 된다.

title_en: Electric power emergency goods and materials comprehensive guarantee analysis and management platform and calculation method
abstract_en: The present invention discloses an electric power emergency goods and materials comprehensive guarantee analysis and management platform and a calculation method. The electric power emergency goods and materials comprehensive guarantee analysis and management platform comprises a resource base module 100, a case base module 200, a disaster situation modeling analysis module 300, a resource demand estimation module 400, a resource allocation module 500, a resource space configuration module 600, a resource guarantee analysis module 700 and a front-end display control module 800, and is characterized in that the resource base module 100 is connected with the disaster situation modeling analysis module 300, the resource space configuration module 600 and the resource guarantee analysis module 700 separately, the case base module 200 is connected with the disaster situation modeling analysis module 300 and the resource guarantee analysis module 700 separately, and the front-end display control module 800 is connected with the disaster situation modeling analysis module 300, the resource demand estimation module 400, the resource allocation module 500, the resource space configuration module 600 and the resource guarantee analysis module 700 separately. According to the present invention, the efficiency effects of solving the repeated reserve and insufficient reserve in the emergency goods and materials reserve, and improving the emergency resource guarantee, are realized.

title_en: Damage data propagation in predictor of structural damage
abstract_en: Methods, systems, and computer programs are presented for updating estimates of damage caused by a disaster based on newly acquired damage data. One method includes operations for generating block damage estimates in a geographical region after an event (e.g., a natural disaster such as an earthquake or a tornado), accessing input damage data for one or more buildings within a first block, and adjusting the block damage estimate of the first block based on the input damage data. One or more related blocks within a threshold distance from the first block are identified, and for each related block, a respective propagation coefficient is determined based on a comparison of features of the first block with features of each related block. The block damage estimate for the one or more related blocks is recalculated based on the respective propagation coefficient.

title_en: Method for applying damage functions while calculating flood damage of flooded areas by using GIS information
title_ko: 공간정보를 사용한 침수지역의 홍수피해액 산정시 침수심 적용 방법
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a method for applying a flooding depth in calculating flood damage in a flooded area using geospatial information which uses an aviation laser measurement and a geospatial information system (GIS) to quantitatively calculate flood damage when a flooded area is generated by localized heavy rain in summer. More specifically, the present invention relates to a method for applying a flooding depth in calculating flood damage in a flooded area using geospatial information, the method which uses light detection and ranging (LiDAR), a technique for aviation laser measurement, and a multi-dimensional flood damage assessment (MD-FDA) based on the GIS to evaluate asset values for buildings and building content of residential areas, farmlands, crops and vinyl greenhouses of farming areas, and industrial type assets and industrial inventory assets of industrial areas, which are evaluating items for flood damage impacting directly on the flood damage amount. Then the method applies the standard of damage rate according to the flooding depth and calculates the flood damage. The method comprises the steps of: obtaining geographical information using laser beams, overlapping the obtained digital surface model with layers of a building of a digital map, measuring digital elevation model (DEM) by using inverse distance weighting interpolation, and building GIS database having administrative map, and land registration map; calculating elevation values of a building ground by using zonal mean filters and elevation values of a building roof by using zonal majority filters to have the height of the building, and calculating the total area by multiplying the number of floors and areas of the building; calculating asset values for buildings and building content of residential areas, farmlands, crops and vinyl greenhouses of farming areas, and industrial type assets and industrial inventory assets of industrial areas; and applying the standard of damage rate according to the flooding depth based DEM and calculating the flood damage amount.
abstract_ko: 본 발명은 항공레이저측량과 공간정보(GIS; Geospatial Information System)를 활용하여 집중호우로 인한 여름철 침수지역 발생시 홍수피해액을 정량적으로 계산하는 공간정보를 사용한 침수지역의 홍수피해액 산정시 침수심 적용 방법에 관한 것으로, 보다 상세하게는 항공레이저측량 기법인 LiDAR(Light Detection And Ranging)와 공간정보(GIS) 기반의 다차원홍수피해액 산정방법(MD-FDA, Multi Dimensional Flood Damage Assessment)을 사용하여 홍수피해액에 직접적인 영향을 주는 홍수피해액 평가항목인 주거지역의「건물」, 「건물내용물」, 농업지역의「농경지」, 「농작물」, 「비닐하우스」, 산업지역의「산업체 유형자산」, 「산업체 재고자산」에 대한 자산가치를 평가한 후, 침수심에 따른 피해율 기준을 적용하여 홍수피해액을 계산하는, 공간정보를 사용한 침수지역의 홍수피해액 산정시 침수심 적용 방법에 관한 것이다.

title_en: A kind of agricultural insurance is surveyed, loss assessment system and its implementation
abstract_en: The invention belongs to agricultural insurance technical field, more particularly to fusion geographical information technology, remote sensing technology, a kind of agricultural insurance of satellite positioning tech is surveyed, loss assessment system and its implementation, including satellite-remote-sensing image data module, there is the Yunnan snub-nosed monkey module that communication data is connected with satellite-remote-sensing image data module, there is the photomap service module that communication data is connected with Yunnan snub-nosed monkey module, and there is the central server that communication data is connected with photomap service module, the central server is connected with target information storage module by tie line, crop database module, meteorological data server module, scene inspection component, agricultural experts end uses module using module and insurance company end, a kind of agricultural insurance that the present invention is provided is surveyed, there is energy large area to carry out accurately measuring disaster area for loss assessment system and its implementation, quickly the advantage of accurate judgment basis can be made to being damaged the disaster-stricken scope of target and degree.

title_en: Earthquake damage estimation system, structure having earthquake damage estimation system, and earthquake damage estimation program
abstract_en: PROBLEM TO BE SOLVED: To improve accuracy in estimation of earthquake damage with reduction in cost.SOLUTION: An earthquake damage estimation system for estimating damage of a structure due to an earthquake, comprises: a first seismometer located on a lower area of the structure; a second seismometer located on an area upper than the lower area of the structure; a storage section in which a structural analysis model having components corresponding to areas of the structure is stored in advance; and a response calculation section that calculates a response value for a location corresponding to an area on which the second seismometer is located by entering a first measurement value measured by the first seismometer into a location corresponding to a lower area of the structure in the structural analysis model, calculates a correction factor on the basis of a relative relationship between the first measurement value and a second measurement value measured by the second seismometer and a relative relationship between the first measurement value and the response value, and calculates a correction response value for each area of the structure corresponding to each component on the basis of the response value of the component of the structural analysis model for the first measurement value and the correction factor.SELECTED DRAWING: Figure 1

title_en: A kind of disaster monitoring damage identification method based on meteorology with Remote Sensing Data Fusion Algorithm
abstract_en: The invention belongs to agricultural insurance technical field, it is more particularly to a kind of based on the meteorological disaster monitoring damage identification method with Remote Sensing Data Fusion Algorithm, from agrometeorological hazard risk assessment, spatial analysis statistical function of the setting loss assessment with reference to GIS after disaster area remote sensing monitoring and calamity, using risk analysis of natural disaster as basic principle, from the danger of disaster Flood inducing factors, hazard-affected body fragility and mitigation ability is combated a natural disaster to build Flood inducing factors model, Flood inducing factors are used as to calculate accumulation monthly precipitation anomaly data by TRMM satellite datas, agricultural disaster is monitored from meteorological disaster, formulation for agricultural restructuring and disaster-proof measures provides foundation.With can a wide range of, round-the-clock, accurate in real time the advantages of grasping apparent and yield effect degree of the meteorological condition to crops, foundation is provided for work such as Making A Strategic Decision of The Agricultural Productions and post-disaster rescue and agricultural insurances.
assignees: HENAN RAINBOW REMOTE SENSING TECH CO LTD

title_en: Lifeline engineering subregion classification seismic direct economic loss appraisal procedure
abstract_en: The invention discloses a kind of lifeline engineering subregion classification seismic direct economic loss appraisal procedures, are used for rapid evaluation lifeline engineering seismic direct economic loss, include the following steps：Milimeter grid subregion classification is carried out to model area, it is several subregions to influence coefficient distribution by model area mesh generation according to each grid compound seismic capability in model area；The Disaster Datas such as all previous typical historical earthquake direct disaster loss assessment report are collected, obtain ratio relation of the lifeline engineering economic loss with building direct economic loss of different subregions；Establish different subregions building and lifeline engineering seismic direct economic loss relation curve；By each subregion building seismic direct economic loss result of calculation, lifeline engineering seismic direct economic loss value is obtained.By above-mentioned steps, by reasonably carrying out mesh generation and subregion, it can fast and accurately complete different zones lifeline engineering direct economic loss under Probabilistic Seismic or Enactive earthquake effect and assess.
assignees: INST ENG MECH CHINA EARTHQUAKE ADMINISTRATION

title_en: System and method for earthquake risk mitigation in building structures
abstract_en: A method for seismic loss assessment including receiving by a computer system computer-readable input data regarding a seismic hazard and building conditions, generating by the computer system one or more mitigation options and for each of the mitigation options, configuring the computer system to: determine a structural response, determine damage states from the structural response, determine an outcome of each of the damage states; and, output a representation of each of the outcomes for each of the damage states. The output is used in a seismic risk mitigation plan and/or design for one or more building structures.

title_en: Flood disaster emergency material distribution analysis method
abstract_en: A flood disaster emergency material distribution analysis method relates to a network analysis method, and the method utilizes initial data obtained from an emergency rescue distribution center execution level to carry out real-time demand point estimation on disaster area material demands; unsupervised cluster analysis is carried out according to the rescue frequency, the casualty rate, the ratio of the vulnerable groups, the rainfall and the building damage degree to obtain the disaster area division; defining the urgency priority of a material distribution area; distributing the remaining rescue materials in the emergency inventory to disaster areas according to the weight sequence; updating the material demand estimation of the disaster area in real time until the disaster area demand reaches the preset satisfaction degree; and realizing dynamic interaction of a decision layer and an execution layer. The problem of emergency material allocation in flood areas is solved. The humanitarian rescue is completed by effectively utilizing the gold rescue period.

title_en: Near real-time earthquake damage assessment method based on post-earthquake aerial image
abstract_en: The invention discloses a near real-time earthquake damage assessment method based on post-earthquake aerial images. The method utilizes important information provided by the on-site aerial photo of the earthquake region, improves the precision of earthquake damage evaluation, has extremely high calculation efficiency, and can provide a near-real-time evaluation result within 48 hours after the earthquake.

title_en: Slotted steel plate shear wall for evaluating maximum interlayer deformation of building caused by earthquake
abstract_en: The invention provides a slotted steel plate shear wall for evaluating the maximum interlayer deformation of a building caused by an earthquake, and belongs to the technical field of evaluation of post-earthquake damage of building structures. The method comprises the steps of variable cross-section steel plate columns and an out-of-plane deformation reference; the variable cross-section steel plate column and the out-of-plane deformation reference are formed by separating a same steel plate through a slit, and are arranged alternately; the cross section width of the variable-section steel plate column is uneven along the height direction, the cross sections of the upper end part and the lower end part of the variable-section steel plate column are large, and the cross section of the middle part of the variable-section steel plate column is small; correspondingly, the cross sections of the upper end part and the lower end part of the out-of-plane deformation reference are small, and the cross section of the middle part is large. The steel plate shear wall is simple in structure and flexible in design, and the slotted steel plate shear wall is processed in a factory, is installed on site and is convenient to apply; the earthquake damage assessment method has the advantages that the function of assessing the maximum interlayer deformation of the building caused by the earthquake is achieved, other tools are not needed, the objectivity and the simplicity are achieved, the time and the economic cost required by the damage assessment after the earthquake can be effectively reduced, and the efficiency of the damage assessment after the earthquake is greatly improved.

title_en: Rape yield loss remote sensing quantitative evaluation method under wet damage stress based on satellite data
abstract_en: The invention discloses a satellite data-based rape yield loss remote sensing quantitative evaluation method under wet damage stress, which comprises the following steps: carrying out a field test of the wet waterlogging of the block-size rape to obtain the yield data of the ground rape treated by different varieties, different development periods and different wet waterlogging; acquiring satellite image data with high spatial resolution and preprocessing the satellite image data; calculating the yield loss rate of rape wet damage and the vegetation index change rate under the wet damage stress; analyzing the related habits of rape yield and yield reduction rate under the wet waterlogging stress and vegetation indexes and change rates thereof; and (3) establishing a remote sensing quantitative estimation model for the yield reduction of the block-size rape under the wet waterlogging stress by using a multiple regression method, and carrying out precision inspection. The achievement can be used for providing service for accurate water and fertilizer management of rape fields of farmers and providing basis for carrying out disaster damage assessment and damage assessment for insurance companies.

title_en: Crop hail disaster remote sensing monitoring method for agricultural insurance claim settlement
abstract_en: A crop hail disaster remote sensing monitoring method for agricultural insurance claims relates to a disaster remote sensing monitoring technology, in particular to application of the remote sensing technology in hail disaster monitoring and application of the remote sensing technology in agricultural insurance. The invention aims to solve the problems of asymmetric information, low damage assessment efficiency, more claim settlement disputes and the like in the traditional agricultural insurance investigation and damage assessment working process. The remote sensing monitoring method comprises the following steps: firstly, acquiring a reflection spectrogram; secondly, measuring the crop loss rate by sampling and recording GPS information of sampling points; thirdly, constructing a multiple linear regression model; fourthly, the method comprises the following steps: inverting the loss rate of the hail disaster land; fifthly: and (5) settling the land parcel with the loss rate more than or equal to 30% in the hail disaster range. The invention has the beneficial effects that: the invention combines the remote sensing technology with the traditional agricultural insurance survey and damage assessment working mode, and creates a novel remote sensing technology application mode and a novel survey and damage assessment mode.

title_en: Method and apparatus for data loss assessment
abstract_en: A method, including receiving, by a secure processor housed in a disaster-proof casing located at a local site, recurring wireless signals from an application server and from a storage system that are collocated with the processor at the local site, the application server configured to store data to the primary storage system, and to mirror the data to a remote site, each of the wireless signals indicating a status of the application server or the storage system at a given time. A status log including the respective statuses of the application server and the storage system at the received times is stored to a memory in the casing, and subsequent to failures of the application server, the storage system and the mirroring, the status log analyzed to compute a data loss at the local site resulting from the failures of the application server, the storage system, and the mirroring.

title_en: Disaster monitoring and analyzing method for extracting multi-dimensional disaster-related information of Internet
abstract_en: The invention provides a disaster monitoring and analyzing method for extracting multi-dimensional disaster-related information of the Internet, which comprises the following steps: s1: real-time acquisition and pretreatment of multi-source data; s2: disaster situation information extraction knowledge base is constructed in an auxiliary mode through a feature word multidimensional expansion algorithm FWME to extract disaster loss information and emotion feedback information of disaster audience groups, and the disaster loss information and the emotion feedback information are used for obtaining multidimensional disaster-related information; s3: and performing combined monitoring and analysis on the disaster area according to the multidimensional disaster-related information. The disaster information extraction knowledge base is constructed, disaster loss information contained in an internet platform and emotion feedback information of audience groups in a disaster process are accurately extracted, combined analysis is carried out by combining time and space dimensions, a disaster progress process is described in detail, and the method is used for assisting in real-time disaster monitoring, disaster damage assessment analysis, disaster rescue feedback, follow-up influence assessment and other works.

title_en: Victim management system
title_ko: 이재민 관리 시스템
abstract_en: The present invention computerizes a task by having a victim registration step of confirming an identity, photographing a subject with a camera, and outputting a 2D barcode including victim information together to issue a victim card and store the corresponding information in a server, a relief supply distributing step of storing and managing whether to distribute a relief supply of the subject in the server by using the 2D barcode of the victim card after distributing the relief supply, and a meal management step of storing and managing whether the subject has a meal in the server by using the 2D barcode of the victim card when having the meal, by processing an existing handwriting-managed task. Further, a LoRa network is constructed by itself to transmit the status of personnel, supplies, meals, etc. of a corresponding shelter to a center which controls the shelters and the states of the shelters which are managed can be checked at a glance by processing data.
abstract_ko:
본 발명은, 기존의 수기로 관리하는 업무를 프로세스화 하여 신분증 스캐너로 신분을 확인하고 카메라로 대상자의 사진을 찍고 이재민 정보를 포함하는 2D바코드를 같이 출력하여 이재민 카드를 발급하고 해당 정보를 서버에 저장하는 이재민 등록 단계

title_en: Seismic damage estimation method and system for electric power system
title_ko: 전력계통의 지진 피해 예측 방법 및 시스템
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a method for estimating damage to an electric power system on an earthquake scenario which is input.
