The method for estimating damage to an electric power system includes: a step of estimating electric power system component dependence in accordance with connection information on an electric power system from a network topology model in which database including connection information on the electric power system to be estimated, component position information, and component initial service supply information comprises a set of individual cells; a step of estimating a maximum ground acceleration of the electric power system component in accordance with the position information on the electric power system component and an earthquake scenario which a user inputs; a step of estimating common cause damage of the electric power system component in accordance with the estimated maximum ground acceleration; a step of estimating series damage of the electric power system component in accordance with the estimation of the common cause damage and the dependence of the electric power system component; and a step of estimating a final service providing rate of the electric power system after an earthquake based on initial service supply information of the electric power system component and estimation of the series damage.
abstract_ko: 본 발명은 입력된 지진 시나리오에 대한 전력계통의 피해를 예측하는 방법에 관한 것으로, 평가 대상 전력계통의 연결정보, 구성요소 위치정보, 구성요소 초기 서비스 공급정보를 포함하는 데이터베이스가 개별 셀의 집합으로 이루어진 네트워크 토폴로지 모델로부터 전력계통의 연결정보에 따라 전력계통 구성요소 의존도를 평가하는 단계, 사용자가 입력한 지진 시나리오와 상기 전력계통 구성요소의 위치정보에 따라 상기 전력계통 구성요소 최대지반가속도를 추정하는 단계, 상기 추정된 최대지반가속도에 따라 상기 전력계통 구성요소의 공통원인피해를 평가하는 단계, 상기 전력계통 구성요소의 의존도와 상기 공통원인피해 평가에 따라 상기 전력계통 구성요소의 연쇄피해를 평가하는 단계 및 상기 연쇄피해 평가와 상기 전력계통 구성요소의 초기 서비스 공급정보로부터 지진 이후 전력계통의 최종 서비스 제공 가능도를 예측하는 단계를 포함한다.

title_en: Automatic damage detection method using low-resolution satellite images
title_ko: 중·저해상도 위성영상을 활용한 피해규모 자동탐지방법
abstract_en: The present invention relates to an automatic method for detecting scale of damage based on a satellite for scientific investigation to figure out causes of natural disasters. An automatic system for detecting scale of damage for the method comprises: a database (120); a body (125) of the automatic system; and a module for automating scale of damage (130).
abstract_ko: 본 발명은 자연재해 잰나원인 과학조사를 위한 위성기반 피해규모 자동탐지방법에 관한 것으로, 더욱 상세하게는 위성영상과 GIS 주제도, 복구단가를 이용하여 피해조사전 개략적인 피해규모를 파악하고 신속한 복구 계획수립을 위한 기초자료 및 현장조사 우선순위 지역 선정의 근거자료로 활용하되, 고해상도의 위성영상 대신에, 보다 활용하기 쉬운 중·저해상도의 위성영상을  활용하여 자연재해 피해탐지를 자동화한 피해규모 자동탐지방법에 관한 것이다. 이를 위한 본 발명은, 인터넷망과의 네트워크 가능한 컴퓨터시스템 서버에서 연속지적도, 수치형도, 토지피복도, 행정구역도를 저장하는 GIS DB(105), 위성영상(Kompsat-2, Landsat-8)을 저장하는 영상 DB(110) 및, 복구단가를 저장하는 피해액 DB(115)를 포함하는 데이터베이스 (120); 영상 전처리 프로그램, 파일관리기능부, 피해정보 추출기능부, 기타 기능부를 포함하는 시스템인터페이스의 피해규모 자동탐지시스템 본체(125) 및; 위성기반 피해규모 자동탐지시스템 본체(125)에 적용될 자연 재해별 태풍이나 폭설의 피해규모 자동화모듈(130)을 포함하여 구성되어;  인터넷망의 USGS(United States Geological Survey) 홈페이지를 통해 누구나 무료로 다운받을 수 있는 Landsat-8 영상을 컴퓨터시스템 서버가 다운받아, 데이터베이스(120)의 영상 DB(110)로 저장하고; 영상 DB(110) 내의 Landsat-8  피해 전후 위성영상을 피해규모 자동탐지시스템 본체(125) 내에서 영상 전처리 프로그램을 통해 전처리를 수행하며; Landsat-8 영상을 피해규모 자동탐지시스템 본체(125)의 파일 관리기능부를 통해 피해규모 자동화모듈(130)에 입력하고; 이렇게 입력된 영상에 피해정보 추출 기능을 적용하기 위하여 피해규모 자동화모듈(130) 내의 범위설정 버튼을 클릭하여 변화탐지를 수행할 범위를 선택하고, 자동탐지실행 버튼을 클릭하여 피해탐지 수행하며; 피해탐지는 토지피복도 내에서 산림지역과 비산림지역을 구분하여 각각 다른 알고리즘을 적용하고, 토지피복도의 산림에 해당하는 지역의 경우에는 영상에 존재하는 분광학적 특성의 변화 크기 및 양상을 효율적으로 탐지할 수 있는 알고리즘인 CVA를 피해 전후 Landsat-8 위성영상의 R, G, B, SWIR1, SWIR2 밴드에 적용한 후 DNDVI 알고리즘을 적용하여 피해 전 영상보다 피해 후 영상에 식생이 증가한 지역은 피해지역이 아닌 것으로 간주하여 최종적인 피해면적을 산출하고;   토지피복도의 비산림에 해당하는 지역의 경우에는 위성영상의 정보를 통해 지표면의 명도, 식생, 수분 정보를 산출할 수 있게 하는 TCT 알고리즘을 통해, 명도, 식생, 수분 정보를 산출하는 것을 특징으로 한다.

title_en: House vibration damage matrix curvonic analysis system and method based on earthquake vibration parameters
abstract_en: The invention provides a house vibration damage matrix curvoing analysis method based on earthquake parameters and a corresponding system, which adopts a maximum likelihood estimation method based on the corresponding relation between intensity and earthquake parameters to convert the damage ratio result of correct house vulnerability matrix or actual vibration damage statistics into a double-parameter vulnerability curve, overcomes the defect of the vulnerability curve based on intensity, and particularly provides a simpler way for obtaining the vulnerability curve aiming at the structure types which are difficult to carry out simulated analysis, such as civil engineering, masonry and the like; based on the relation between the intensity and the earthquake motion parameters, the characteristic parameters of the earthquake vulnerability curves of various house structures are given, and basic data can be provided for the house building earthquake damage assessment based on the earthquake motion parameters. The method and the system have high reliability and wide application, and can be used for checking and perfecting the existing vulnerability matrix or curve so as to better serve the fields of quick earthquake disaster assessment, risk assessment, insurance assessment and the like.

title_en: Building monomer earthquake insurance rate determination method based on building information model
abstract_en: The invention provides a building monomer earthquake insurance rate determination method based on a building information model, and belongs to the technical field of civil engineering. The method comprises the steps of firstly establishing a vulnerability method-based main component earthquake economic loss prediction module, including building a building information model, structural earthquake time course analysis, main component earthquake damage prediction and main component economic loss prediction; then establishing an earthquake economic loss prediction module based on BIM dependent objects, and dividing the earthquake economic loss prediction module into three parts, namely dependence object relation judgment, dependence component earthquake damage assessment and economic loss prediction; and finally, carrying out fine earthquake insurance rate determination on the building monomers, wherein the fine earthquake insurance rate determination comprises the steps of establishing a rate determination mathematical model and a calculation method. The invention can accurately calculate the earthquake insurance fee to the component level, covers the attachments of the main components which cannot be considered by the common vulnerability method, greatly improves the accuracy of the earthquake insurance, and is suitable for determining the fine earthquake insurance fee of the important building monomers.

title_en: Method, device, equipment and medium for evaluating damage of target object after earthquake
abstract_en: The embodiment of the invention discloses a method, a device and equipment for evaluating damage of a post-earthquake target object and a computer readable storage medium. Extracting the vector outline of a building to be evaluated before and after the earthquake in the area to be evaluated, and calculating respective preset characteristic parameters according to vector outline data of the building to be evaluated before and after the earthquake and respective corresponding remote sensing images to form a target characteristic parameter set; and inputting the target characteristic parameter set into the damage assessment model to obtain a damage assessment result of the building to be assessed. The damage evaluation model outputs the damage grade of the building to be evaluated, and the damage grade is at least any one of more than two damage grades; the damage assessment model is obtained by training the feature parameters of a plurality of building samples by using a machine learning algorithm, and the feature parameter categories of the building samples comprise feature parameter categories in a target feature parameter set. The application provides a technical scheme has promoted aassessment efficiency, fineness and the degree of accuracy of the damage information of physical after shaking.

title_en: Underground structure damage assessment method based on complex effect field calculation
abstract_en: The invention relates to an underground structure damage assessment method based on complex effect field calculation, which comprises the following steps: the method comprises the following steps: determining underground structure target parameters, attack ammunition parameters and bullet intersection parameters; step two: carrying out damage effect calculation of a complex effect field according to a damage mechanism; step three: comparing the shock wave load and the earthquake dynamic load which are obtained by calculation in the step two and act on the internal components and the equipment with a standard damage criterion according to the parameters determined in the step one to obtain a physical damage evaluation result; step four: establishing a functional damage model, and carrying out functional damage evaluation on underground structural components and subsystems by combining physical damage evaluation results; step five: and establishing a damage evaluation model, and finally obtaining an evaluation conclusion of the damage effect of the underground structure system by combining the underground structure component and the subsystem function damage evaluation result. The invention solves the problem that the existing underground structure damage assessment method is not comprehensive and accurate.

title_en: Building Damage assessment drafting method and system
abstract_en: The invention relates to a kind of building Damage assessment drafting method and systems.This method comprises: to polarimetric synthetic aperture radar SAR data carries out Touzi decomposition before calamity and after calamity；The Touzi decomposed component extracted using full-polarization SAR data after calamity before calamity, the Touzi decomposing alpha in analyzing and training sample area s1 After component calamity with the variation before calamity, and then determine characterization building damage degree evaluation index；Causes are established between the evaluation index and building really damage degree；And the damage scale evaluation figure of different construction zones in whole image is calculated according to the causes.Building Damage assessment drafting method of the present invention and system can be quickly obtained the spatial distribution of building damage degree after disaster generation, provide more accurate information for emergency monitoring after calamity and rescue.
assignees: DDEQING ACAD OF SATELLITE APPLICATIONS;INST REMOTE SENSING & DIGITAL EARTH CAS

title_en: Building damage estimation device
abstract_en: To estimate the damages of a building caused by a disaster rapidly and accurately.SOLUTION: An optical image of colors from the sky and a building polygon are used. Feature image generation means 111 generates a plurality of feature images including a red-based feature image from the optical image. Explanatory variable data generation means 112 calculates an explanatory variable from feature images in the building polygon. A damage situation is determined from the explanatory variable using a building damage estimation model 224 learned in advance. The red-based feature image is a binary image, and the pixels having one of two values in the image satisfy the condition that the value of R is the largest among the RGB values in the optical image.SELECTED DRAWING: Figure 5

title_en: A kind of city integrated park shock-absorbing disaster mitigation function evaluation method
abstract_en: The invention discloses a kind of city integrated park shock-absorbing disaster mitigation function evaluation methods, step includes: based on arrangement, analysis and the research to domestic and international city guard against disaster systems organization, city guard against disaster irrigation on greenbelt and construction situation, several evaluation points are chosen, city integrated park shock-absorbing function of disaster prevention appraisement system and city integrated park shock-absorbing disaster mitigation function evaluation criterion are established；By analytic hierarchy process (AHP), the weight of each index in city integrated park shock-absorbing function of disaster prevention appraisement system is determined, after through consistency check, to construct city integrated park shock-absorbing disaster mitigation function appraisement system；The city integrated park expansion of needs assessment is investigated on the spot, is given a mark according to evaluation criterion to park, finally, being analyzed and evaluated in conjunction with city integrated park shock-absorbing disaster mitigation function appraisement system to the shock-absorbing disaster mitigation function in park.The present invention constructs a set of city integrated park shock-absorbing disaster mitigation function appraisement system, can the shock-absorbing mitigation ability to city integrated park assess.

title_en: Natural disaster damage assessment method and device
abstract_en: The embodiment of the application discloses a natural disaster damage assessment method and a device, wherein the method comprises the following steps: acquiring natural disaster parameters of a target area to be evaluated, wherein the natural disaster parameters comprise risk parameters and loss parameters; performing risk assessment based on the risk parameters to obtain a risk assessment result, and generating a risk assessment report based on the risk assessment result; performing loss evaluation based on the loss parameters to obtain a loss evaluation result, and generating a loss evaluation report based on the loss evaluation result; and outputting and displaying a risk assessment report and a loss assessment report corresponding to the target area to be assessed. By adopting the embodiment of the application, the damage of the natural disaster can be accurately evaluated.

title_en: Crop pest damage assessment and claim settlement method and system
abstract_en: The embodiment of the invention provides a damage assessment and claim settlement method and a system for crop diseases and insect pests, wherein the method comprises the following steps: determining the growth change ratio of crops in the current year relative to the last year according to satellite remote sensing data of the crop growth period in the current year and the last year, and determining the estimated crop yield in the current year by combining the actual crop yield in the last year; determining the pest and disease yield reduction rate of the crops according to the estimated yield and the trend unit yield of the crops in the current year; and determining the disaster damage rate according to the pest and disease damage reduction rate so as to realize insurance claim settlement. According to the satellite remote sensing data of the crops in the current year and the last year in the growth period, the estimated yield of the crops in the current year is determined, so that the accurate estimation of the yield of the crops in the current year is realized, and the pest and disease reduction rate of the crops is determined according to the estimated yield and the trend unit yield of the crops in the current year, so that the problem of inaccurate pest and disease damage assessment of the crops in the current large-area scale is solved, and the method has objectivity and accuracy.

title_en: Automation system for disaster damage investigation
title_ko: 고해상도 위성영상을 활용한 재난피해조사 자동화시스템
abstract_en: The present invention relates to an automatic disaster damage investigating system using a high-resolution satellite image, which comprises: a database (120) including a GIS DB (105), an image DB (110), and a damage DB (115); an automatic damage investigating system main body (125) of a system interface; and an automatic damage investigating module (130) of a typhoon or heavy snow for each natural disaster.

title_en: It is a kind of landslide and Geological Hazards of debris monitoring and emergency response method
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a kind of landslide and Geological Hazards of debris monitoring and emergency response method, landslide involved in this method and Geological Hazards of debris monitoring are monitored early warning subsystem, emergency and Damage assessment subsystem after commander's subsystem, disaster information extraction subsystem, calamity and emergency consultation service subsystem on-line by ground with emergency service system and are formed；Integrate before calamity emergency disposal business after early warning, calamity, a kind of whole process, systematic solution are provided.The present invention fully considers landslide and Geological Hazards of debris monitoring and warning difficult point and outburst feature, emergency management and rescue after monitoring and warning and generation before disaster is occurred organically combine, remote sensing monitoring and emergency response technological means based on space-air-ground integration, carry out emergency disposal business integration, forms the systemic geology calamity emergency disposal method of landslide and mud-rock flow.Multi-Monitoring Techniques mutual supplement with each other's advantages is realized, instead of with mode of manually patrolling, a large amount of manpower and material resources is saved, shortens the calamity emergency decision-making time, effectively improves each department's cooperative response emergency efficiency.
assignees: XINJIANG UYGUR AUTONOMOUS REGION SURVEYING AND MAPPING SCIENCE RES INSTITUTE

title_en: Low-altitude near-real-time building earthquake damage assessment method
abstract_en: The invention provides a low-altitude near-real-time building earthquake damage assessment method. The assessment method comprises the steps of preparation of related data, segmentation of building images, assessment of earthquake damage based on a CNN model and the like. The evaluation method is expected to provide reference for rapid evaluation and emergency rescue of earthquake damage of the regional building. With the continuous application of the image segmentation method in the actual earthquake, more and more building damage images are obtained, so that an image library for training a CNN classifier is remarkably expanded, and the prediction precision and reliability of the CNN classifier are finally improved.

title_en: Distribution network typhoon disaster loss assessment method and device
abstract_en: The application discloses a distribution network typhoon disaster loss assessment method and device, and the method comprises the following steps: calculating to obtain a plurality of groups of wires of each electric pole and the wind load of the electric pole according to the basic wind pressure calculated by the preset wind direction and wind speed value, the preset parameter sample and the preset mapping relation; calculating to obtain a plurality of electric pole base bending moments of each electric pole based on a moment balance principle according to a plurality of groups of leads and electric pole wind loads; counting the number of electric pole base bending moments of each electric pole, which are larger than the preset electric pole resistance bending moment, as the electric pole damage times; dividing the number of times of damaging the electric pole of each electric pole by the total number of bending moments of the base of the electric pole to obtain the probability of damaging each electric pole, and taking the probability of damaging each electric pole as the vulnerability of each electric pole; and updating the preset wind direction and wind speed values to obtain the vulnerability of each electric pole under different wind directions and wind speeds. The method and the device solve the technical problems that in the prior art, the calculation period of a model established for the damage of the electric pole of the complex distribution network line is long, and the damage of the area distribution network line cannot be effectively evaluated.

title_en: Intelligent assessment and damage assessment system and method for rice lodging based on deep learning
abstract_en: The invention provides a rice lodging intelligent assessment and damage assessment system based on deep learning and an assessment and damage assessment method thereof, belongs to the field of rice lodging and damage assessment, and provides the rice lodging intelligent assessment and damage assessment system based on deep learning and an assessment and damage assessment method thereof, wherein the system can be matched with farmer information, can perform quantitative damage assessment, and is high in practical operability and automation degree. In the invention, the fast splicing software is used for fast splicing the images of the unmanned aerial vehicle; the image data loading module is used for loading the spliced complete unmanned aerial vehicle image, the polygon drawing module is used for drawing an right plot on the spliced image according to the information of farmers, the cutting module is used for cutting according to the drawn polygon, the disaster identification module is used for segmenting a disaster area according to a deep learning algorithm, and the disaster statistical module is used for counting the disaster proportion; and the confirmation list output module is used for outputting a disaster evaluation damage assessment report. The method is mainly used for evaluating and determining the damage of rice lodging.

title_en: Crop damage assessment method based on multi-stage image comparison
abstract_en: The invention provides a crop damage assessment method based on multi-phase image comparison, which relates to the field of crop disaster damage assessment and comprises a satellite imaging system, a signal base station, a multispectral acquisition device and an image comparison terminal, wherein the satellite imaging system is used for regularly shooting multispectral imaging pictures and high-definition imaging pictures, relevant information is transmitted to the image comparison terminal through the signal base station, the image comparison terminal receives the relevant information and makes a comparison map, and the comparison map is used as an original comparison file for judging crop damage; the method comprises the steps that a worker selects a sample area according to a damage reporting area, a multispectral collecting device collects a high-definition image and a multispectral image of the sample area, an agricultural expert evaluates the rating of the sample area according to an evaluation method and inputs the rating into an image comparison terminal, and other areas obtain the disaster rating of other areas according to the image comparison and the rating of the sample area, so that the disaster situation of other areas can be quickly obtained.
assignees: SPACEFLIGHT XINDE ZHITU BEIJING TECH CO LTD

title_en: Loss evaluation method based on NDVI time series change
abstract_en: The invention provides a loss evaluation method based on NDVI time sequence change, which relates to the field of crop disaster damage assessment and comprises a multispectral imaging device, a movable transmitting base station, an evaluation system and multispectral image comparison equipment.
assignees: SPACEFLIGHT XINDE ZHITU BEIJING TECH CO LTD

title_en: System for assessing expect flooding date and damage
title_ko: 침수 예측 정보 및 피해액 산출 시스템
abstract_en: The purpose of the present invention is to provide a system for producing flooding prediction information and calculating the damage, which predicts future flooding by using ultrashort rainfall prediction information and calculates flooding prediction and the damage based on the predicted information. To this end, the present invention includes a simulation management unit which generates predictive rainfall information from weather information received from a radar and a satellite; performs a flooding simulation by using the generated predictive rainfall information, wherein a one-dimensional simulation is performed by using a storm water management model (SWMM) model and a two-dimensional simulation is performed by using a two-dimensional unsteady flow (TUFLOW) model; converts a result of the flooding simulation into GIS spatial data; and displays the same together with the amount of damage due to flooding calculated through multi-dimensional flood damage analysis (MD-FDA). Therefore, the present invention can quantitatively manage flooding damage by predicting the future flooding with the ultrashort rainfall prediction information and calculating the flooding prediction and the damage based on the predicted information.
abstract_ko: 본 발명은 초단기 강우 예측 정보를 이용하여 미래의 침수를 예측하고, 예측된 정보를 바탕으로 침수 예측과 침수 피해액을 산출하는 침수 예측 정보 및 피해액 산출 시스템을 제공하는 것을 목적으로 한다. 이를 위해, 본 발명은 레이더와 위성으로부터 수신한 기상 정보로부터 예측 강우정보를 생성하고, 상기 생성된 예측 강우정보를 이용하여 1차원 모의는 SWMM(Stom Water Management Model) 모형을 이용하며, 2차원 모의는 TUFLOW(Two-dimensional Unsteady FLOW) 모형을 이용하여 침수 모의를 진행하며, 상기 침수 모의 결과를 GIS 공간 데이터로 변환하고, 다차원 홍수피해 산정법(MD-FDA. Multi- Dimensional Flood Damage Analysis)을 통해 산출한 침수 피해액과 함께 디스플레이하는 모의 관리부를 포함한다. 따라서, 본 발명은 초단기 강우 예측 정보를 이용하여 미래의 침수를 예측하고, 예측된 정보를 바탕으로 침수 예측과 침수 피해액을 산출함으로써, 침수 피해를 정량적으로 관리할 수 있는 장점이 있다.

title_en: Crop damage analysis system for crop damage assessment and crop damage assessment method using the same
title_ko: 농작물 손해사정 평가를 위한 농작물 피해 분석 시스템 및 이를 이용한 농작물 손해사정 평가 방법
abstract_en: According to the present invention, a crop damage analysis system for crop damage assessment comprises: an unmanned aerial vehicle; a management terminal device remotely controlling a shooting operation and a driving path of the unmanned aerial vehicle; and a crop damage analysis device analyzing and storing data collected from the unmanned aerial vehicle for each section to conduct damage assessment related to crop damage when crops are damaged due to disasters or when the crops are damaged by a pest or disease. The crop damage analysis system for crop damage assessment provides an environment capable of effectively conducting damage assessment on crop damage caused by disasters, pests, and diseases and increasing reliability, transparency, fairness, and professionalism in evaluating the damage assessment of the crop damage.
abstract_ko: 본 발명에 따른 농작물 손해사정 평가를 위한 농작물 피해 분석 시스템은 무인항공기, 상기 무인항공기의 촬영동작 및 운전 경로를 원격으로 제어하는 관리 단말 장치, 그리고 재해 또는 재난이 발생해 농작물이 피해를 입거나 병충해 또는 질병으로 인해 농작물이 피해를 입은 경우에 농작물 피해에 관한 손해사정 평가를 실시할 수 있도록 상기 무인항공기에서 수집된 데이터를 구간별로 분석하여 저장하는 농작물 피해 분석 장치를 포함한다. 이를 통해서, 본 발명은 재해 또는 재난 발생, 병충해나 질병 등으로 인한 농작물 피해의 손해사정 평가를 효과적으로 실시하고, 농작물 피해의 손해사정 평가에 대한 신뢰성, 투명성, 공정성 및 전문성을 향상시실 수 있는 환경을 제공한다.

title_en: Construction method and application method of off-line earthquake disaster damage assessment system
abstract_en: The invention relates to a construction method and an application method of an off-line earthquake disaster damage assessment system. The construction method comprises the following steps: acquiring basic data; the basic data comprises basic geographic data and seismic professional element data; processing and sorting the basic data to generate off-line map data; generating earthquake loss pre-evaluation result data of each kilometer grid under different intensities by using an earthquake loss evaluation model; carrying out block storage on the seismic loss pre-evaluation result data of each kilometer grid under different intensities; stacking the pre-evaluation result data of the earthquake loss of each kilometer grid under different intensity and the off-line map data to obtain a charting expression of the loss result; and constructing and developing an interactive interface and an interactive operation function based on object-oriented programming and graphic image processing technologies to obtain an off-line earthquake disaster damage evaluation system. The earthquake disaster damage assessment method can improve the efficiency and stability of earthquake disaster damage assessment.

title_en: Disaster prevention monitoring system and method based on big data
abstract_en: The invention discloses a disaster prevention monitoring system and method based on big data, which comprises a parameter adjusting module, a real-time monitoring data module, a flood deduction calculating module, a submergence judging module, a submergence range calculating module, an internet map calling and LBS calling module, a population data statistics module, a disaster situation evaluation module, a submergence range gridding processing module, a base station LAC address generating module in a submergence range, an operator early warning short message pushing module, an early warning short message generating module, a short message sending feedback acquiring module and a thermodynamic diagram drawing module; the method can accurately count the population suffering from the flood and drought disaster defense, provide accurate data support and command tracking for flood and drought disaster defense commanding, provide accurate early warning for the population suffering from the flood and drought disaster damage assessment and flood and drought disaster defense, and provide accurate data support and scheduling decision support for the flood and drought disaster defense commanding.

title_en: Three-dimensional digital system capable of displaying submerging compensation information of yellow river downstream beach area
abstract_en: The invention discloses a three-dimensional digital system capable of displaying submerging compensation information of a yellow river downstream beach area, which comprises a beach area social and economic information management subsystem and a beach area three-dimensional information display subsystem, wherein the beach area social and economic information management subsystem and the beach area three-dimensional information display subsystem are designed according to the architecture of a data layer, a data access layer, a system application layer and a system presentation layer; the information of the beach area social and economic information management subsystem is the basis for carrying out inundation statistics on the beach area three-dimensional display system, and after the beach area three-dimensional information display subsystem calculates the inundated villages, the beach area three-dimensional information management subsystem carries out inundation loss statistics and three-dimensional scene display according to the village information stored in the social and economic information management database. The method can develop corresponding decision-making activities for the information of the yellow river downstream beach area, provides comprehensive, dynamic and visual technical means, simultaneously carries out scientific, rapid and reliable support such as social and economic impact analysis, disaster damage assessment and scheme optimization, and has important significance for comprehensively improving the scientificity, accuracy and rationality of decision-making.

title_en: Method for large sructures safety diagnosis using drone, device and computer readable medium for performing the method
title_ko: 무인비행장치를 이용한 거대구조물 안전진단 방법, 이를 수행하기 위한 장치 및 기록매체
abstract_en: A safety diagnosis method of large structures using an unmanned flying device includes the steps of: photographing a city using an unmanned flying device wherein a bridge or a building exists in the city; indexing information of bridge structures that match the information collected on buildings and the information on large structures extracted from images of cities where the bridge or the building exists; evaluating an abnormal movement and residual deformation of bridges or structures to perform a disaster damage simulation for disasters; and deriving a response scenario and mission procedures in case of the disaster for the bridge or building based on simulation results. Accordingly, by overcoming the limit of damage assessment of disasters of large structures by using an unmanned flying device, it is possible to quickly predict secondary accidents such as collapse due to disasters such as earthquakes by securing mastery and golden time of the disaster situation.
abstract_ko: 무인비행장치를 이용한 거대구조물 안전진단 장치는, 무인비행장치를 이용하여 교량 또는 건축물이 존재하는 도시를 촬영하고, 교량 또는 건축물이 존재하는 도시를 촬영한 이미지로부터 추출한 거대구조물에 대한 정보와 건축물에 대해 수집한 정보를 일치하는 교량구조물의 정보와 인덱싱하고, 교량 또는 건축물의 이상거동과 잔류변형을 평가하여 재난에 대한 피해 시뮬레이션을 실시하고, 시뮬레이션 결과를 기초로 하여 해당 교량 또는 건축물에 대한 재난 발생 시 대응 시나리오 및 임무절차를 도출한다. 이에 따라, 거대구조물의 재난에 대한 피해 평가한계를 무인비행장치를 활용하여 극복함으로써 재난 상황의 장악력 및 골든타임 확보를 통해 지진 등의 재난에 대한에 의한 붕괴 등 2차 사고를 신속하게 예측할 수 있다.

title_en: Disaster damage investigation·analysis system using drone and disaster damage investigation·analysis method
title_ko: 드론을 이용한 재난피해 조사·분석시스템 및 이를 이용한 재난피해 조사·분석방법
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a disaster damage investigation and analysis system using drones and a disaster damage investigation and analysis method using the same. According to an embodiment of the present invention, the disaster damage investigation and analysis system using drones comprises: a drone device photographing a disaster-damaged region from above through a mounted camera module to obtain image information of the disaster-damaged region; and a controller device receiving the image information of the disaster-damaged region from the drone device through wireless communication with the drone device, and processing the transmitted image information through a preset automatic calibration algorithm to obtain 3D modeling information. The automatic calibration algorithm applies preset ground reference point information and interior orientation parameters (IOPs) information of the camera module mounted on the drone device to the image information obtained through the drone device to set up an initial camera model so as to calibrate the image information, and then automatically optimizes the initial camera model while repeatedly adjusting external orientation parameters (EOPs) information of the camera module through bundle adjustment to increase the accuracy of the image information.
abstract_ko:
본 발명은 드론을 이용한 재난피해 조사분석시스템 및 이를 이용한 재난피해 조사분석방법에 관한 것이다. 
본 발명의 일측면에 따르면, 탑재된 카메라 모듈을 통해 상공에서 재난 피해 지역을 촬영하여 상기 재난 피해 지역의 영상 정보를 획득하기 위한 드론 장치; 및 상기 드론 장치와 무선통신하여 상기 드론 장치로부터 재난 피해 지역의 영상 정보를 전송받고, 전송된 영상 정보를 기설정된 자동 보정 알고리즘을 통해 프로세싱하여 3차원 모델링 정보를 획득하기 위한 컨트롤러 장치;를 포함하며, 상기 자동 보정 알고리즘은, 상기 드론 장치를 통해 획득한 영상 정보에, 사전에 미리 설정된 지상기준점 정보 및 상기 드론 장치에 탑재된 카메라 모듈의 내부표정요소(interior orientation parameters(IOPs)) 정보를 적용하여 상기 영상 정보를 보정하기 위한 초기 카메라 모델을 수립하고, 이후, 상기 카메라 모듈의 외부표정요소(exterior orientation parameters(EOPs)) 정보를 광속조정법(bundle adjustment)을 통해 반복 조정하면서 상기 초기 카메라 모델을 자동 최적화하여 상기 영상 정보의 정확도를 높일 수 있다.

title_en: Building fire disaster damage estimation method based on BIM and numerical simulation
abstract_en: The invention provides a building fire disaster damage estimation method based on BIM and numerical simulation, which comprises the following steps: building information BIM model is established and converted into fire model, and the development condition of fire in the building is simulated by using numerical simulation method; extracting fire simulation data, and performing temperature data integration and smoke data integration; writing the integrated data into an attribute table of a building information model, determining the damage degree of various building components according to the integrated temperature data, and performing fouling area statistics according to the integrated smoke data; determining the damage repair sum of the building component and the smoke contamination repair sum of the building component after the fire according to the damage degree of the component and the counted smoke contamination area; and carrying out visual display of damage of the building components and visual display of economic losses of the building. The method can accurately simulate the fire spreading condition in the building after the fire occurs, give the damage assessment and economic loss estimation which are accurate to the component level, and provide technical support for fire departments, insurance industries and the like.

title_en: Damage level estimation system of building
abstract_en: To achieve a system capable of quickly estimating a damage level of a building.SOLUTION: A gyro sensor 2 for changing an output accompanying deformation of a mullion 11 is mounted on the mullion 11 constituting a curtain wall 1. In the case of a disaster such as an earthquake, a damage level of a building is estimated by a data processing device 3 which is damage estimation means based on output results of the gyro sensor 2 or the like, and display of an external output device 4 is changed according to the estimation results.SELECTED DRAWING: Figure 5

title_en: Method and system to predict the extent of structural damage
abstract_en: Methods, systems, and computer programs are presented for predicting the scale and scope of damage after an earthquake. One method includes an operation for identifying a plurality of features, each feature being correlated to an indication of structural damage caused to a structure by an earthquake. The method further includes performing machine learning, using one or more hardware processors, to analyze destruction caused by one or more earthquakes to obtain a damage-estimation algorithm. The machine learning is based on the identified plurality of features. Further, the method includes operations for accessing shaking data for a new earthquake, and for estimating, using the one or more hardware processors, earthquake damage at a block level for a geographical region utilizing the damage-estimation algorithm and the shaking data. Further, the earthquake damage at the block level is presented, on a display screen, in a map of at least part of the geographical region.

title_en: Construction and application of summer corn lodging type characteristic evaluation model based on growth period days
abstract_en: The invention discloses construction and application of a summer corn lodging type characteristic evaluation model based on growth period days, and aims to solve the technical problem that lodging types and proportions thereof which are easy to occur in different growth stages are not researched and judged in the prior art. The invention uses the regional test data of local varieties of lodging disasters to construct a primary lodging type characteristic curve, and respectively establishes a segmental fitting model before and after the emasculation period and a comprehensive curve model covering the main development period. The average simulation errors of the piecewise fitting model and the comprehensive curve model are 11.9% and 11.1%. The invention is the basis for developing the lodging disaster research and provides theoretical support for developing lodging disaster damage assessment, guiding agricultural production decision, making agricultural insurance claim index and the like.
assignees: HENAN INST OF METEOROLOGICAL SCIENCES;UNIV CHINA AGRICULTURAL;Hebi Meteorological Service

title_en: Vehicle inspection systems and methods
abstract_en: Disclosed are vehicle inspection systems and methods, and more particularly, systems and methods for appraising the damage caused to a vehicle during an accident and in certain embodiments for dispositioning the vehicle from the accident scene. The disclosed appraisal systems can include one or more cameras, scanner and sensors and a computing device. The cameras can be mounted to a recovery vehicle, for example, for taking imagery of the damaged vehicle at an accident scene. The computing device receives the imagery from each camera and/or sensors/scanners and communicates the data and imagery to a remote server for use in a damage assessment. An evaluation is performed using the transmitted data and a determination is made as to whether sufficient information has been provided in order to allow an agent of the insurer and/or a data analysis module to make a damage assessment and provide a routing instruction for dispositioning the vehicle from the accident scene and, if appropriate, for automatically arranging a rental car service for the driver or owner of the damaged vehicle based on factors such as vehicle and coverage data.

title_en: Method for quantitatively calculating rainfall induced sea surface stress
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the technical field of marine environment numerical simulation and marine forecast, can also be applied to disaster risk assessment in the field of marine engineering, and particularly relates to a method for calculating rainfall-induced sea surface stress; the method establishes a three-dimensional motion equation of raindrops in an atmospheric turbulence boundary layer by considering various factors such as atmospheric layer junction, wind speed, sea surface roughness, rainfall rate, raindrop particle size distribution and the like, obtains a numerical solution of rainfall-induced sea surface stress through numerical integration, has important reference values for ocean business prediction, ocean engineering and soil loss assessment, and has important scientific and practical significance; meanwhile, the method provided by the invention can be used as a physical process option of an earth system mode, realizes parameterization of a grid physical process of conveying rainfall to ocean energy, and provides a basis for scientific research, thereby deepening cognition and understanding of a momentum exchange process between air interfaces.
assignees: FIRST INSTITUTE OF OCEANOGRAPHY MINI OF NATURAL RESOURCES

title_en: Agricultural insurance survey unmanned aerial vehicle device, rotor and fixed wing unmanned aerial vehicle flight platform
abstract_en: The utility model belongs to the field of unmanned aerial vehicle remote sensing application, and discloses an agricultural insurance survey unmanned aerial vehicle device, a rotor wing and a fixed wing unmanned aerial vehicle flight platform, which comprises a server for realizing training, optimization and deployment of an image segmentation model based on deep learning and storing crop survey information; the Internet is connected with the server and used for realizing data communication; the ground control station is connected with the Internet and is used for loading task planning data and an image segmentation model and comprehensively monitoring unmanned aerial vehicle remote control and remote measurement data; the unmanned aerial vehicle is connected with the ground control station and used for collecting, dividing and splicing images. The agricultural insurance survey unmanned aerial vehicle device capable of automatically measuring the crop disaster area is developed by taking agricultural insurance survey damage assessment as an application background, taking a server and a ground control station as a basis, taking an unmanned aerial vehicle flight platform as a carrier and taking embedded vision calculation as a core.

title_en: Building earthquake damage estimation device, method of using building earthquake damage estimation device, building earthquake damage estimation method and program
abstract_en: To estimate the degree of damage caused by an earthquake in a building without a seismograph.SOLUTION: A building earthquake damage estimation device acquires: a ground characteristic at a position of a building; ground characteristics of installation positions of a plurality of seismographs at positions different from the position of the building; and a structural characteristic of the building, being based on the ground characteristic of the position of the building and the ground characteristics of the installation positions of the plurality of seismographs, selects a seismograph for estimating the degree of damage, from among the plurality of seismographs, suitable for estimating the degree of damage caused by an earthquake in the building, acquires a time waveform of acceleration measured by the seismograph for estimating the degree of damage when an earthquake occurs, acquires a relation created in advance between the structural characteristic of a building, the time waveform of acceleration, and the degree of damage caused by the earthquake, and estimates a degree of damage of the building caused by the earthquake based on the structural characteristic of the building, the time waveform of acceleration, and the relation.SELECTED DRAWING: Figure 1

title_en: Damage estimation information creation system for disaster control and program for the same system
abstract_en: To provide a damage estimation information creation system for disaster control which enhances disaster response capacity of a society.SOLUTION: A damage estimation information creation system 1 for disaster control which creates damage estimation information includes a damage estimation information creation support computer 2 and a damage estimation information database 21. The damage estimation information database comprises: a basic information database 22 for registering information of an estimated disaster type, a disaster-stricken area, and a training level; a disaster information database 23 for registering estimated disaster information; a database 24 for names of prefectures, cities, towns, and villages; a social damage case database 25; a base name database 26; an in-house damage case database 27; a countermeasure case database 28; and a person name database 29 for registering employee names. The damage estimation information creation support computer includes information generating means 17 for referring to each information and creating the damage estimation information composed of estimated disaster status information, social damage status information, base damage status information, and safety confirmation status information for each employee.SELECTED DRAWING: Figure 1
assignees: RESCUE NOW KIKI KANRI KENKYUSHO CO LTD

title_en: Remote sensing building earthquake damage assessment method and system based on deep learning and cloud computing
abstract_en: The invention discloses a remote sensing building earthquake damage assessment method and system based on deep learning and cloud computing. The method mainly comprises the following steps: the method comprises the steps of expanding a sample set of buildings before and after an earthquake and earthquake-damaged buildings based on characteristic images, designing a depth convolution network model suitable for completely collapsed buildings, partially collapsed buildings and complete building extraction, automatically acquiring hyper-parameters based on an intelligent agent, respectively training the completely collapsed buildings, the partially collapsed buildings and the complete building extraction depth convolution network model at the cloud end, extracting an image disaster damage area after the earthquake, and carrying out labeling on the disaster damage level of the buildings before the earthquake and counting and drawing the number of the buildings in the area where the earthquake damage is completely collapsed and partially collapsed. The disclosed system is oriented to the user requirements of disaster prevention and reduction departments and comprises a user terminal, a network communication base station, a gateway server and a central cloud server. The invention improves the timeliness, the accuracy and the intelligent level of the acquisition and evaluation of the earthquake damage information of the building.

title_en: Gardening pest control management system
abstract_en: The invention provides a horticultural disease and pest control management system, and relates to the technical field of disease and pest control. The horticultural pest control management system comprises a chlorophyll inversion module, a leaf area index production module, a video data processing module, a disease monitoring module, a disease and damage assessment module, a pest monitoring module, a pest and damage assessment module, a control measure suggestion and a pest expert knowledge base. According to the horticultural pest control management system, basic information such as farmland video information, air temperature and humidity, rainfall, soil temperature and the like collected in a test area is utilized, disaster response measures are provided according to a relevant expert knowledge base, loss caused by disasters is minimized, disaster damage assessment is carried out, and the disaster damage is digitalized, so that managers can know the disaster damage more clearly and can understand the disaster damage more conveniently.

title_en: Method and device for determining damaged part of vehicle
abstract_en: The invention discloses a method for determining a damaged part of a vehicle, which comprises the following steps: acquiring a flooding height and a flooding mode of the vehicle, wherein the flooding mode represents the posture of the vehicle when the vehicle is flooded; acquiring component position information of the vehicle; and determining a damaged part of the vehicle according to the flooding height of the vehicle, the flooding mode and the part position information. The influence of subjective factors on the determination of the damaged part by adopting artificial experience in the related technology is avoided, and the accuracy and the specialty of vehicle damage assessment are improved.
assignees: BANGBANG AUTOMOBILE SALES SERVICE BEIJING CO LTD

title_en: Data model update for structural-damage predictor after an earthquake
abstract_en: Methods, systems, and computer programs are presented for updating the data model of a structural damage predictor after an earthquake. One method includes an operation for identifying features for a structure and fragility functions for predicting structural damage to the structure, the fragility functions being stored in a database. The method further includes an operation for estimating a first damage to the structure after an earthquake utilizing a damage-estimation algorithm and the fragility functions for the structure. One or more of the fragility functions are changed based on the first damage to the structure when the first damage to the structure is above a predetermined damage threshold. The method further includes operations for accessing shaking data for a new earthquake, and for estimating a second damage to the structure after the new earthquake utilizing the damage-estimation algorithm and the fragility functions for the structure.

title_en: Foundation part damage estimation device and foundation part damage estimation program
abstract_en: To provide a foundation part damage estimation device and a foundation part damage estimation program that can estimate whether there are earth-quake caused damages in the foundation part using foundation part sensors installed in the upper part of the foundation part.SOLUTION: A foundation part damage estimation device 100 includes a building vibration estimation part 102B which estimates the building vibration mode in normal times and the building vibration mode immediately after an earthquake by using a building sensor 18 provided on each floor of the building, a foundation vibration estimation part 102C that estimates the foundation vibration mode in normal times and the foundation vibration mode immediately after an earthquake by using a foundation sensor 20 provided in the upper part of the foundation of the building, and a damage estimation part 102D which estimates that the foundation of the building has been damaged by earthquake when the normal building vibration mode is used to standardize the ground vibration mode immediately after an earthquake and the difference between the mode vectors of the standardized ground vibration mode immediately after an earthquake and the normal ground vibration mode is greater than or equal to a predetermined difference.SELECTED DRAWING: Figure 3

title_en: Construction method and application of mountain torrent disaster population loss assessment model
abstract_en: The invention provides a method for constructing a mountain torrent disaster population loss evaluation model, which comprises the steps of obtaining terrain parameters, soil parameters, land resource parameters, regional hydrological characteristic parameters and population distribution data of a region to be evaluated; acquiring meteorological parameters and death population distribution data of a single historical mountain torrent disaster in the area to be evaluated; determining the maximum submerging depth distribution, the maximum flow velocity distribution and the maximum impact force distribution of the historical mountain torrent disasters based on the parameters, and calculating to obtain maximum distribution product data; dividing the area to be evaluated into a plurality of torrential flood influence areas according to the numerical value of the maximum distribution product data; determining the population mortality rate of each torrent affected area; and building a mountain torrent disaster population loss evaluation model of the area to be evaluated through fitting according to the maximum distribution product data and the population mortality of each mountain torrent influence area. The model considers the influence of three factors of water depth, flow velocity and impact force on population death caused by torrential flood disasters, and has high precision.

title_en: Method And System For Earthquake Disaster Level Assessment
abstract_en: The present disclosure provides a method and system for earthquake disaster level assessment. The method includes: obtaining earthquake disaster information at an initial stage of an earthquake; determining a casualty assessment model based on an epicentral intensity as a core factor, an earthquake magnitude, a seismic intensity, an earthquake origin time, and a population density in a seismic area; determining an earthquake economic loss assessment model based on the earthquake magnitude, the seismic intensity, and gross domestic product (GDP) per capita; establishing an earthquake disaster level assessment model based on the casualty assessment model and the earthquake economic loss assessment model; and determining an earthquake disaster level based on the earthquake disaster level assessment model and initiating an emergency response based on the earthquake disaster level. The present disclosure can quickly assess an earthquake disaster level and initiate an emergency response.

title_en: Earthquake damage reinforced concrete column crack width calculation method based on deformation
abstract_en: The invention discloses a method for calculating the crack width of a vibration-loss reinforced concrete column based on deformation, which comprises the steps of firstly, assuming the magnitude of bending deformation, and carrying out iterative calculation according to the assumed value of the bending deformation to determine the axial force and bending moment born by the section of the end part of the vibration-loss reinforced concrete column; calculating the shearing force born by the earthquake damage reinforced concrete column according to the shearing deformation, and determining the bending moment and the shearing force born by the earthquake damage reinforced concrete column actually; respectively calculating the width of the maximum transverse crack and the width of the maximum oblique crack generated by the earthquake damage reinforced concrete column according to the bending moment and the shearing force; and finally, adding the maximum transverse crack width and the maximum oblique crack width to obtain the crack width corresponding to the deformation of the earthquake damage reinforced concrete column. Compared with the traditional crack width detection method and technology, the method overcomes the defects that the traditional earthquake damage reinforced concrete column needs to be measured one by one when carrying out crack detection, has low efficiency, larger error and the like, and has better practicability in damage assessment of the earthquake damage reinforced concrete column.

title_en: Building earthquake damage information detection and extraction method
abstract_en: The invention relates to a building earthquake damage information detection and extraction method, which comprises the following steps: s1, point cloud data preprocessing; s2, performing principal component analysis on the original data of each wall of the building after coordinate conversion, calculating the curvature value of the point cloud data of the wall, and extracting points with curvature normal distribution expected values larger than a threshold value; s3, calculating an included angle value of an adjacent point of the wall point cloud data, performing statistical analysis on distribution characteristics of characteristic values of included angles of adjacent point clouds of cracks of the building wall body after earthquake, and extracting points of which the included angle value of the adjacent point is greater than a threshold value; s4, carrying out statistical analysis on the normal vector of the point cloud data to obtain a discrimination threshold corresponding to a building damage area; s5, denoising the preliminary extraction result calculated in the S4 by adopting a density clustering algorithm to obtain a distribution area of the crack point cloud of the building wall; according to the earthquake damage assessment method, the three-dimensional point cloud data are acquired by scanning the earthquake-caused building through the three-dimensional laser scanner, the earthquake damage information of the building is extracted rapidly, and technical support and scientific guarantee can be provided for emergency rescue and loss assessment after the earthquake.
assignees: EARTHQUAKE ADMINISTRATION OF HEBEI PROVINCE;YANG FAN

title_en: Yield loss assessment method for winter wheat meteorological disasters based on yield constituent elements
abstract_en: The invention provides a winter wheat meteorological disaster yield loss assessment method based on yield constituent elements, which comprises the following steps: calculating yield of a disaster in a growth period to spike number, spike grain number or thousand grain weight to form a loss rate E, N or W, establishing a disaster loss model mathematical expression for each pixel, and calculating the yield loss rate YLose of a disaster of a certain pixel to yield Pixel element When the scale result of the pixel element is upscaled to the region, the YLose is calculated according to the weight of the loss rate of the pixel element in the region Region(s) . The method considers the cumulative superposition effect of various disasters on the yield, can evaluate the scale of any area and any spatial resolution, and particularly combines remote sensing data to evaluate the yield loss of the meteorological disasters from the angles of grids and pixels.

title_en: Earthquake damage assessment and early warning device used when earthquake damage occurs
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a carry out earthquake damage aassessment and early warning device when being used for earthquake damage to take place, include the under casing and fix the computer body at the under casing top, the inside of under casing is provided with heat dissipation mechanism, the left side of computer body is rotated through the axis of rotation and is connected with the guard plate, and the front at guard plate left side top and the equal fixedly connected with fixed establishment in the back, fixed establishment includes the shell, the bottom of shell and the top fixed connection of guard plate, the utility model relates to an earthquake damage aassessment early warning technical field. This a be used for when earthquake damage takes place to carry out earthquake damage aassessment and early warning device, the left side through the computer body is rotated through the axis of rotation and is connected with the guard plate, is provided with the guard plate in the socket department of computer, when not using the computer, fixes the guard plate in computer one side through fixed establishment, shelters from the protection to the socket, prevents that dust and water from getting into the computer, has prolonged the life of computer.

title_en: Flood disaster early warning method based on BP-GEO
abstract_en: The invention discloses a flood disaster early warning method based on BP-GEO, which specifically comprises the following steps: step 1, solving the micro-terrain characteristics of an area according to elevation data, and correcting radial data by using the micro-terrain characteristics of the area; step 2, classifying the geographical positions of the drainage basin by combining the influence degree of the disasters by using a fuzzy C value clustering method; step 3, constructing a flood disaster forecasting system by utilizing a BP neural network model; and 4, utilizing the disaster damage assessment model and combining the specific situation of the disaster-affected area, carrying out flood disaster early warning and assessing the disaster grade and the damage situation, wherein the influence of the micro-terrain features on the runoff is considered, classifying the flood watersheds by utilizing a clustering analysis method, and finally, combining a BP neural network technology to carry out relatively accurate flood forecast so that the disaster assessment model can give out a disaster prevention guidance scheme in advance.

title_en: Information processing device, information processing system, damage estimation method, and program
abstract_en: To easily grasp the state of damage to the whole due to an earthquake.SOLUTION: An information processing device 100 acquires, from seismic intensity meters 200-1 to 200-m, seismic intensity information that indicates the seismic intensity of an area in which a building is included that is an observation object; acquires, from sensors 300-1 to 300-n, building damage state information that indicates the building damage state of the building having been detected by the sensors 300-1 to 300-n; acquires, from a database 400, building property information that indicates the properties of the building; when the sensors 300-1 to 300-n cannot detect the damage level of a building that is the observation object, estimates the damage level of the building on the basis of the seismic intensity indicated by the acquired seismic intensity information, the properties indicated by the building property information and a damage level determined on the basis of building damage state information with regard to buildings other than the building; and outputs the estimated damage level as the damage level of the building.SELECTED DRAWING: Figure 1

title_en: Flood loss assessment method and system
abstract_en: The invention discloses a flood damage assessment method and a flood damage assessment system, wherein the method comprises the following steps: acquiring an advanced synthetic aperture radar data image of an insurance standard land through a satellite; acquiring a boundary threshold value of a water body and a building in the advanced synthetic aperture radar data image, and extracting the water body of the synthetic aperture radar data image according to the boundary threshold value; reading boundary line elevation data of the water body submerging the building to obtain a submerging surface elevation H; and acquiring the elevation H of the insurance standard land, and acquiring the flooding height of the insurance standard land according to the elevation H and the flooding surface elevation H. The invention aims to provide a flood damage assessment method and system, which can increase the accuracy of a flooded area and reduce the claim settlement fund by acquiring the actual flooded area and the actual flooding height.
assignees: CHENGDU ZHENGHE DENENG RISK MAN CONSULTING CO LTD;CHINA PACIFIC INSURANCE GROUP PROPERTY INSURANCE CO LTD

title_en: Operational damage estimation method using disaster risk model and operational damage estimation device performing the same
title_ko: 재해 리스크 모델을 이용한 운영 피해 추정 방법 및 이를 수행하는 운영 피해 추정 장치
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a method for estimating operational damage of a building according to occurrence of disasters, which provides reliability disassembly and operational damage information. According to the present invention, the method comprises the following steps: acquiring typhoon information on a target area including a target building; acquiring precipitation information from the typhoon information and acquiring effective typhoon information on the basis of the precipitation information; acquiring rain rate information on the basis of the effective typhoon information; calculating wind field information from the typhoon information and acquiring effective wind field information on the basis of topographic information on the target area; acquiring flood information by using at least one of the effective typhoon information, the precipitation intensity information, the effective wind field information, and the topographic information; calculating a rest period of the target building in the target area by using the flooding information; and outputting operation damage information of the target building acquired by using operation information and rest period of the target building.
abstract_ko: 본 발명은 재해 발생에 따른 건물의 운영 피해를 추정하는 방법에 있어서, 타겟 건물이 포함된 타겟 지역에 대한 태풍 정보를 획득하는 단계, 상기 태풍 정보로부터 강수량(precipitation) 정보를 획득하고 상기 강수량 정보에 기초하여 유효 태풍 정보를 획득하는 단계, 상기 유효 태풍 정보에 기초하여 강수 강도(rain rate) 정보를 획득하는 단계, 상기 태풍 정보로부터 바람장 정보를 산출하고 상기 타겟 지역에 대한 지형 정보를 기초로 유효 바람장 정보를 획득하는 단계, 상기 유효 태풍 정보, 상기 강수 강도 정보, 상기 유효 바람장 정보 및 상기 지형 정보 중 적어도 하나를 이용하여 침수 정보를 획득하는 단계, 상기 침수 정보를 이용하여 상기 타겟 지역 내 상기 타겟 건물의 휴지기간을 산출하는 단계, 및 상기 타겟 건물의 운영 정보 및 상기 휴지 기간을 이용하여 획득한 상기 타겟 건물의 운영 피해 정보를 출력하는 단계를 포함하는 운영 피해 추정 방법에 관한 발명이다.

title_en: Agricultural dangerous case data evaluation method and device, computer equipment and storage medium
abstract_en: The invention relates to the field of data processing, in particular to an agricultural dangerous case data evaluation method, an agricultural dangerous case data evaluation device, computer equipment and a storage medium, wherein the method comprises the following steps: acquiring meteorological data and satellite remote sensing data of a designated area to generate a preliminary disaster damage assessment result; setting a plurality of sampling points in a designated area according to the preliminary disaster damage evaluation result; acquiring field investigation data of sampling points and aerial photography remote sensing data of a designated area and sending the field investigation data and the aerial photography remote sensing data to a designated terminal, and obtaining a sampling disaster damage evaluation result by the designated terminal according to the field investigation data and the aerial photography remote sensing data; acquiring sampling spectrum data corresponding to the sampling disaster evaluation result from the aerial photography remote sensing data, and determining a disaster grade threshold according to the sampling spectrum data and the sampling disaster evaluation result; and evaluating the spectral data of the satellite remote sensing data according to the disaster grade threshold value to generate a disaster evaluation result of the specified area. The invention reduces the difficulty of collecting the agricultural dangerous case data and reduces the cost of agricultural dangerous case exploration and damage assessment.
assignees: PING AN TECH SHENZHEN CO LTD

title_en: Disaster security calculation method, and user terminal and non-transitory medium implementing same
abstract_en: A disaster security resource calculation method includes obtaining disaster prevention data of a place to be evaluated and loss assessment data of the place in a disaster scenario, and determining disaster security resources required by the place to be evaluated in the disaster scenario using a preset calculation model according to the disaster prevention data and the loss assessment data. The disaster prevention data includes environmental information, item information, and personnel information.
assignees: HONGFUJIN PREC ELECTRONICS TIANJIN CO LTD

title_en: Method for estimating earthquake damage of power facilities and earthquake damage estimation apparatus using the same
title_ko: 전력설비 지진피해 추정 방법 및 이를 이용한 지진피해 추정 장치
abstract_en: The present invention relates to an electric power facility earthquake damage estimation method and an earthquake damage estimation device using the same. The method according to an embodiment of the present invention comprises the steps of: deriving an earthquake vulnerability curve model of a power facility including model coefficients reflecting the field conditions of the power facility; determining the model coefficients on the basis of the evaluation results performed on the field conditions in which the power facilities are installed; and applying the model coefficient to the earthquake fragility curve model to determine an earthquake fragility curve, and then applying a correlation between the power facility damage step and the earthquake destruction probability to the earthquake fragility curve; and identifying the earthquake damage probability corresponding to the maximum ground acceleration (PGA) value of the power facility to classify the damage stage of the power facilities.
abstract_ko: 본 발명은 전력설비 지진피해 추정 방법 및 이를 이용한 지진피해 추정 장치에 관한 것으로, 본 발명의 실시예에 따른 전력설비 지진피해 추정 방법은, 전력설비의 현장조건을 반영하는 모델계수가 포함된 전력설비의 지진취약도 곡선 모델을 도출하는 단계; 상기 전력설비가 설치된 현장상태에 대해 수행된 평가 결과를 토대로 상기 모델계수를 결정하는 단계; 상기 모델계수를 상기 지진취약도 곡선 모델에 적용하여 지진취약도 곡선을 결정한 후, 상기 지진취약도 곡선에 상기 전력설비 손상단계와 지진파괴확률 간의 상관관계를 적용하는 단계; 및 상기 전력설비의 최대지반가속도(PGA) 값에 대응되는 지진파괴확률을 확인하여 상기 전력설비 손상단계를 구분하는 단계;를 포함한다.

title_en: Processing method of disaster-suffering monitoring page of power grid equipment
abstract_en: The application provides a processing method of a disaster-suffering monitoring page of power grid equipment, which comprises the following steps: responding to a power grid equipment disaster-suffered reporting event triggered by a user, and displaying the position of a user terminal so that the user can confirm whether the position of the user terminal corresponds to the position of the power grid equipment to be reported; if so, displaying a map identifying the position of the user terminal in a first display area of the user terminal, and displaying a power grid equipment disaster-suffering filling page in a second display area parallel to the first display area; the power grid equipment disaster-affected reporting page comprises a disaster information reporting sub-page and a power grid equipment damaged reporting sub-page which are arranged in parallel; acquiring disaster information input by a user on a disaster information reporting sub-page and power grid equipment damage information input on a power grid equipment damage reporting sub-page; disaster information and power grid equipment damage information are sent to the power grid equipment disaster monitoring platform, and the collection efficiency of disaster power grid equipment information is improved.
assignees: CSG DIGITAL POWER GRID RES INST CO LTD

title_en: Method and device for enhancing vehicle damage image
abstract_en: The invention provides a method and a device for enhancing a vehicle damage image. The invention provides a set of image restoration scheme based on a convolutional neural network, which can restore an image, eliminate a light reflection region and a shadow region in the image, restore the light reflection shadow region in the component region by segmenting each component region in a vehicle appearance part, greatly improve the accuracy of a subsequent AI (artificial intelligence) loss assessment link or an artificial nuclear loss link, and can recover the loss for an insurance company.

title_en: Seismic damage structure damage quantification method based on Kalman filtering and elastic-plastic energy consumption difference
abstract_en: The invention discloses a seismic damage structure damage quantification method based on Kalman filtering and elastic-plastic energy consumption difference, which comprises the steps of obtaining the displacement, speed and acceleration response of an actual structure under an earthquake by using a sensor; then, extracting the response of the structure under the pre-earthquake, and identifying the equivalent mass and the equivalent rigidity of the structure by using Kalman filtering so as to establish an equivalent elastic model of the actual structure; calculating the ideal elastic response of the actual structure under the action of the principal shock according to the equivalent model, and calculating the ideal elastic deformation energy of the structure; calculating the real elastic-plastic deformation energy of the structure according to the actual measurement response of the result under the main earthquake; and finally, evaluating the overall damage degree and the interlayer damage degree of the structure by comparing the difference between the ideal elastic deformation energy and the real elastic-plastic deformation energy. Compared with the traditional damage assessment method, the damage quantification method provided by the invention has the advantages of high calculation efficiency, accurate assessment result and higher engineering application value.

title_en: Meteorological disaster insurance index evaluation method and system
abstract_en: The invention discloses a weather disaster insurance index assessment method and a system, wherein the method comprises the following steps: s1, acquiring meteorological data and disaster damage data; s2, evaluating the risk of the weather disasters; s3, establishing a disaster loss evaluation model; s4, constructing a weather disaster insurance index evaluation model; s5, developing and applying weather disaster insurance index products; the system comprises a meteorological data and disaster damage data acquisition module, a meteorological disaster risk assessment module, a disaster loss assessment model module, a meteorological disaster insurance index assessment model construction module and a product development and application module. According to the invention, dynamic adjustment of the claim product according to the weather disaster insurance index evaluation is realized, and the accurate operation of the weather disaster insurance index evaluation is achieved.

title_en: Southwest vortex-oriented distribution transformer loss evaluation system and southwest vortex-oriented distribution transformer loss evaluation method
abstract_en: The invention provides a southwest vortex-oriented distribution transformer disaster damage assessment system and a southwest vortex-oriented distribution transformer disaster damage assessment method, wherein the system comprises a wireless communication base station, a front-end server, a database, an application server, a website server, a workstation, a switch, an intermediate layer server and a power grid production monitoring command center; according to the method, weather forecast variables, southwest vortex influence area coordinate variables, equipment basic information data, historical disaster data and equipment state data are acquired by a wireless communication base station and a front-end server and uploaded to a database server, a disaster damage assessment model is established by an application server through a neural network, and a distribution transformer disaster damage assessment result facing southwest vortex is calculated according to the data in the database server, so that the technical problem of scientific evaluation of the distribution transformer loss under southwest vortex influence is solved, and the efficiency of each level of power grid production monitoring command center in coping with southwest vortex wind prevention and flood prevention emergency work is improved.

title_en: Building damage assessment method based on Mask RCNN
abstract_en: A building damage assessment method based on Mask RCNN relates to the field of building damage assessment. The method solves the problem that the neural network model has low precision in the building damage assessment task. The invention uses ResNet50-vd as a main network architecture of a feature pyramid network as a feature extraction part to realize the feature extraction of strong semantics and strong resolution of post-disaster images; the method comprises the steps that strong semantic features are input into a regional recommendation network, a recommendation frame and a recommendation frame category are obtained, a plurality of feature matrixes are generated, a shared feature layer is formed, and features with strong resolution are input into a RoIAlign layer; inputting each feature matrix to the RoIAlign layer, and obtaining a plurality of feature graphs after scaling the feature matrix to k multiplied by k; a plurality of feature maps are processed simultaneously, mask RCNN is generated through a full convolution neural network, and redundancy is removed through a non-maximum suppression algorithm; and obtaining the position of the building in the satellite image, and scoring the reliability of the prediction result according to the damage degree of the building. The method mainly realizes the hierarchical evaluation of the damage degree of the building and is applied to the disaster loss evaluation.

title_en: Detection method for simulating yield strength of steel bar after fire
abstract_en: The invention discloses a detection method for simulating the yield strength of a steel bar after a fire disaster. The invention adopts the electromagnetic induction heat treatment technology to heat up, and simulates the actual fire field temperature, on one hand, the heating speed is high, the heat preservation time is long, and the fire field environment can be simulated accurately; a formula with higher precision is established for analysis and calculation, the test result can accurately reflect the yield strength change of the steel bar after the fire occurs, powerful scientific basis is provided for analyzing the change condition of the building when the fire occurs, and test basis is provided for the damage assessment and repair of the steel bar structure after the fire occurs.

title_en: Power grid equipment disaster damage assessment method and device, storage medium and electronic equipment
