abstract_en: The invention discloses a method and a device for evaluating disaster damage of power grid equipment, a storage medium and electronic equipment, wherein the method comprises the following steps: obtaining a grading result of the damage degree of the single power grid equipment caused by the single disaster and an influence degree result of the single disaster on the single power grid equipment; calculating a single disaster damage weight value according to the influence degree result and the Pythagorean fuzzy set theory; calculating the damage result of the single disaster to the single power grid equipment according to the grading result and the single disaster damage weight value; and calculating the damage degree of the power grid equipment when multiple disasters are concurrent according to the damage result of the single disaster on the single power grid equipment and the single disaster damage weight value. According to the method, when the damage result of the single disaster to the single power grid equipment is calculated, the scoring result and the weight value are considered, so that the accuracy of evaluation of the damage result of the single disaster to the single power grid equipment is improved; and on the basis, the damage degree of the power grid equipment under the concurrent action of multiple disasters is quickly evaluated, and a basis is provided for emergency decision.
assignees: GLOBAL ENERGY INTERCONNECTION RES INST CO LTD;STATE GRID CORP CHINA;STATE GRID ZHEJIANG ELECTRIC POWER CO LTD

title_en: Flood disaster situation evaluation method based on vector guidance
abstract_en: The invention discloses a flood situation evaluation method based on vector guidance, which comprises the steps of water body extraction, vector guidance, flood submerging range determination and flood loss estimation; the flood disaster assessment method obtains the water body range through the flood period remote sensing image, then the water body range is matched with the geographic vector data, the flood disaster can be rapidly positioned to the flood disaster occurrence place, the disaster damage assessment can be carried out, the disaster information can be rapidly extracted under the condition that processing resources are limited, the implementation is simple and rapid, the required cost is low, the coordination capacity between the interior of different data and the data is fully and deeply dug by utilizing the auxiliary function of the geographic vector information, the flood disaster assessment is realized, the data required in the assessment process is less, the analysis is simple and convenient, the efficiency is higher and more accurate compared with the existing assessment method, the processing is carried out based on the data of 0 level or 1 level, and rapid decision support can be provided for the disaster reduction and relief service.
assignees: UNIV CHENGDU INFORMATION TECHNOLOGY;NAT DISASTER REDUCTION CENTER OF THE EMERGENCY MANAGEMENT DEPARTMENT

title_en: TOTAL MANAGEMENT SYSTEM OF GRID ELECTRIC POWER SYSTEM Based on High Voltage Transmission
title_ko: 송전 전력 계통 기반의 전력 계통 관제 시스템
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a transmission power system-based power system control system that predicts power demand in advance on the basis of artificial intelligence. The transmission power system-based power system control system comprises a control system that predicts electricity demand on the basis of big data information collected by accessing at least one of TV news database, media DB, social network service (SNS), and national disaster safety system using a communication network, and controlling the power reserve ratio required for the plurality of power consumers according to the predicted power demand. The control system comprises a demand forecasting unit for performing a keyword search on the text and voice information included in the big data information on the basis of artificial intelligence to predict daily power demand, weekly power demand, and quarterly power demand for a plurality of power demanders. It is possible to solve the problem of imbalance of power supply and demand in the power system, and it is possible to increase the reserve power required for the power system.
abstract_ko: 본 발명은 인공지능 기반으로 전력 수요를 미리 예측하는 송전 전력 계통 기반의 전력 계통 관제 시스템에 관한 것으로, 통신망을 이용해 TV 뉴스 DB(data base), 언론사 DB, SNS(social network service), 및 국가재난안전시스템 중에서 적어도 하나에 접속하여 수집한 빅데이터 정보에 기반하여 전력 수요를 예측하고, 예측된 전력 수요에 따라 상기 복수의 전력 수요처들에게 필요한 전력 예비율을 제어하는 제어 시스템을 포함하고, 상기 제어 시스템은, 상기 빅데이터 정보에 포함된 텍스트 및 음성 정보를 인공지능 기반으로 키워드 검색을 수행하여, 상기 복수의 전력 수요처들에 대한 일 단위의 전력 수요, 주 단위의 전력 수요, 및 분기 단위의 전력 수요를 예측하는 수요 예측부를 포함하는 바, 전력 계통의 전력 수급 불균형 문제를 해소하며, 전력 계통에 필요한 예비 전력을 높일 수 있다.

title_en: Cloud-integrated disaster intelligent sensing, transmission, identification and evaluation method
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the technical field of structural health monitoring and disaster prevention and reduction, and particularly relates to a cloud-integrated disaster intelligent sensing, transmission, identification and evaluation method, which specifically comprises the following steps: carrying components such as a pan-tilt camera, a picture transmission cloud box and the like on an unmanned aerial vehicle, and connecting the components with a ground workstation to form an unmanned aerial vehicle platform; secondly, operating a ground workstation in the unmanned aerial vehicle platform in the first step to acquire disaster information and upload image/video data to a cloud end in real time; step three, downloading the disaster image/video data acquired in the step two in real time by using a ground workstation; step four, disaster identification and evaluation are carried out on the real-time disaster data downloaded in the step three; the invention has the beneficial effects that: according to the method, the intelligent and automatic disaster damage assessment can be realized by combining an unmanned aerial vehicle platform and a deep learning technology, and the method has the advantages of high efficiency, high safety, regional assessment and the like.

title_en: Neural network-based building damage assessment method after natural disaster
abstract_en: The application relates to the technical field of building damage assessment, in particular to a method for assessing building damage after natural disasters based on a neural network. The building damage assessment method comprises the following steps: acquiring a satellite remote sensing image RSI of an area to be evaluated, wherein the satellite remote sensing image RSI comprises a pre-disaster RSI and a post-disaster RSI; establishing an image set, and labeling the image set to obtain a labeled image set; establishing a data set for evaluating the building damage based on the labeled image set; building damage assessment network BDANet is constructed based on the neural network; training the BDANet by using the data set to obtain a building damage assessment model; the building damage assessment model is used for assessing the damage degree of buildings in the area to be assessed so as to solve the problems that in the prior art, huge pixel images need to be processed quickly, building positioning accuracy is low, and building damage assessment accuracy is low.
assignees: YUNNAN POWER GRID CO LTD ELECTRIC POWER RES INST

title_en: Rapid prediction method for earthquake response of three-span gallery type RC frame building
abstract_en: A quick prediction method for earthquake response of a three-span gallery type RC frame building relates to the technical field of civil engineering, aims at the problem of low earthquake response prediction speed in the prior art, simultaneously considers diversity of target building structure parameters and variability of earthquake motion through input of a prediction model, can be suitable for a large class of three-span gallery type frame structures with the same stress characteristics, and a trained StruNet model can be applied to structures with the same stress characteristics in different target areas. The model established based on the deep learning method can obviously shorten the structural response prediction time, can provide quick support for building damage estimation after earthquake, shortens the working time and reduces the calculation cost on building earthquake resistance evaluation before earthquake. Compared with the traditional method which is long in time consumption and complex in modeling, the method is good in accuracy, and the method is high in seismic response prediction speed.

title_en: Flood disaster damage assessment method and simulation deduction system
abstract_en: The invention relates to a flood disaster damage assessment method and a simulation deduction system, belonging to the technical field of assessment analysis simulation and comprising the steps of constructing and training a flood deduction neural network model; acquiring and monitoring hydrological characteristic information in real time, and calculating the precipitation of a prediction area; flood deduction is carried out; setting loss evaluation parameters; and (4) loss evaluation calculation. The invention comprehensively utilizes satellite remote sensing and sensors to monitor data, and makes up the problems of complexity of information integration of collected information and insufficient real-time performance; establishing a neural network deduction model, continuously optimizing flood deduction capacity through deep self-learning, adjusting and optimizing network parameters according to land cover data, and improving loss evaluation accuracy; and a Markov chain method is adopted in the precipitation prediction, so that redundant data volume is relieved, and the deduction calculation efficiency is improved.
assignees: NANJING WECHIN INFORMATION TECH CO LTD

title_en: Damage evaluation information system, server device, terminal device, and program
abstract_en: Provided are a damage assessment information system, a server device, a terminal device, and a program that can bring about at least one among an improved sense of understanding with respect to a damage assessment result, a reduction of inspection costs, and a reduction in discrepancies between damage assessment results by a plurality of inspectors. A preliminary damage assessment result is acquired, and a server device extracts a plurality of disaster images associated with the preliminary damage assessment result from a disaster image database (15) and displays the extracted disaster images on a display device of a terminal device. The input of an instruction to confirm a damage assessment result is received from the terminal device on which the disaster images are displayed, and the confirmed damage assessment result is registered in a damage inspection result database (17).

title_en: Disaster relief hub box system
abstract_en: A disaster relief hub box system includes a hub box, instructions, and damage assessment materials. The hub box may comprise a door that is hingedly coupled to the hub box. To open the door, a user may use a key or coin to turn a lock. Once the door is opened, clipboards with instructions, a radio, and the damage assessment form may be provided to community members to organize the community and address any emergency situation. The hub box may be opened by any individual without the need of a key, allowing it to be accessible to anyone day or night. To deter vandalism and notify community members of a possible emergency, an alarm may be positioned inside the hub box and activated when the door is opened.

title_en: Damage estimation device and damage estimation program
abstract_en: To obtain a damage estimation device and a damage estimation program capable of simultaneously estimating a damaged state of a building itself by an earthquake and a damaged state of foundations of the building by the earthquake for the building after construction.SOLUTION: A damage estimation device 100 includes: a building vibration estimation part 102B for estimating a normal building vibration mode and a building vibration mode immediately after an earthquake by system identification using a separation model analyzable by separating mutual influence of a building and foundations by using a building sensor 18 provided in the building; a foundation vibration estimation part 102C for estimating a normal foundation vibration mode and a foundation vibration mode immediately after an earthquake by system identification using the separation model by using a foundation sensor 20 provided in an upper part of the foundations; and a damage estimation part 102D for estimating a damaged state of a building and foundations from a difference in a physical quantity regarding stiffness obtained in the normal building vibration mode and the building vibration mode immediately after an earthquake, and a difference in a physical quantity regarding stiffness obtained in the normal foundation vibration mode and the foundation vibration mode immediately after an earthquake.SELECTED DRAWING: Figure 3

title_en: Apparatus for predicting flood damage and method for predicting flood damage
title_ko: 침수 피해액 산출 장치 및 침수 피해액 산출 방법
abstract_en: The present invention relates to an apparatus for estimating flood damage and a method for estimating flood damage. An apparatus for estimating flood damage according to the present invention includes: an asset value estimating part that classifies buildings in a target area by use and estimates and stores the value of assets damaged by flooding for each building; and a flood damage estimation part for each building that applies different damage estimation formulas to the asset value according to the use of the building and estimates flood damage caused by changes in the depth of flooding for each building.
abstract_ko: 본 발명은 침수 피해액 산출 장치 및 침수 피해액 산출 방법에 관한 것으로서, 본 발명에 따른 침수 피해액 산출 장치는 대상 지역 내 건물을 용도별로 분류하고 각 건물에 대하여 침수시 발생하는 피해 자산가치를 산정하여 저장하는 자산 가치 산정부 및 건물 용도에 따라서 상기 자산가치에 서로 다른 피해액 산출식을 적용하여 침수심의 변화에 따른 침수 피해액을 건물별로 산정하는 건물별 침수 피해액 산출부를 포함하는 것을 특징으로 한다.
assignees: SEOUL NAT UNIV R&DB FOUNDATION;KOREA INST SCI & TECH INF

title_en: Monte Carlo simulation-based urban water supply pipe network earthquake damage assessment method
abstract_en: The invention provides a Monte Carlo simulation-based urban water supply network earthquake damage assessment method, which comprises the following steps of: 1. gridding the research area; 2. generating a spatially correlated peak ground velocity distribution map corresponding to a study region discretized by different grid sizes; 3. evaluating the earthquake damage probability of each pipeline in the pipe network on each peak value ground velocity distribution diagram; 4. simulating the damage situation of the pipe network on each peak value ground speed distribution graph by using a Monte Carlo method; 5. counting damage indexes, and analyzing and determining recommended grid size; 6. calculating a recommended grid size suitable for a pipe network to be evaluated, and generating a peak ground speed distribution map of a research area under the recommended grid size; 7. and simulating the earthquake damage state of the pipe network by using Monte Carlo, and counting and analyzing the damage indexes of the pipe network. The method can be used for reliable and efficient evaluation of earthquake damage of urban water supply networks of any scale, and calculation efficiency is remarkably improved.

title_en: Fire overall process monitoring method and device based on remote sensing data
abstract_en: The application relates to a fire overall process monitoring method and device based on remote sensing data, wherein the method comprises the following steps: acquiring first remote sensing data at a monitoring area in real time, and analyzing the first remote sensing data; when the first remote sensing data containing the abnormal temperature region is analyzed, the abnormal temperature region is extracted from the first remote sensing data, and the current fire spreading trend is predicted based on the abnormal temperature region to obtain the corresponding fire spreading trend; and when the first remote sensing data is analyzed to have no abnormal temperature region, carrying out fire early warning processing on the current monitoring region based on the first remote sensing data to obtain a corresponding fire early warning result. The method has the advantages that through setting a fire spreading area prediction flow and a fire early warning flow, and analyzing and calling different threads for the first remote sensing data of the monitoring area acquired in real time, the fire is monitored in the whole process of early warning before occurrence, near real-time monitoring during occurrence and disaster damage assessment after occurrence.
assignees: BEIJING SPACEFLIGHT TITAN SCIENCE AND TECH CO LTD

title_en: Crop growth remote sensing monitoring system and method based on crop model and assimilation technology
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the technical field of crop detection, and discloses a crop growth remote sensing monitoring system and a method based on a crop model and a assimilation technology, wherein the crop growth remote sensing monitoring system based on the crop model and the assimilation technology comprises: the system comprises a remote sensing data acquisition module, a data preprocessing module, a data transmission module, a central control module, a model construction module, a crop growth condition monitoring module, a growth condition parameter extraction module, a growth condition parameter assimilation module, a data storage module and an updating display module. The crop growth remote sensing monitoring system based on the crop model and the assimilation technology effectively improves the crop monitoring precision, is simple and convenient, and is easy to popularize and apply in a large area. Meanwhile, the data assimilation can effectively improve the monitoring precision of the monitoring model, reveal the growth change rule and ensure the stability and reliability of the result; the precision of crop monitoring and disaster damage assessment is obviously improved, and the method has an important application prospect.
assignees: AGRICULTURAL REMOTE SENSING AND INFORMATION RES INSTITUTE OF HEILONGJIANG ACADEMY OF AGRICULTURAL SC

title_en: Damage estimation system for building
abstract_en: To provide a system for estimating the degree of damage of a building if a principal shock based on emergency earthquake prediction information takes place by combining information on the degree of damage of the building by the occurrence of the past earthquake with the emergency earthquake prediction information by an emergency earthquake flash report.SOLUTION: A damage estimation system for a building includes a plurality of slave unit modules 11, a master unit module for calculating earthquake information on the basis of measurement information received from the slave unit modules and transmitting a calculation result to a server 13, and the server for diagnosing a damage level of a building 21 by an earthquake on the basis of the earthquake information received from the master unit module. The server includes storage means for storing the earthquake information and the damage level of the building, and reception means for receiving an emergency earthquake flash report, and predicts a damage level of the building by an arrival scheduled earthquake by using estimation information on the arrival scheduled earthquake acquired by the emergency earthquake flash report, the stored earthquake information and information of the damage level of the building after receiving the emergency earthquake flash report.SELECTED DRAWING: Figure 1

title_en: Boiler damage estimation system and boiler damage estimation device
abstract_en: Provided is a damage estimation method that takes into account boiler-specific behaviors during earthquakes. A boiler damage estimation device (100) receives, from a cloud server (200), sensor data output after detecting the relative displacement of a furnace rear wall (22) constituting part of a furnace (2) of a boiler (1) and facing a cage portion (4) and a cage front wall (41) constituting part of the cage portion and facing the furnace rear wall, calculates time series changes in the relative displacement of the boiler on the basis of the sensor data, analyzes the progress of boiler damage and the amount of change in the shapes of the furnace rear wall and the cage portion, and outputs the analysis results.
assignees: MITSUBISHI HEAVY IND LTD;MITSUBISHI POWER LTD

title_en: Non-structural system seismic loss assessment method considering multi-dimensional seismic input
abstract_en: The invention discloses a non-structural system seismic loss evaluation method considering multi-dimensional seismic input, belonging to the technical field of seismic loss evaluation; the method comprises the following steps: selecting near fault earthquake motion matched with the earthquake acceleration response spectrum according to the site characteristics; establishing a structure numerical model by using finite element software; extracting horizontal and vertical acceleration or speed responses of a structural floor and calculating a combined response; judging when loss evaluation under the common excitation of horizontal and vertical earthquakes needs to be considered at the same time according to the probability model; carrying out numerical modeling on the non-structural component to obtain the probability of overturning damage; and correcting the vulnerability curve according to the overturning damage probability, calculating the earthquake economic loss expectation of a single component, and finally obtaining the earthquake economic loss of the non-structural system of the whole building. Different from the traditional evaluation method for the earthquake economic loss of the non-structural system under the action of the horizontal earthquake, the method provided by the invention considers the engineering practice of multi-dimensional earthquake input, and improves the accuracy of the earthquake loss evaluation calculation result.

title_en: Rural real estate loss assessment method based on finite element analysis and geographic information
abstract_en: The invention discloses a method for evaluating rural house property loss based on finite element analysis and geographic information, which solves the problem that the accuracy of a flood damage rate curve in the prior art needs to be improved. The method comprises the following steps of 1, simulating a flood damage process of a masonry house; step 2, fitting a loss rate curve; step 3, simulating and determining the flood influence range and the submerging water depth by utilizing hydrodynamic software; step 4, evaluating the house value in the inundation area; and 5, calculating the loss of the flood property. According to the technology, the damage process of the masonry house in the rural area at the downstream of the yellow river in flood is analyzed through finite element simulation, and loss rate data are fitted to obtain a continuous loss rate curve. Compared with the traditional stepped loss rate curve, the curve takes relative water depth as an independent variable, can be used for loss evaluation of masonry houses with different building heights, and has wider applicability.

title_en: Watershed water simulation method based on webGIS platform and considering comprehensive utilization requirements
abstract_en: A watershed water simulation method based on a webGIS platform and considering comprehensive utilization requirements comprises the following steps of: editing and managing the layers; step 2: generating a comprehensive scheduling calculation scheme; step 3: performing demonstration of watershed water simulation; step 4: performing disaster loss assessment; the invention aims to provide a watershed water simulation method considering comprehensive utilization requirements of reservoir dispatching, which is used for completing watershed water simulation of a dispatching scheme with comprehensive utilization requirements of multiple aspects such as cascade reservoir flood control, water resources, sediment, emergency, ecology and the like, realizing visual display and deduction of the simulation of a reservoir dispatching process, and facilitating decision making and dispatching scheme evaluation analysis of users.

title_en: Method for evaluating tunnel damage under fire disaster-explosion based on object particle method
abstract_en: The invention provides a fire disaster-explosion tunnel damage assessment method based on an object point method. The method utilizes a material point method program to simulate the post-fire explosion effect in the tunnel, considers the fire high-temperature effect in the tunnel by adopting a mode of reducing the compressive strength and the elastic modulus of a concrete lining structure, establishes the material point method program on the basis of the material point method program, introduces HJC constitutive model to the material point method source program, simulates the large deformation and dynamic response of the concrete under the action of fire-explosion impact, outputs a structural damage factor cloud picture of the tunnel structure after explosion disaster, draws a damage degree grade picture of the tunnel structure under the fire-explosion, determines the damage degree grade of the tunnel structure under the fire-explosion, provides theoretical support for determining the key index of the fire-explosion chain disaster, and provides support for the emergency response of the facility chain disaster on the underground foundation.

title_en: System for realizing accurate insurance application, verification and claim settlement and working method thereof
abstract_en: The invention discloses a system for realizing accurate insurance application, verification and claim settlement and a working method thereof. And the rear end of the farmer land parcel management subsystem is simultaneously and respectively connected with a land parcel management system and a farmer management system. The advantage of this patent lies in: 1. the system can better store data into the database, is convenient to search, easy to store, not easy to make mistakes and high in efficiency; 2. the actual land area of the peasant household can be accurately determined in the underwriting link, and accurate underwriting is carried out; 3. during verification, specific land positions of farmers are definitely known, and the authenticity of verification is ensured; 4. clearly knowing the land position of the farmer during surveying and damage assessment, thereby ensuring that the disaster-affected land parcel belongs to the farmer; 5. effectively avoids the situations of false underwriting, false mark verification and false risk emergence.
assignees: BEIJING STAR SCALE SCIENCE AND TECH LIMITED COMPANY

title_en: Optimization algorithm-based method and device for inverting time course of structural displacement under earthquake
abstract_en: The application relates to an optimization algorithm-based method and device for time-course inversion of structure displacement under earthquake, and the method comprises the following steps: acquiring basic structure information of an actual structure under an earthquake, acquiring actual measurement response of the actual structure under the earthquake, and equating the actual structure to a calculation model and structural parameters of the calculation model based on the basic structure information; determining an optimization strategy according to the type and the number of the actually measured responses, and calculating the error of the structural parameters of the calculation model based on the optimization strategy; determining the optimal structure parameters of the calculation model by adopting a preset optimization mode with the error minimization as a target; and inputting the ground acceleration time course into a calculation model represented by optimal structure parameters, calculating to obtain each layer of displacement time course as the displacement time course of the actual structure, and further evaluating the structural damage. Therefore, the problems of non-uniform structural seismic damage assessment standards, strong subjectivity and the like are solved, objective, scientific and efficient seismic damage emergency assessment is realized, and the method is favorable for properly arranging disaster victims after the earthquake and maintaining the stability of social order.

title_en: Steam cloud explosion damage assessment method
abstract_en: The invention discloses a vapor cloud explosion disaster damage assessment method, which can estimate a disaster damage range through an explosion intensity curve and an influence degree, can quickly acquire the lateral overpressure of an explosion wave peak value at different distances, quantitatively assess the injury of personnel and the damage of buildings, evacuate personnel in time, reduce the loss of lives and properties caused by accidents to the minimum, and can calculate the distance between a target position and the center of a gas explosion source through the lateral overpressure of the explosion wave peak value and assess the explosion wave coverage range.

title_en: IMU-based method for monitoring and evaluating damage state of anti-seismic support and hanger
abstract_en: The invention relates to an IMU-based damage state monitoring and evaluating method for an anti-seismic support and hanger, which comprises the following steps: 1) building an earthquake-resistant support and hanger damage monitoring device, and preprocessing after acquiring response data of each component of the earthquake-resistant support and hanger through an IMU (inertial measurement Unit); 2) selecting a first acquisition interval after the anti-seismic support and hanger is installed and before the anti-seismic support and hanger is formally put into use, and calculating a statistical characteristic value V in a normal state through time sequence response data of IMUs (inertial measurement units) of all measuring points  0  (ii) a 3) In the formal use stage of the anti-seismic support hanger, a second acquisition interval is selected, and the statistical characteristic value V in the damage state is calculated by utilizing the time sequence response data of the IMU of each measuring point  1  (ii) a 4) Calculating the relative variation RV of all the statistical characteristic values; 5) selecting damage sensitivity indexes of the final support and hanger; 6) and carrying out damage assessment on the anti-seismic support and hanger. Compared with the prior art, the hair conditionerObviously, response data of three-direction six-degree-of-freedom of the measuring points are utilized, damage sensitive indexes of the support and hanger are enriched, and comprehensive evaluation on the damage state of the support and hanger is achieved.

title_en: Mine border-crossing mining ecological environment damage assessment system and method
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of environmental damage assessment, in particular to a mine border-crossing mining ecological environment damage assessment system and a method thereof, wherein the system comprises a natural resource damage assessment module, a natural resource damage assessment module and a data processing module, wherein the natural resource damage assessment module is used for assessing reduction, disappearance and irreversible damage of various natural resources caused by mine mining; the natural environment damage evaluation module is used for evaluating the damage of pollution damage of various natural environments caused by mining; the human resource damage assessment module is used for assessing damage of various human resources caused by mining; the human environment damage assessment module is used for assessing damage of various human environments caused by mining; and the secondary disaster evaluation module is used for evaluating damage caused by various secondary disasters caused by mining. The method can effectively acquire the relevant data information of the surrounding environment of the mine, so that the economic loss caused by ecological damage and environmental pollution can be quantitatively evaluated.
assignees: SOUTH CHINA INST OF ENVIRONMENTAL SCIENCES MEE ECOLOGY AND ENVIRONMENT EMERGENCY INST OF ECOLOGY AND

title_en: Disaster damage assessment system for disaster-affected area
abstract_en: The invention discloses a disaster damage evaluation system of a disaster area, which relates to the technical field of disaster evaluation and comprises a data statistics module, a space operation module, a quantitative analysis module and a visual expression module, wherein the disaster damage evaluation system of the disaster area counts disaster factors through the statistics module, the minimum administrative division data is calculated through a space operation module, the corresponding economic loss and the disaster population are calculated through a quantitative analysis module, then carrying out calculation and verification again, so that the system can automatically carry out disaster damage real-time assessment work, influence ground feature statistics work and vector data return work on the designated area, the assessment system supports the functions of mining analysis, data statistics, space operation, quantitative analysis and visual expression, and the method is not limited to a certain disaster or a certain specific area, and can meet the use and implementation requirements of various application scenes.

title_en: Python-based long-period spectrum intensity calculation method
abstract_en: The invention discloses a method for calculating the intensity of a long-period spectrum based on Python. The invention comprises the following three steps: the method comprises the following steps of (1) preprocessing seismic acceleration data: processing earthquake motion acceleration data obtained by monitoring all stations after earthquake; (2) Adjusting the upper limit time range and the lower limit time range of a spectrum intensity function formula to be 0.1 s-10.1 s, and calculating the integral value of a relative velocity response spectrum in the range; (3) And calculating the long-period spectrum intensity value according to the different range classification tables of the spectrum intensity. The spectrum intensity long period calculation method provided by the invention can rapidly calculate intensity values near the station based on strong earthquake records of different stations, the intensity values obtained by different stations are stored in a point data mode, then a large amount of station intensity point data are subjected to interpolation processing by using a common Kriging interpolation method, so that a spectrum intensity distribution diagram can be drawn, intensity distribution conditions of a severe earthquake region can be clearly checked, and data preparation is prepared for subsequent casualties and economic loss assessment.

title_en: Building earthquake damage assessment method based on non-structural member damage identification under video monitoring
abstract_en: The invention discloses a building earthquake damage assessment method based on non-structural component damage identification under video monitoring, belonging to the technical field of earthquake engineering; the method comprises the following steps: acquiring an image of the whole process of damage and destruction of a non-structural component in a public building before and after an earthquake occurs, and dividing a monitoring video into video frames before, during and after the earthquake occurs; carrying out target detection, identification classification and positioning on a non-structural component in a video picture before the occurrence of the earthquake; carrying out target tracking on the successfully identified non-structural components on a video picture in the earthquake occurrence process; identifying and judging the earthquake response and damage states of various non-structural components for the video pictures after the earthquake occurs; and summarizing the damage state information of various non-structural components, and judging the seismic damage loss degree of the non-structural system in the building. The invention utilizes the video monitoring system which is popularized and distributed in the urban public building to identify the earthquake damage of the non-structural component through the video picture, thereby effectively evaluating the earthquake damage degree in the building.

title_en: Hub for automated recovery after a critical event in shared mobility services
abstract_en: Systems and methods are disclosed for using a hub to automate recovery after a critical event during shared mobility services. One method may include, receiving, by a computing device and from a user device, a notification of a critical event during a shared mobility service; receiving natural language input associated with a first aspect of the critical event; parsing the natural language input and identifying a first value corresponding to the first aspect; determining, based on the first value, a second aspect (e.g., severity of damage) of the critical event; requesting the user device to send images of the second aspect; after receiving the images, determining a second value corresponding to the second aspect; generating, by the computing device and via a user interface of the user device, a representation of the critical event; receiving, from the user device, an approval of the representation; and generating a damage assessment.

title_en: Method for quickly evaluating efficiency damage of traffic network under influence of flood disasters
abstract_en: The invention discloses a method for quickly evaluating the efficiency damage of a traffic network under the influence of flood disasters, which comprises the steps of obtaining a rainfall prediction result; extracting the flooding range of the flood; establishing a geological disaster risk background field of a rainfall area within a flooding range; judging a disaster area affected by the flood disaster and a result of the disaster area affected by the flood disaster; and performing fusion analysis on the result of the affected area by the flood disaster and the traffic network data to acquire the scale and degree information of road damage and obstruction of the affected area caused by the flood disaster. The invention provides a post-disaster emergency disposal method of 'short-term weather forecast, flood risk assessment, geological disaster assessment and traffic damage assessment', organizes experts in various industries such as meteorology, disasters and traffic based on acquired disaster information, cooperatively develops emergency consultation, fully exerts professional advantages, strengthens prediction and analysis of disaster chain processes, makes a post-disaster emergency plan and submits the post-disaster emergency plan to a competent department for decision making.

title_en: Agricultural meteorological insurance loss assessment method, system, storage medium and equipment
abstract_en: The invention provides an agricultural meteorological insurance damage assessment method, system, storage medium and equipment, which comprises the steps of evaluating the disaster degree of crops corresponding to meteorological elements according to meteorological data of a plurality of meteorological elements; constructing a meteorological index set according to meteorological data and disaster degree, and constructing a model based on the meteorological index set and the yield loss rate to obtain a loss model between the meteorological index and the yield loss rate; and acquiring meteorological data of the target crops, and inputting the meteorological data of the target crops into the loss model to obtain the loss rate of the target crops. According to the agricultural meteorological insurance damage assessment method, the agricultural meteorological insurance damage assessment system, the agricultural meteorological insurance storage medium and the agricultural meteorological insurance damage assessment equipment, a meteorological index set is established according to meteorological data and disaster types, a damage model is established according to the meteorological index set and the yield loss rate, the disaster degree of various meteorological disaster types in the past year is assessed, and the reliability of meteorological insurance is provided.

title_en: Agricultural meteorological disaster dynamic monitoring and yield loss assessment system
abstract_en: A dynamic monitoring and yield loss assessment system for agricultural meteorological disasters belongs to the technical field of agricultural information intelligent analysis, and comprises a monitoring rod, a high-definition camera, an integrated meteorological five-element monitor, a photovoltaic panel storage battery, a rainfall sensor, a soil temperature and humidity sensor, a weak current box, a 4G router and a hard disk video recorder; the high-definition camera is arranged on the top of the monitoring rod; the integrated meteorological five-element monitor and the rainfall sensor are arranged on the monitoring rod; the weak current box is arranged on the monitoring rod, and the 4G router and the hard disk video recorder are both arranged in the weak current box; the photovoltaic panel is arranged on the monitoring rod, and a photovoltaic panel storage battery is arranged on the photovoltaic panel; the soil temperature and humidity sensor is buried in the soil. The method is used for monitoring meteorological conditions and meteorological disasters by agricultural farmers in the crop growth process, giving early warning to the meteorological disasters in real time, and storing disaster-suffering conditions in a video image mode, so that the farmers can resist disasters in time, save themselves and settle claims in later period conveniently.
assignees: JILIN PROVINCE ZHONGNONG SUNSHINE DATA CO LTD

title_en: Method for detecting and attributing influence of climate change and human activities on low water flow
abstract_en: The invention provides a method for detecting and attributing influences of climate change and human activities on low water flow, which comprises the following steps: collecting runoff index observation data representing low flow and influence factor data thereof, and preprocessing the data; detecting the runoff trend by adopting a Sen's slope detection method; simulating runoff by using a machine learning support vector machine model; evaluating the performance of a support vector machine model, and comparing the simulated runoff with the actual measurement runoff and the simulated runoff trend with the actual measurement runoff trend; through a control experiment and a sensitivity experiment, the time sequence of the influence factor is subjected to trend elimination, and the specific contribution of the influence factor to the runoff is quantitatively identified; and (4) introducing a full differential expansion method based on multiple linear regression to calculate the influence factor contribution. The method can quantitatively identify the influence of the climate change and the human activities on the global low water flow, is beneficial to scientifically understanding the action process of the climate change and the human activities on the global drought evolution, and can provide theoretical reference for global water resource management and flood and drought damage assessment.

title_en: Forest fire detection early warning and decision-making system based on sky-ground integration technology
abstract_en: The invention discloses a forest fire detection, early warning and decision-making system based on a sky-ground integrated technology, which relates to the technical field of forest fire detection, early warning and decision-making systems and comprises the following steps: the fire prevention command center is used for managing and controlling, the unmanned aerial vehicle patrols and examines monitoring management module for the processing transmission of unmanned aerial vehicle control and picture, the forest protection house, the management of setting up a point and protecting high definition network camera. Based on forest area basic geographic data, forestry thematic data, satellite remote sensing data and DEM data, various monitoring data such as unmanned aircraft inspection data, base station video monitoring data, forest protection personnel inspection data, meteorological data and the like are combined to build an emergency comprehensive command system with one network and one platform, so that the whole process of pre-disaster, in-disaster and post-disaster dynamic management and control with high integration of forest fire daily monitoring, fire point quick positioning, fire suppression command decision making and disaster loss assessment under a three-dimensional scene are realized, and early prevention and early rescue of forest fires are realized.
assignees: SICHUAN KERUIYUAN INFORMATION TECH CO LTD

title_en: Method for rapidly evaluating damage assessment of forest fire based on block chain
abstract_en: The invention provides a method for rapidly evaluating damage assessment of forest fires based on a block chain. The method comprises the following steps: after a forest fire happens, the unmanned aerial vehicle rapidly starts to go to an accident site and takes a picture of the fire site in a picture taking mode to obtain evidence, the picture taken back is utilized, calculation of the site burnt area and identification of trees are completed through a computer modeling and machine learning mode, the compensation pricing standard of the local corresponding trees is obtained from a credible price bureau platform through a price prediction machine, the whole disaster damage can be calculated, meanwhile, the picture, the identification result, price of the price bureau and a final report are simultaneously stored on a block chain, and evidence solidification is carried out. Compared with the existing method for manually counting the loss quantity, the method for counting the loss quantity is used for contacting with the commodity price department to determine the loss after data is summarized, and the efficiency and the transparency are greatly improved and promoted.

title_en: Agricultural disaster information remote sensing extraction loss evaluation method based on Internet of things
abstract_en: The invention discloses an agricultural disaster information remote sensing extraction loss assessment method based on the Internet of things, and relates to the technical field of crop disaster situation assessment. The invention comprises the following steps: shooting remote sensing images of crops in a plurality of areas before and after a disaster; acquiring an NDVI interpolation graph before and after a disaster, extracting disaster features of the interpolation graph and training a disaster identification module; carrying out remote sensing image acquisition on crops, and determining a crop area to be investigated; the method comprises the steps of inputting a crop area to be investigated into a disaster recognition module, outputting a predicted disaster trend by the disaster recognition module, and evaluating the grade of the disaster on remote sensing image data.

title_en: Method for evaluating damage of ground objects in disaster scene of offline training and online learning
abstract_en: The invention relates to a disaster scene ground object damage assessment method based on an offline training-online learning framework, which is used for rapidly and accurately assessing the damage of ground objects in a multi-disaster scene and supporting disaster emergency response application. Continuously aligning the statistical characteristic distribution of the model in the unknown region and the unknown disaster data through an offline training-online learning frame, and overcoming the problem of distribution drift caused by the unknown region and the unknown disaster; an end-to-end multitask pre-disaster ground object extraction and post-disaster damage assessment depth network model is designed, pre-disaster ground object region extraction and post-disaster ground object damage assessment are integrated together in a differentiable mode, and the problem that a traditional damage assessment model cannot simultaneously achieve end-to-end training, reasoning and target consistency prediction is solved. The method can solve the problems that the existing model is difficult to generalize to unknown areas, unknown disaster species, inconsistent evaluation target semantics and the like, and effectively supports accurate minute-level rapid emergency response of urban disasters.

title_en: Remote sensing disaster scene mapping method based on hierarchical dense architecture search
abstract_en: The invention relates to a mapping method for remote sensing disaster scenes based on hierarchical dense architecture search, which is used for ground surface coverage mapping and damage assessment of complex and multiple disaster scenes and assists disaster emergency response and decision. Designing an efficient hierarchical dense architecture searching framework, combining the existing various depth encoders in the searching stage, adaptively optimizing the architecture parameters of a multi-scale dense decoder so as to meet the efficient fusion of various disaster-affected ground features of the current scene, and decoding the optimal decoding architecture through breadth-first; in the training stage, efficient model training is realized by migrating the model parameters of the depth encoder and jointly searching the obtained decoding structure. The invention can solve the problems of high design difficulty, high time cost and the like of a network architecture of a complex disaster scene, does not need to manually design a deep interpretation architecture, and can realize high-efficiency full automation from data to interpretation results in the face of various disasters or other complex scenes.

title_en: GIS fuzzy analysis-based power transmission line seismic loss assessment method
abstract_en: The invention discloses a power transmission line seismic loss assessment method based on GIS fuzzy analysis, which is characterized by comprising the following steps: establishing an importance function of power transmission line corridor equipment; performing refined space simulation; acquiring the visualized number of geological influence factors of the transmission line corridor after earthquake; the conventional rasterization method represents data of each layer, and acquires a power transmission equipment information matrix possibly affected in a power grid system; determining a membership function; and calculating the influence degree of the power transmission line on the region after the geological disaster occurs by solving the fuzzy comprehensive evaluation index. According to the power transmission line earthquake loss assessment method, through correlation analysis of historical earthquake disasters and influences of power transmission equipment, disaster dynamic assessment is carried out by combining real-time tide data of the power transmission line, auxiliary decision support for emergency disaster relief of a power grid can be provided, and compared with the prior art, accuracy and effectiveness are improved, so that the disaster resistance response level of the power grid is improved, and the later engineering investment cost is reduced.

title_en: Basic emergency management mobile intelligent series platform and equipment
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of intelligent emergency management, and discloses a basic emergency management mobile intelligent series platform and equipment, which comprise a primary management platform, a secondary management platform and a tertiary management platform which are communicated with each other; the first-level management platform, the second-level management platform and the third-level management platform are all provided with a scene monitoring system, a command communication system, a rescue management system, a propaganda warning system and a post-disaster disposal management system; the scene monitoring system is used for monitoring and collecting disaster accident information; the rescue management system is used for comprehensively counting and updating rescue reserve information of each block of the base layer; the command communication system is used for intelligently managing disaster accidents and commanding rescue; the propaganda warning system is used for commanding personnel to conduct propaganda plan drilling; the post-disaster treatment management system is used for performing post-disaster damage assessment and generating post-disaster reconstruction suggestions. The invention can provide a dynamic, reliable and systematic intelligent emergency management scheme, and achieves a better emergency management effect.

title_en: Support steel frame design parameter selection method based on fatigue life prediction
abstract_en: The invention relates to a method for selecting design parameters of a support steel frame based on fatigue life prediction, which comprises the following steps: the method comprises the steps of supporting rods and two gusset plates, wherein two ends of the supporting rods are respectively fixed on a steel beam and a steel column through one gusset plate, and the method comprises the following steps: simulating a stress-strain field at a damage key position of the supporting steel frame according to the existing supporting steel frame, and obtaining relevant design parameters of the supporting rod and the gusset plate; calculating a low cycle fatigue life equation of the support rod; calculating a low cycle fatigue life equation of a gusset plate corresponding to the support rod; determining selection parameters of the supporting steel frame; the method is based on experimental analysis data and numerical simulation data and obtained through statistics, has higher accuracy and comprehensive consideration factors, provides a theoretical basis for low-cycle fatigue damage assessment and life prediction of the central support frame, and can be used for the safety evaluation work of the earthquake-resistant design of the support frame.

title_en: System and method for wildfire risk assessment, mitigation and monitoring for building structures
abstract_en: There is a system and method for wildfire loss assessment for a building structure, or a set of building structures, comprising obtaining a building structure dataset; receiving, by a computer system, computer-readable input data regarding one or more fuel sources, in the proximity of the building structure location, that may cause the building structure to ignite; correlating and combining the building structure dataset with the fuel source dataset; determining, by the computer system, an ignition potential for the building structure based on the one or more fuel sources; and outputting a report of the ignition potential for the building structure.

title_en: Damage estimation device, damage estimation program and damage estimation method
abstract_en: To reduce the effect of congestion of a communication line while enabling the degree of sustained damage due to earthquake vibration to be estimated with good accuracy.SOLUTION: A damage estimation device according to the present invention comprises: a data acquisition unit for acquiring first earthquake vibration data which, generated using an earthquake sensor, indicates a physical quantity regarding an earthquake vibration in a first direction along the ground surface, and acquiring second earthquake vibration data which, generated using the earthquake sensor, indicates a physical quantity regarding the earthquake vibration in a second direction along the ground surface which is different from the first direction; and a unidimensional spectrum calculation unit for calculating a first spectrum in the first direction using the first earthquake vibration data, calculating a second spectrum in the second direction using the second earthquake vibration data, calculating a unidirectional spectrum using the first and second spectra, and generating unidirectional spectrum data that indicates the unidirectional spectrum.SELECTED DRAWING: Figure 2
assignees: ASAHI KASEI CORP;ASAHI KASEI HOMES CO

title_en: Method for evaluating indirect damage of disaster
abstract_en: The invention discloses a disaster indirect loss assessment method, which comprehensively considers the influence of the supply and the demand of fixed assets such as house plant equipment, traffic infrastructure and the like on each industry of an economic system after the fixed assets are damaged due to a disaster and a large number of people are damaged due to the disaster and cannot participate in production service, dynamically assesses the continuous indirect loss suffered by the economic system from the occurrence of the disaster to the complete completion of recovery and reconstruction, and monitors the recovery characteristics of the economic system in a disaster area in the post-disaster recovery and reconstruction period, thereby better improving the formulation of post-disaster emergency rescue and recovery and reconstruction strategies. The comprehensiveness and accuracy of natural disaster economic loss evaluation can be improved in mechanism, indirect disaster economic loss evaluation is supplemented, and the absolute value risk of the disaster is quantitatively represented by the height of economic loss. The invention can make the determination of the disaster insurance premium of the insurance industry more scientific and reasonable, and can promote the development of the disaster insurance industry to a certain extent.

title_en: Building earthquake damage assessment method based on unmanned aerial vehicle and semantic segmentation model
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of civil engineering structure health assessment and disaster prevention and reduction, in particular to a building earthquake damage assessment method based on an unmanned aerial vehicle and a semantic segmentation model, aiming at providing a building earthquake damage assessment method based on the unmanned aerial vehicle and the semantic segmentation model, and mainly solving the following problems: the problem that the existing semantic segmentation model has low segmentation precision on multi-scale and view-angle-shielded targets in unmanned aerial vehicle images and occupies large hardware resources is solved; the beneficial effects are as follows: the unmanned aerial vehicle building earthquake damage assessment model provided by the invention occupies a small memory, and is only 80% of a reference model; the improved model has higher precision which can reach 91.4 percent and is improved by 5.5 percent compared with a reference model.

title_en: Method for determining cotton seedling stage strong wind disaster weather index insurance rate
abstract_en: The invention discloses a method for determining the insurance rate of the weather index of a cotton seedling stage gale disaster, which belongs to the technical field of agricultural insurance, wherein the agricultural weather index insurance is an innovative insurance product different from the traditional insurance based on damage claim, and the method can be used for paying by comparing the weather index value on the final date of the insurance period with the reference value determined in an insurance contract according to the set weather index insurance, and can relieve the problem of market failure of the agricultural insurance to a certain extent without taking the actual loss of a specific insurance subject matter as the payment standard. Compared with other insurance products, the meteorological index insurance has the advantages of simple claim settlement, easy moral risk control, risk dispersion and the like.
assignees: WULAN WUSU AGRICULTURAL METEOROLOGICAL TEST STATION;Xinjiang Xingnong Network Information Center

title_en: Earthquake economic loss evaluation method and device, electronic equipment and storage medium
abstract_en: The application provides a method and a device for evaluating economic loss of earthquake, electronic equipment and a storage medium, wherein the method comprises the following steps: after the earthquake occurs, carrying out numerical simulation on the earthquake to obtain an intensity distribution numerical value of the earthquake; according to population distribution data of earthquake occurrence places, performing spatial integration on population distribution data in different intensity ranges to obtain population exposure numbers in different intensity distribution numerical ranges; inputting the population exposure number and the per capita fixed assets of the earthquake occurrence area in different intensity distribution numerical ranges into a regional economic loss evaluation model, and evaluating to obtain an economic loss evaluation value of the earthquake occurrence area; the regional economic loss assessment model is constructed on the basis of an earthquake disaster database, a regional sub-region and a provincial fixed asset database. The scheme can rapidly evaluate the economic loss range, the mathematical expected value and the spatial distribution after the earthquake occurs, and the evaluation result is more accurate.

title_en: SAR building earthquake damage estimation method based on texture features
abstract_en: The invention discloses a SAR building earthquake damage estimation method based on texture features, which comprises the steps of firstly importing original full-polarization synthetic aperture radar (PolSAR) data for preprocessing, carrying out polarization decomposition on the full-polarization synthetic aperture radar data by using an improved Yamaguchi four-component decomposition (IYFD) method, extracting a secondary scattering component and a volume scattering component, classifying to-be-identified ground objects in a full-polarization synthetic aperture radar image corresponding to the secondary scattering component into parallel perfect buildings, calculating SPAN images of the extracted full-polarization synthetic aperture radar data according to a formula, and calculating MSD values of the full-polarization synthetic aperture radar data according to the formula; compared with the traditional polarization decomposition method, the method has the advantages that more than half of sound buildings are successfully separated from the mixed ground objects of the collapsed buildings, so that not only is the high enough damaged building identification precision ensured, but also the high correct identification precision of the sound buildings is ensured, and the building earthquake damage estimation precision and reliability are greatly improved.

title_en: High arch dam earthquake damage assessment method and system based on finite element model correction
abstract_en: The invention discloses a high arch dam earthquake damage assessment method and system based on finite element model correction, the method comprises the steps of firstly obtaining working modal parameters of an arch dam through arch dam prototype vibration response calculation, establishing a three-dimensional finite element model of the arch dam-reservoir-foundation system, and optimizing and updating the parameters of the finite element model through modal parameter identification values; secondly, applying boundary conditions to the corrected finite element model based on the viscoelastic artificial boundary, and simulating seismic oscillation input at different incident angles by adopting equivalent node force; and finally, simulating the damage and cracking of the concrete dam body by using the concrete plastic damage constitutive model, and carrying out power time course analysis on the arch dam-reservoir-foundation three-dimensional finite element correction model to obtain the damage result of the high arch dam under different vibration incidence angles. The method constructs a finite element model reflecting the real dynamic characteristics, effectively reduces the error of the finite element model of the high arch dam, and quantitatively evaluates the damage of the high arch dam under different vibration incidence angles.

title_en: Disaster information managing and providing system
abstract_en: To provide a disaster information managing and providing system capable of grasping an accurate disaster situation at a site.SOLUTION: A disaster information managing and providing system includes: a seismic intensity information acquisition unit 26 for acquiring seismic intensity information around a building from published seismic intensity distribution information; a precipitation acquisition unit 24 for acquiring precipitation around the building from published observed information of precipitation; a flood inundation distribution acquisition unit 25 for acquiring ambient inundation information around the building from a published flood hazard map; an inundation determination unit 27 for acquiring presence or absence of inundation and a water level at the time of inundation around the building as local inundation information from image information captured by a fixed point camera installed in the building; a building earthquake damage estimation unit 29 for estimating an earthquake damage degree of the building based on building information and seismic intensity information; and an inundation risk degree determination unit 28 for determining a risk degree of inundation based on the precipitation, the ambient inundation information, and the local inundation information.SELECTED DRAWING: Figure 7

title_en: Forest fire investigation damage assessment method based on spectral characteristics
abstract_en: The invention discloses a forest fire investigation damage assessment method based on spectral features, which adopts a spectral features and image color space conversion method to extract fire spots, after forest fires occur, absorption peaks of vegetation red light wave bands disappear, remote sensing reflectivity is enhanced, vegetation and non-vegetation pixels can be distinguished by combining the features, the accurate extraction of post-disaster areas is realized, the color space commonly used in life is RGB color display, the HSV color space can intuitively display the hue H, the saturation S and the brightness V of an image, is more suitable for image processing, commonly used for dividing objects with specified colors, the problem that fire and non-fire boundaries cannot be accurately distinguished is extracted for vegetation after fires based on the spectral features, the HSV color space can independently process color tone values without influencing the saturation and the brightness, and the problem that boundary pixel extraction is difficult can be solved by combining the points.

title_en: Post-earthquake building damage assessment method for emergency rescue
abstract_en: The disclosure relates to the field of earthquake disaster assessment, in particular to a post-earthquake building damage assessment method for emergency rescue, which comprises the following steps: preprocessing the obtained historical post-earthquake positive photographic images with the building damage class labels to obtain a training data set; building a building damage classification model based on a building reinforcement feature extraction neural network, wherein in the reinforcement feature extraction network, a feature reinforcement module and two auxiliary monitoring modules are designed, an encoder unit of a semantic segmentation network module is connected with a first auxiliary monitoring module through the feature reinforcement module, a second auxiliary monitoring module is connected with the penultimate layer in a decoder unit of the semantic segmentation network module, and a training data set training model is utilized to obtain a trained building damage classification model; inputting the image to be evaluated into a trained building damage classification model, and outputting the post-earthquake building damage classification for emergency rescue. By utilizing the method disclosed by the invention, the accuracy of the damage assessment result of the post-earthquake building is improved.
assignees: UNIV CHINA GEOSCIENCES WUHAN;NAT EARTHQUAKE RESPONSE SUPPORT SERVICE

title_en: Third industry economic loss assessment method and device for drought disasters
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of disaster damage assessment, in particular to a third industrial economic damage assessment method and device for drought disasters, wherein the method comprises the following steps: dividing economic loss of drought disasters to the third industry into economic loss of the drought disasters to the third industry under a non-control scene and economic loss of the drought disasters to the third industry under a control scene; calculating the total amount of economic losses of a first potential third industry caused by drought disasters in a non-control scene; calculating the total amount of economic losses of a second potential third industry caused by drought disasters in a control scene; and calculating potential economic losses after control according to the total amount of the first potential third industrial economic losses and the total amount of the second potential third industrial economic losses. By the technical scheme, the third industrial economic loss of drought disasters can be effectively and objectively evaluated in real time.
assignees: INST OF ENVIRONMENT AND SUSTAINABLE DEVELOPMENT IN AGRICULTURE CHINESE ACADEMY OF AGRICULTURAL SCIEN

title_en: Method, system, electronic equipment and medium for evaluating disaster damage of aquaculture area
abstract_en: The invention discloses a method, a system, electronic equipment and a medium for evaluating disaster damage of an aquaculture area, and relates to the field of disaster damage evaluation of the aquaculture area; the method comprises the steps of extracting a first aquaculture area image and a second aquaculture area image of an aquaculture flooded disaster coverage area before the occurrence of the flooded disaster and a third aquaculture area image after the occurrence of the flooded disaster according to images, respectively calculating connectivity of each aquaculture area in the second aquaculture area image and each aquaculture area in the third aquaculture area image according to the first aquaculture area image by using a connectivity algorithm, comparing the connectivity of each aquaculture area in the second aquaculture area image with the connectivity of each aquaculture area in the third aquaculture area image, and determining damage evaluation results of each aquaculture area. The method and the device improve the accuracy of damage assessment of the aquaculture pond by improving the extraction accuracy of the aquaculture pond.

title_en: Natural disaster economic loss assessment method and device
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of disaster prediction, in particular to a natural disaster economic loss assessment method and a device, wherein the method comprises the following steps: calculating the influence of natural disasters on each industry by adopting a dynamic CGE model, and acquiring the influence coefficient of the natural disasters on each industry every day; counting influence coefficients of natural disasters on various industries within a preset time period, taking days as an X axis, taking the influence coefficients as a Y axis, and establishing a multiple linear regression model; and predicting the time point when the influence degree of the natural disasters on the total social economic loss value is reduced or aggravated according to the multiple linear regression model. By the technical scheme, quantitative evaluation of influence of natural disasters on the total industrial economic loss value is realized, and evaluation efficiency and accuracy are improved.
assignees: INST OF ENVIRONMENT AND SUSTAINABLE DEVELOPMENT IN AGRICULTURE CHINESE ACADEMY OF AGRICULTURAL SCIEN

title_en: Earthquake damage estimation method
abstract_en: To provide an earthquake damage estimation method capable of determining whether or not a train stopped between stations after an earthquake can move to the next station based on information on earthquake ground motion experienced in the past and no damage.SOLUTION: An earthquake damage estimation method includes: a section identification step of dividing a kilometrage which is a distance from a route starting point of a railway line into predetermined sections; an information aggregating step of aggregating seismic motion information and information on the presence or absence of damage for the section when an earthquake occurs; a score calculation step of calculating a safety factor score from the information aggregated in the information aggregation step; and a determination step of determining whether or not inspection of the route in the section is necessary on the basis of the safety factor score when a new earthquake occurs.SELECTED DRAWING: Figure 1

title_en: Quick population loss assessment method based on occurrence probability of earthquake landslide
abstract_en: The invention relates to a population loss rapid evaluation method based on occurrence probability of an earthquake landslide, which comprises the steps of constructing a common-earthquake landslide database corresponding to a typical earthquake by adopting an artificial visual interpretation method, constructing a multi-factor influence model of occurrence of the earthquake landslide by adopting a machine learning method, obtaining weights of all continuous factors and weights of all classifications of classification factors, calculating occurrence probability of earthquake-induced landslide of a detected area under different earthquake intensities by adopting the multi-factor influence model of occurrence of the earthquake landslide, constructing a population loss prediction model based on the occurrence probability of the earthquake-induced landslide, and further calculating population loss data caused by the common-earthquake landslide of future sudden earthquake events. According to the method, through the method for constructing the database and the evaluation model of the landslide of the occurred earthquake, the probability of landslide caused by sudden earthquake in the area to be measured is rapidly obtained, and the population loss caused by landslide of the earthquake is estimated by using an optimized buried pressure model in combination with population density distribution data of the area to be measured.
assignees: THE NATIONAL NATURAL DISASTER PREVENTION AND CONTROL RES INSTITUTE OF EMERGENCY MANAGEMENT DEPARTMEN

title_en: Method and system suitable for rapid collaborative evaluation of earthquake disasters in black box period
abstract_en: The application provides a method and a system for rapid collaborative evaluation of earthquake disasters suitable for a black box period, wherein the method comprises the following steps: acquiring seismic industry data from a seismic industry system and acquiring various other industry data from other industry systems; performing disaster rapid collaborative assessment by utilizing the earthquake industry data and the industry data; the disaster rapid collaborative assessment includes disaster area and influence range assessment, casualties assessment and building damage assessment. After the earthquake disaster occurs, the application promotes each other under the condition of information sharing, and aims at rapid collaborative evaluation of the disaster to carry out scientific decision. By utilizing a multimedia computer and a communication technology, various disaster phenomena caused by earthquakes are cooperatively evaluated after the earthquakes by combining the currently available supporting resources so as to achieve the process of maximizing disaster relief efficiency, and scientific and reasonable disaster scale judging results are produced to serve emergency command decisions.

title_en: Substation rainfall flood risk assessment result analysis method and system based on simulation
abstract_en: The technical field of the application mainly comprises the fields of power engineering, hydrology, meteorology, environmental science, risk assessment and the like, and relates to a substation rainfall flood risk assessment result analysis method based on simulation, which comprises the following steps: carrying out storm scene simulation design by using a three-dimensional space digital model, a multi-scale environment data model and a two-dimensional coupling numerical simulation model; drawing a flood distribution map by using a substation rain and flood risk assessment model under different scenes; and after flood risk information interpolation and color matching are completed, the risk map is adjusted and modified. The method solves the problems that in the prior art, the rain and flood risk analysis of the transformer substation depends on manual subjective experience, single means, short plates exist and the like, can provide scientific basis for analysis and formulation of various plans such as flood disaster loss assessment, environmental risk control, flood control transformation and the like of the transformer substation, ensures that the flood disaster management and control of the transformer substation is in a certain vector, and is beneficial to improving the power supply quality.

title_en: Damage evaluation method for reinforced concrete frame structure under earthquake action
abstract_en: The invention discloses a damage assessment model of a reinforced concrete frame structure under the action of an earthquake, which divides a target into a multi-level damage assessment index system according to the characteristics and damage characteristics of the target, constructs a judgment matrix of the index system from top to bottom, calculates the weight occupied by each level of index corresponding to the index of the last level where the index is positioned, selects corresponding quantitative and qualitative judgment standards and calculation methods aiming at the damage characteristics of the lowest level of index under the action of the earthquake, calculates the membership degree of the fuzzy damage corresponding to each lowest level of index quantitatively, calculates the membership degree of various damage of the whole target from bottom to top, and processes the result to obtain a final conclusion.
