The method can quickly and reliably calculate the damage effect of the target structure after the earthquake action, can be adjusted according to the specific condition of the target structure, has flexibility and wide applicability, and is suitable for the prediction and quick calculation of the damage effect under the condition of saving a large amount of manpower and material resources and with less damage information.
assignees: SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL ENG DESIGN INST GROUP CO LTD;UNIV SOUTHEAST

title_en: Disaster damage evaluation system for small and medium-sized span bridges
abstract_en: The application relates to the technical field of bridge disaster damage assessment, and discloses a disaster damage assessment system of a small and medium-sized span bridge, which comprises a server, a data arrangement module, a monitoring sensor, a safety assessment module and an early warning system; the input end of the server is connected with a monitoring sensor and a video acquisition module, the input end of the data arrangement module is connected with the output end of the server, the output end of the data arrangement module is connected with a damage prediction module, and the output end of the damage prediction module is connected with a comparison analysis module. According to the application, the disaster damage calculation module is arranged to calculate and predict the direct loss of the bridge after disaster through various data and parameters, and the monitoring sensor, the safety evaluation module and the like are arranged to monitor various parameters after bridge repair, so that the bridge is convenient to maintain and repair regularly, meanwhile, the indirect cost in the follow-up maintenance and repair can be predicted by means of the monitoring data, and finally, the disaster damage can be accurately and reliably evaluated.
assignees: JIANGSU SUXIN ENG CONSULTATION CO LTD

title_en: Comprehensive control and early warning system for flood disasters of transformer substation
abstract_en: The invention discloses a comprehensive prevention and control early warning system for flood disasters of a transformer substation, which relates to the technical field of disasters and prevention and control early warning and comprises a basic information management unit; a numerical simulation analysis unit; and the rainfall flood risk assessment analysis unit and the two-dimensional three-dimensional visual display analysis unit. The method realizes automatic prediction and early warning of the flood disasters of the transformer substation and automatic assessment of the flood risks of the transformer substation, provides scientific basis for analysis of various plans such as loss assessment, environmental risk control, flood control transformation and the like of the flood disasters of the transformer substation, reduces the influence of the flood disasters on safe and stable operation of the transformer substation, promotes the passive-to-active transition of the flood disaster control of the power grid, comprehensively improves personal safety guarantee capability of companies and supports construction of safe enterprises.

title_en: Post-disaster assessment method and device for power transmission tower pole, computer equipment and storage medium
abstract_en: The embodiment of the application discloses a post-disaster evaluation method for a power transmission tower, which comprises the following steps: after the disaster occurs, the unmanned aerial vehicle flies to the area where the tower pole is located, and image data of the power transmission tower pole after the disaster is obtained; obtaining a first geometric model according to the image data; performing rapid batch damage assessment according to the first geometric model to obtain an assessment result; the evaluation results are damaged or undamaged; and if the evaluation result is damage, carrying out single-point refined damage evaluation on the power transmission tower pole according to the first geometric model to obtain a risk grade, wherein the risk grade is a grade I risk or a grade II risk or a grade III risk.
assignees: YUNNAN POWER GRID CO LTD ELECTRIC POWER RES INST

title_en: Industrial factory building fire risk prediction and loss assessment method and device
abstract_en: The invention discloses a method and a device for predicting fire risk and evaluating loss of an industrial factory building, which relate to the technical field of industrial fire risk and loss evaluation and comprise the following steps: based on the analysis and evaluation of the indoor and outdoor fire potential risks of the industrial factory building; based on the numerical simulation analysis of the indoor and outdoor fires/smoke of the industrial factory building; fire loss assessment based on fire impact range simulation. According to the requirements of industrial parks, purposes, structures, fireproof characteristics and cleanliness of factory buildings, based on a fire numerical simulation equation and combining with technologies such as factory building design, intelligent factory digital management, geographic information systems, space superposition buffer analysis and the like, the invention provides a whole-process whole-flow industrial factory fire risk and loss evaluation model method, a solution and an application tool device for measuring and calculating fire loss according to the burning loss rate, loss range and the like of building equipment after a fire disaster is determined in an indoor and outdoor fire potential risk source evaluation auxiliary determination fire source before the disaster, a numerical simulation prediction smoke and fire spreading area in the disaster.
assignees: AEROSPACE INFORMATION RESEARCH INSTITUTE CHINESE ACADEMY OF SCIENCES

title_en: Vegetation disaster damage assessment method and system
abstract_en: The application discloses a vegetation disaster damage assessment method and a vegetation disaster damage assessment system, wherein the method comprises the following steps: collecting MODIS NDVI data and preprocessing to obtain NDVI 16d data; generating NDVI data of a preset time period based on the NDVI 16d data; calculating FVC data, NPP data and QI data of a preset time period based on the NDVI data; acquiring weather disaster indexes in a preset time period based on daily air temperature and precipitation data; and carrying out disaster damage assessment by using a vegetation ecological disaster damage assessment model based on the vegetation ecological quality index and the meteorological disaster index. The application reflects the influence and strength of a single weather disaster on vegetation ecology by constructing the comprehensive model coupled with the weather disaster index and the vegetation parameter. Meanwhile, the loss rate is utilized to quantify the disaster-caused loss of the vegetation, namely, the influence of various meteorological disasters on vegetation ecology and the intensity are comprehensively reflected.

title_en: Quantitative evaluation method for radar remote sensing building earthquake damage based on polarization characteristic parameters
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of earthquake damage assessment, in particular to a radar remote sensing building earthquake damage quantitative assessment method based on novel polarization characteristic parameters, which comprises the following steps of carrying out polarization decomposition on preprocessed post-earthquake full-polarization synthetic aperture radar data by using a Yamaguchi four-component polarization decomposition method, and extracting three scattering components; the method comprises the steps of carrying out polarization decomposition on pre-processed post-earthquake full-polarization synthetic aperture radar data by using a Touzi polarization decomposition method, extracting polarization decomposition parameters, calculating polarization characteristic parameters MRMPT, dividing full-polarization synthetic aperture radar image elements which are obtained by carrying out polarization decomposition on four components of Yamaguchi and are dominant in volume scattering components into collapsed buildings and intact buildings by using MRMPT, carrying out further supplementary identification on the collapsed buildings by using MOSP parameters, selecting a proper threshold value for MOSP, calculating an area comprehensive average earthquake damage index according to a formula, combining earthquake damage grade evaluation requirements, converting and combining the earthquake damage grade evaluation requirements into specified earthquake damage grades, and drawing a building earthquake damage evaluation graph.

title_en: Big data-based ecological system damage assessment method after natural disaster
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the technical field of ecological system damage assessment, and particularly relates to a natural disaster post-ecological system damage assessment method based on big data. The method can help researchers to systematically evaluate damage degree, recovery capability and economic value loss of the ecosystem after natural disasters, has important significance for evaluating the damage degree and the economic value loss of the ecosystem, provides scientific basis for subsequent evaluation of the damage of the ecosystem, provides reliable data support for subsequent analysis and summarization, and provides scientific basis for related decisions.

title_en: Disaster damage claim settlement method, device, equipment and storage medium thereof
abstract_en: The embodiment of the application belongs to the technical field of financial science and technology, and is applied to typhoon disaster damage claim settlement application scenes, and relates to a disaster damage claim settlement method, device, equipment and storage medium thereof.
assignees: CHINA PING AN PROPERTY INSURANCE CO LTD

title_en: Building earthquake damage assessment model for optimizing BP neural network by improved genetic algorithm
abstract_en: The building earthquake damage assessment model for optimizing BP neural network by improving genetic algorithm comprises the following steps: step 1, collecting building earthquake damage data from historical earthquake cases, wherein the building earthquake damage data comprise main influencing factors and damage levels of building earthquake damage; step 2, carrying out digital quantitative representation on the non-digital building earthquake damage data; step 3, carrying out equalization and normalization treatment on the digitized building earthquake damage data to obtain a sample data set; and 4, constructing a back propagation neural network, optimizing the back propagation neural network through an improved genetic algorithm, and constructing a building earthquake damage assessment model. According to the invention, by adopting a nonlinear self-adaptive cross rate and variation rate adjustment method, training individuals are regenerated, the fixed cross rate and variation rate of the traditional genetic algorithm are improved, the generalization capability of the back propagation neural network model is improved, the obtained model output result has good consistency with the actual result, the accuracy is high, and the rapid and accurate assessment of the building earthquake damage can be realized.

title_en: Building earthquake damage intelligent assessment method based on multi-mode large model
abstract_en: The invention discloses an intelligent assessment method for building earthquake damage based on a multi-mode large model, and belongs to the technical field of earthquake engineering; the method comprises the following steps: acquiring a damage picture to construct a multi-mode earthquake damage assessment data set; constructing a multi-mode earthquake damage evaluation large model, optimizing by using an image-text contrast loss function, and outputting a new multi-mode vector representation through a multi-mode encoder; training the multi-mode earthquake damage assessment large model by adopting a data set, and integrating the trained multi-mode earthquake damage assessment large model algorithm into an unmanned plane or a patrol vehicle; and carrying out real-time earthquake damage evaluation on each building on the earthquake disaster site to generate regional building disaster damage evaluation reports. The evaluation method provided by the invention realizes the function of evaluating the damage degree judgment of the building more professionally and accurately by comprehensively utilizing the multi-mode damage pictures and the multiple information sources described by the damage language and combining the deep learning technology, and can provide important technical support for the earthquake disaster emergency rescue work.
assignees: UNIV SICHUAN;CHENGDU XUNHUI TECH CO LTD

title_en: Earthquake indirect economic loss assessment method based on comprehensive disaster index
abstract_en: The application provides an earthquake indirect economic loss assessment method based on comprehensive disaster indexes, which relates to the technical field of earthquake disaster loss assessment, wherein the method comprises the following steps: acquiring public economic data of a seismic area, wherein the public economic data comprises input-output tables and GDP data; acquiring economic loss data of an earthquake region, wherein the economic loss data comprises enterprise outage time and comprehensive disaster indexes; calculating industrial association loss by using an input-output method based on the input-output table, and calculating enterprise outage loss based on GDP data, enterprise outage time and comprehensive disaster index; and calculating to obtain the indirect economic loss of the earthquake based on the industrial association loss and the enterprise outage loss. The method and the device can accurately evaluate the indirect economic loss of the earthquake, and provide scientific basis for disaster defense, post-disaster recovery reconstruction and other works.
assignees: NAT DISASTER REDUCTION CENTER OF EMERGENCY MANAGEMENT DEPARTMENT EMERGENCY MANAGEMENT DEPARTMENT SAT;NAT EARTHQUAKE RESPONSE SUPPORT SERVICE

title_en: InSAR-based building group post-earthquake damage assessment method and system
abstract_en: The invention discloses a building group post-earthquake damage assessment method and system based on InSAR, comprising the steps of determining a research area, obtaining radar images before and after earthquake in the corresponding area, and obtaining a radar data set contained in the radar images; D-InSAR is utilized to process radar images before and after the earthquake, and an LOS deformation map of the view direction of the radar in the research area is obtained; decomposing LOS directional deformation to obtain seismic main directional deformation; drawing a deformation grading diagram of the building; acquiring optical remote sensing images of a research area before and after an earthquake, and positioning a collapse building after the earthquake; positioning the collapsed building in the deformation grading diagram, comparing the optical remote sensing image with the deformation grading diagram, and positioning the exact position of the collapsed building; and evaluating the post-earthquake damage of the building, and evaluating the post-earthquake damage condition based on the position information and the deformation grading diagram of the collapsed building. The method aims at urban building groups, and improves the accuracy and efficiency of the evaluation process through integration of the InSAR and the optical remote sensing image.

title_en: Building group earthquake damage sample data set establishing method and building group earthquake damage assessment method
abstract_en: The invention provides a building group earthquake damage sample data set establishing method and a building group earthquake damage evaluation method, wherein the building group earthquake damage sample data set establishing method comprises the following steps: the method comprises the steps of obtaining pre-monitored strong vibration data, and classifying the strong vibration data by utilizing pre-calculated regional building vibration indexes; selecting one or more grades of earthquake motion data from the strong vibration data, and recording the earthquake motion data as target earthquake motion data; constructing seismic data compatible with a response spectrum of the target seismic data based on the strong seismic data to perform data augmentation on the target seismic data; and building a building group earthquake hazard sample data set based on the amplified target earthquake hazard data and the strong earthquake hazard data. The method can realize the data expansion of the target earthquake motion data, increases the data volume of the established building group earthquake motion sample data set, and can effectively improve the accuracy of the urban building group earthquake motion evaluation when the earthquake motion evaluation is carried out based on the building group earthquake motion sample data set.

title_en: Vehicle damage assessment method, device, electronic equipment and computer readable storage medium
abstract_en: The present disclosure relates to the technical field of vehicle insurance claims, and discloses a vehicle damage assessment method, a device, an electronic device and a computer readable storage medium; the method comprises the following steps: acquiring insurance amount data, vehicle grade data, a flooding degree data set and a maintenance place name set of a target vehicle; determining a vehicle grade coefficient according to a mapping relation between preset vehicle grade data and the vehicle grade coefficient; determining a flooding degree coefficient set according to a mapping relation between a preset flooding degree data set and the flooding degree coefficient set; determining a maintenance place coefficient set according to a mapping relation between a preset maintenance place name set and the maintenance place coefficient set; and determining the damage assessment amount data of the vehicle according to the insurance amount data, the vehicle grade coefficient, the flooding degree coefficient set and the maintenance area coefficient set. According to the method and the device, the damage assessment amount data of the target vehicle can be rapidly and accurately determined by considering various factors such as the target vehicle information, the flooding condition information and the maintenance condition information.

title_en: Building earthquake damage assessment method based on evidence reasoning
abstract_en: The building earthquake damage assessment method based on evidence reasoning comprises the following steps: step 1, constructing a rule base, wherein the rule base is composed of a plurality of rules, and each rule comprises a rule input vector and a rule output vector; step 2, calculating rule weight of each rule; step 3, converting each element information in the input information x into a distributed confidence structure by adopting a membership function, and calculating the activation weight of the input information relative to each rule; and 4, combining all the activated rules to be commonly used for reasoning the confidence of each damage level of different structure types under different intensities. According to the invention, the earthquake damage prediction grade is optimized into a probability distribution form, different damage grades and reliability levels of the building under comprehensive influence factors are described in a quantitative mode, and compared with a single evaluation result given by a model, the probability distribution form provides more information, so that the uncertainty of the earthquake damage evaluation problem of the building is met.

title_en: High-adaptability damage assessment method
abstract_en: The invention discloses a high-adaptability damage assessment method, and relates to the field of computer vision and disaster emergency response. Firstly, inputting a damaged area data set into a segmentation network and a damage classification network for training to obtain a segmentation network model and a damage classification model, manufacturing a data set T of the area before and after new damage, and inputting the data set T into a two-stage refined damage evaluation neural network to obtain a building segmentation result and a damage classification result. The method has strong adaptability to the new event area, so that the damage classification can be refined quickly and efficiently, the calculation capability and the quick decision capability of the deep neural network are utilized to replace the on-site manual evaluation, the time and energy consumption is greatly reduced, and the damage degree of the building in the disaster area in a large range is judged efficiently under the condition of ensuring the accuracy and timeliness.

title_en: Earthquake disaster population loss rapid evaluation method based on wind turbine data
abstract_en: A rapid earthquake disaster population loss assessment method based on wind power generation data is used for assessing the casualties of people in different grid areas by connecting data acquired in real time with a model interface and combining the earthquake intensity of corresponding areas. The invention can evaluate the population loss of earthquake disasters more accurately and comprehensively, and further analyze rescue requirements and potential risks of different groups and areas.
assignees: SHANGHAI SHUZHE DATA TECH CO LTD

title_en: Mining earthquake-induced earth surface damage assessment method based on intensity index
abstract_en: The invention discloses a mining vibration-induced earth surface damage assessment method based on intensity indexes, which comprises the steps of firstly drawing a mining vibration wave data change curve of each station in the current vibration wave speed range, observing the peak value change condition of each curve, judging whether the peak value velocity PGV of a particle is overscaled, if so, complementing the peak value in the overscaled range in a slope manner on two sides of the overscaled range, thereby obtaining the complemented peak value velocity PGV of the particle, and simultaneously obtaining the peak value acceleration PGA of the particle, so that the obtained data is more accurate and has smaller error; combining the two to calculate particle peak acceleration and particle peak velocity at different positions of the earth surface according to the propagation attenuation rule of the vibration wave in the rock mass; finally, calculating the seismic intensity I at different positions of the earth surface according to a seismic intensity formula, and drawing a seismic intensity contour map; the intensity index graph can be used for accurately evaluating the surface damage, is high in universality and has high application value.
assignees: UNIV CHINA MINING;INNER MONGOLIA HAOSHENG COAL IND CO LTD

title_en: Equipment damage assessment method and system for power transmission and transformation multi-source three-dimensional collaborative dynamic monitoring
abstract_en: The invention discloses a method and a system for evaluating equipment damage of power transmission and transformation multi-source three-dimensional collaborative dynamic monitoring, wherein the method comprises the following steps: collecting monitoring data received by a sensor on the equipment; analyzing the monitoring data, evaluating the damage condition of the equipment by utilizing the monitoring data of the multi-source equipment, and updating historical data and abnormal indexes; and when the monitoring data fluctuates, scheduling the monitoring data of the multi-source equipment to evaluate the damaged change condition of the equipment. The error of human cost and manual evaluation is reduced, the equipment can be comprehensively monitored from multiple angles and dimensions, and no possible damaged information is omitted. The damage condition of the equipment is timely found and evaluated, so that decision support is provided for maintenance and repair. According to the positions, functions and damage probability of the sensors in disasters, corresponding weights are set for each sensor, so that accuracy of evaluation results is ensured.

title_en: Natural disaster insurance processing method and system based on unmanned aerial vehicle video data
abstract_en: The invention discloses a natural disaster insurance processing method and system based on unmanned aerial vehicle video data, comprising the steps of collecting aerial video images after natural disasters occur by using an unmanned aerial vehicle; preliminary preprocessing of the image; separating water areas, farmlands, buildings and roads in the video frame images according to the color characteristics of the video images; extracting key features from the identified farmland areas to form feature vectors; inputting the formed feature vector into a trained convolutional neural network for processing; the convolutional neural network outputs the specific position of the disaster-affected farmland, the type and area of the affected crops, the loss of crop yield, flooding, drought and insect attack; and (3) automatically integrating the identification result into an insurance company claim settlement system by an automatic claim settlement processing flow. According to the method, unmanned plane technology is combined with the convolutional neural network, the traditional disaster loss assessment process is automated and accurate, and through the method, the efficiency of claim settlement processing is improved, and the accuracy and reliability of assessment are improved.

title_en: Coastal erosion disaster loss assessment method
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of disaster assessment, in particular to a coastal erosion disaster loss assessment method. The method comprises the following steps: calculating the direct economic loss of coastal erosion; according to the land loss area of the coastal segment eroded by the coast, counting the land loss area of the area; constructing a comprehensive evaluation mathematical model according to the direct economic loss and the land loss area to obtain a disaster index; establishing a comprehensive grading standard of coast erosion disaster degree; and obtaining the comprehensive disaster grade of coast erosion according to the disaster index and the comprehensive grading standard of the disaster degree of coast erosion. According to the method, the disaster evaluation result is more accurate, the disaster grade is obtained more rapidly, and the disaster treatment is facilitated.

title_en: Post-fire concrete structure damage assessment method based on image classification
abstract_en: A post-fire concrete structure damage assessment method based on image classification relates to the technical field of post-fire concrete structure damage assessment, and comprises the following steps: s1, manufacturing a data set; s2, configuring a network architecture and super parameters; s3, network training and performance evaluation; s4, module visualization; s5, designing a GUI interface. The invention constructs an image data set for network training and verification based on an image processing method in deep learning; the classification network suitable for the damage type and grade of the RC structural member after the fire disaster is provided, so that the color change, the cracking degree of the crack, the bursting degree of the concrete and the exposed reinforcement degree of the reinforcing steel bar of the member after the fire disaster can be classified, and the final damage grade can be predicted according to the damage type; and a GUI interactive interface is established, so that the automatic detection function of concrete structure damage after fire is realized.

title_en: Data evaluation method, device, equipment and storage medium based on artificial intelligence
abstract_en: The application belongs to the field of artificial intelligence and the field of financial science and technology, and relates to a data evaluation method based on artificial intelligence, which comprises the following steps: after a planting insurance claim settlement request corresponding to a target disaster area is acquired, receiving farmland image data which is acquired by an unmanned aerial vehicle and corresponds to the target disaster area; performing image preprocessing on farmland image data to obtain target image data; extracting features of the target image data to obtain crop feature data; invoking a loss analysis model to generate loss degree evaluation data respectively corresponding to various crops contained in the target image data; a claims value is generated based on the loss level evaluation data. The application also provides a data evaluation device, computer equipment and a storage medium based on the artificial intelligence. In addition, the present application relates to blockchain technology in which claim values may be stored. The method and the device can be applied to agricultural risk claim settlement scenes in the financial field, and can effectively improve the damage assessment processing efficiency and the damage assessment processing accuracy of planting risks.
assignees: CHINA PING AN PROPERTY INSURANCE CO LTD

title_en: Vibration damage prediction method and system based on Kriging model
abstract_en: The embodiment of the application provides a vibration damage prediction method and a system based on a Kriging model, wherein the method comprises the following steps: obtaining model training data; training the Kriging model by adopting the obtained model training data, and obtaining a trained shock resistance Kriging model and a trained shock resistance requirement Kriging model; and obtaining a vibration damage estimation result based on the trained vibration resistance Kriging model and the vibration resistance requirement Kriging model. According to the method, the Kriging model is used as a basis, the Kriging model is trained by adopting the corresponding data set, and the shock resistance requirement of the structure are respectively obtained through the trained Kriging model, so that the effective prediction of the shock damage of the structure under the specified earthquake action is realized.
assignees: CITIC GENERAL INST OF ARCHITECTURAL DESIGN & RES CO LTD

title_en: Deep learning-based natural disaster damage assessment method and device
abstract_en: The application provides a natural disaster damage assessment method and device based on deep learning. The method comprises the following steps: acquiring a target current image and a target reconstruction image of a target disaster-stricken facility set; processing the current image of the target by using a type recognition model to obtain the type of the target facility of each target disaster-stricken facility; processing the target current image and the target reconstruction image by using a scale evaluation model to obtain a target current scale and a target reconstruction scale of each target disaster-stricken facility; determining the target damage proportion of each target disaster-stricken facility according to the current target scale and the target reconstruction scale; and determining a target loss value of each target disaster-stricken facility according to the target damage proportion, the target facility type, the target reconstruction scale and the target area value. By introducing the deep learning technology, a large amount of data can be automatically processed, the loss of the building structure and the infrastructure caused by the natural disasters can be rapidly and accurately estimated, and the efficiency and consistency of natural disaster loss estimation are improved.

title_en: Reservoir operation period flood evaluation method based on process mechanism
abstract_en: The invention provides a reservoir operation period flood evaluation method based on a process mechanism, which belongs to the technical field of flood evaluation, and comprises the following steps: selecting the flood data with the maximum flood peak of each year, and calculating the flood frequency; constructing a dangerous relation curve between flood frequency and flood peak; simulating flood scenes corresponding to flood peaks; simulating a reservoir flood scheduling process for each flood scenario, and obtaining final flood loss of the flood; constructing a vulnerability relation between flood scenes and flood losses, and fitting a vulnerability relation curve; and constructing a loss risk relation curve between the flood frequency and the flood loss. The invention starts from the development and evolution process of flood, builds a chained transmission process based on natural flood risk, risk loss vulnerability after reservoir dispatching and loss risk, forms a flood risk identification and loss assessment method system, and provides traceable, interpretable and controllable flood risk management decision support for the reservoir under the global view.
assignees: UNIV ANHUI AGRICULTURAL;NANJING HYDRAULIC RES INST

title_en: Method, device, equipment and storage medium for detecting power distribution network line disaster damage
abstract_en: The invention discloses a method, a device, equipment and a storage medium for detecting the disaster damage of a power distribution network line, which comprise the following steps: acquiring a plurality of local images corresponding to a power distribution network line to be detected, preprocessing each local image, and splicing the preprocessed local images to obtain a panoramic image; image segmentation is carried out on the panoramic image to obtain a plurality of image areas, disaster damage types corresponding to each image area are identified, disaster damage information corresponding to the power distribution network line is evaluated to obtain a disaster damage report according to disaster damage identification results corresponding to each image area, and the panoramic image and the disaster damage report are visually displayed. The technical scheme of the embodiment of the invention can reduce the workload and risk of manual inspection, improve the post-disaster detection and recovery efficiency of the power distribution network line, and provide effective information support for the rapid recovery of the power distribution network line.

title_en: Method for detecting damage of post-fire concrete structure by image target detection
abstract_en: A method for detecting damage of a post-fire concrete structure by image target detection relates to the technical field of post-fire concrete structure damage assessment, and comprises the steps of firstly, defining four damage types of surface smoldering, crack cracking, concrete bursting and reinforcement exposure of an RC structural member after a fire, and constructing a corresponding data set for network training and verification. Then, one-stage target detection YOLOv s is selected as a base line network, and an AF-FPN module is introduced to improve the multi-scale performance and detection speed of the network. The detection performance of the comparison model under the combined conditions of different background interferences and damages reaches 93% of the highest detection precision and 80% of the average precision, and the detection performance is improved by about 10% compared with the network without improvement. And finally, researching and developing a damage detection system based on the mobile terminal of the smart phone to realize real-time detection of damage after disaster. The invention realizes the efficient nondestructive detection of the concrete structure after fire.

title_en: Building economic dynamic loss assessment and disaster reduction decision system under flood disasters
abstract_en: The invention discloses a building economic dynamic loss assessment and disaster reduction decision system under a flood disaster, which is based on a fine physical model and considers the uncertainty of resistance distribution of building components when coping with the flood disaster, and can obtain time-varying disaster economic loss in the whole flood process when being applied to a pre-disaster simulation scene, thereby providing a basis for the scheduling of related disaster relief materials; when the method is applied to a real-time monitoring scene, compared with the existing method, the method can accurately obtain the economic loss condition of each building in the monitoring area at the current moment.

title_en: Bridge earthquake motion response prediction and post-earthquake rapid assessment system based on digital twinning
abstract_en: The invention relates to a digital twinning-based bridge earthquake motion response prediction and post-earthquake rapid assessment system, which belongs to the field of bridge earthquake resistance and comprises an earthquake motion simulation module, a digital twinning model module, an earthquake response prediction module and an earthquake damage assessment module; the invention realizes the response simulation, prediction and rapid assessment of technical conditions of the bridge in various earthquake and vibration scenes, provides support for the maintenance and reinforcement of the bridge before earthquake and the emergency decision after earthquake, and ensures the safety and reliability of bridge engineering.
assignees: CHINA MERCHANTS CHONGQING COMMUNICATIONS TECH RESEARCH & DESIGN INSTITUTE CO LTD

title_en: Waterlogging disaster risk assessment system based on causal sum or graph
abstract_en: The invention discloses a causal and graph-based waterlogging disaster risk assessment system, which comprises the following steps: the waterlogging point monitoring module is used for acquiring monitoring data of all waterlogging points in the risk area; the point location information sensing module is used for extracting static building information and dynamic flow information; the causal and or relation module is used for constructing a causal and or relation model of the risk area and the waterlogging point; the risk calculation module is used for calculating the probability of occurrence of waterlogging events in each risk area; the loss calculation module is used for calculating a loss value and a loss expected value of each node; the risk assessment module is used for outputting the sorting result as a risk and loss assessment result. The system is based on a causal and relational model, and by calculating the loss value and the loss expected value and evaluating and sequencing the risk areas, the risk and loss evaluation result with intuitionistic and high accuracy is provided on the premise of ensuring the evaluation efficiency, and more scientific support and guidance are provided for waterlogging prevention and control work.
assignees: DMAI INTELLIGENT TECH GUANGZHOU CO LTD

title_en: Earthquake economic loss assessment method and device based on fixed capital stock
abstract_en: The invention provides a seismic economic loss assessment method and a seismic economic loss assessment device based on fixed capital stock, wherein the method comprises the following steps: acquiring seismic data of a target seismic disaster and socioeconomic attribute data of a target area where the target seismic disaster is located; obtaining values of at least two explanatory variables according to the seismic data and the socioeconomic attribute data; obtaining the direct economic loss of the target earthquake disaster through a direct economic loss evaluation model of the target earthquake disaster according to the values of at least two explanatory variables; the target earthquake disaster direct economic loss evaluation model comprises at least two interpretation variables, and each interpretation variable is calibrated with an elastic coefficient; the direct economic loss of the earthquake disaster is in a nonlinear relation with the interpretation variable, and the direct economic loss of the earthquake disaster is determined by the interpretation variable value and the elastic coefficient. The method can construct a rapid seismic direct economic loss assessment model based on fixed capital stock assessment and regional disaster system theory, and accurately assess the direct economic loss of the earthquake.

title_en: Agricultural meteorological disaster dynamic monitoring and yield loss assessment system
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of agriculture intelligence analysis, in particular to an agriculture meteorological disaster dynamic monitoring and yield loss assessment system, which comprises: the meteorological monitoring modules are used for collecting meteorological data; the data processing module is used for analyzing and judging agricultural meteorological disaster conditions; the meteorological monitoring module is also used for extracting wind speed information and wind direction information; the image acquisition module is used for acquiring crop images based on wind speed information and wind direction information to generate verification images; the data processing module is further configured to generate verification data and output a yield impairment result based on the verification image and the impairment image. According to the invention, the actual image of the crop is acquired in a short distance, so that the identification and judgment process is simplified, and the yield loss assessment efficiency and accuracy are improved; the time point of image acquisition before and after the damage of the crops is reasonably planned, the image recognition difficulty is reduced, the yield loss assessment efficiency is improved, and the damage condition of the crops after the agricultural meteorological disasters is truly and accurately acquired based on the dynamic recognition of the crops.

title_en: Calculation method for bending bearing capacity of rusted reinforced concrete beam after high temperature
abstract_en: A calculation method for the bending bearing capacity of a rusted reinforced concrete beam after high temperature belongs to the technical field of damage assessment after a concrete structure fire disaster, and comprises the following steps: step 1, determining constitutive relation of concrete and rusted steel bars after high temperature according to the existing research result, and then carrying out mechanical analysis on the section to obtain a force balance equation, a bending moment balance equation and a plane coordination equation; and 2, researching different steel bar strains and damage modes thereof during cross section damage according to cross section analysis, and obtaining a flexural bearing capacity calculation method under each damage mode according to constitutive relation and cross section analysis. The method comprehensively considers the problem of bending bearing capacity of the reinforced concrete beam under two nonlinear factors of high temperature and corrosion, and comprises the transition of a failure mode caused by the change of the steel bar strain caused by the corrosion, and calculates the bending bearing capacity of the reinforced concrete beam after the corrosion at high temperature.

title_en: Post-disaster building damage assessment method, device and equipment based on remote sensing image
abstract_en: The disclosure provides a post-disaster building damage assessment method, device and equipment based on remote sensing images, which can be applied to the technical field of image processing. The post-disaster building damage assessment method based on the remote sensing image comprises the following steps: inputting the pre-disaster remote sensing image into a semantic segmentation model, and outputting a segmentation result after semantic segmentation, wherein the pre-disaster remote sensing image characterizes the remote sensing image of the target building group before the disaster occurs; inputting post-disaster remote sensing images and pre-disaster remote sensing images of a target building group into a classification model, and outputting damage level labels aiming at the target building group, wherein the classification model outputs the damage level labels through multiple fusion of the characteristics indicated by the post-disaster remote sensing images and the characteristics indicated by the pre-disaster remote sensing images; and fusing the segmentation result and the damage grade label to obtain a damage grade identification image.
assignees: AEROSPACE INFORMATION RESEARCH INSTITUTE CHINESE ACADEMY OF SCIENCES

title_en: Power transmission and distribution line equipment disaster damage assessment method based on decision tree
abstract_en: The invention relates to a decision tree-based power transmission and distribution line equipment disaster damage assessment method, which comprises the following steps: acquiring meteorological data of historical weather and facility information of power transmission and distribution line equipment, acquiring monitoring data information, performing data preprocessing, and extracting features to form a training set; constructing a decision tree model based on a classification algorithm, and training by using a training set to obtain a disaster damage prediction model of the power transmission and distribution line equipment; acquiring real-time meteorological data and facility information of target power transmission and distribution line equipment to perform data preprocessing to obtain target characteristic data, and inputting the target characteristic data into a disaster prediction model of the power transmission and distribution line equipment to obtain a prediction result; constructing a disaster damage evaluation model of the power transmission and distribution line equipment based on DBScan algorithm, and training by using a training set to obtain the disaster damage evaluation model of the power transmission and distribution line equipment; and inputting the prediction result into a disaster damage evaluation model of the power transmission and distribution line equipment to obtain a disaster damage evaluation result of the target power transmission and distribution line equipment.
assignees: STATE GRID FUJIAN ELECTRIC POWER CO;ELECTRIC POWER RES INST STATE GRID FUJIAN ELECTRIC POWER CO LTD;STATE GRID CORP CHINA

title_en: Forest fire monitoring and early warning system and method thereof
abstract_en: The application relates to the field of forestry monitoring, in particular to a forest fire monitoring and early warning system, which comprises a basic video module, a map module, a high-point cruising module, a forest fire monitoring module, a three-dimensional map module and a fireproof command module, wherein the basic video module provides real-time video and video data support for other modules, realizes data sharing with the map module, communicates with the high-point cruising module to acquire fire positioning and monitoring tasks, the high-point cruising module is linked with the forest fire monitoring module to share unmanned plane track data, early warning and treatment of the fire are realized, the three-dimensional map module receives the data of the forest fire monitoring module and the high-point cruising module, performs fire positioning, spreading analysis and disaster damage assessment, and the fireproof command module interacts with the three-dimensional map module to realize the functions of rescue strength searching, pre-plan management and disaster damage assessment. The application has the advantage of solving the integration problems of forest fire monitoring, early warning, disposal and post-disaster evaluation.
assignees: GUANGDONG CHANGRUN COMMUNICATION ENG CO LTD

title_en: Method for predicting wind pressure inside and outside open-cell short building group
abstract_en: The invention relates to a method for predicting internal and external wind pressure of an open-pore short building group, which comprises the steps of firstly, establishing a layout rule internal and external wind pressure database of the short building group by taking building interference and open-pore influence into consideration based on wind tunnel tests, secondly, dividing the open-pore short building group into three open-pore categories based on the database, judging the open-pore categories according to working condition parameters and selecting a reasonable internal and external pressure determining method when insufficient wind tunnel test data are available, finally, performing machine learning training based on obtained internal and external wind pressure data to obtain a prediction model for the internal and external wind pressure of the short building group with arbitrary layout, wherein the established prediction method for the internal and external wind pressure of the short building group can avoid inaccurate disaster loss assessment caused by calculating the internal and external wind pressure of the building by using an unsteady Bernoulli equation, and meanwhile, can also avoid resource waste caused by determining the internal and external wind pressure of the building by using a wind tunnel test or a numerical simulation method, and is beneficial to efficient implementation of wind disaster loss analysis of the short building group by introducing machine learning.

title_en: Method, device and equipment for determining storm flood disaster loss
abstract_en: The invention provides a method, a device and equipment for determining the loss of a storm flood disaster, wherein the method comprises the following steps: acquiring meteorological data of a target storm flood disaster and socioeconomic data of a target area where the target storm flood disaster is located; the socioeconomic data includes a fixed capital stock value grid map and a total national production value for everyone; determining disaster factor dangers of the target storm flood disaster, and disaster bearing body exposure and vulnerability of the target area according to the meteorological data and the socioeconomic data; and according to the disaster causing factor dangers, the disaster bearing body exposure and the vulnerability, obtaining the direct economic loss of the target storm flood disaster by presetting a storm flood disaster loss evaluation model. According to the scheme, an accurate direct economic loss assessment model of the storm flood disaster can be constructed, and the direct economic loss of the storm flood disaster can be predicted based on the model.

title_en: Remote sensing image-based damage assessment method and system
abstract_en: The invention discloses a remote sensing image-based damage evaluation method and a remote sensing image-based damage evaluation system, wherein a building damage evaluation network is used for building damage evaluation of remote sensing images; the building damage evaluation network training method comprises the following steps: acquiring building damage evaluation data; building positioning is carried out on the image before damage; performing convolution pooling operation on the images before and after damage to obtain a space feature map; fusing the spatial feature images of the images before and after the damage of the same layer, extracting deep difference features, and fusing disaster category feature values into the feature images; splicing the building positioning result and the feature images of each layer, and then carrying out convolution fusion to obtain an evaluation classification image; based on the output evaluation classification diagram and the corresponding evaluation label, training is completed to complete the building damage evaluation network. Adding disaster category information for the region images to be classified; the network detection capability can be improved, and the method has the advantages of high evaluation and classification precision, small error and the like. Disaster category information is introduced into the network, and the evaluation accuracy of building damage is improved.

title_en: Rice yield disaster loss assessment method based on high-resolution remote sensing image
abstract_en: The invention discloses a rice yield disaster loss assessment method based on high-resolution remote sensing images. Firstly, GF-1 remote sensing data are obtained, and the data are stored, registered and cut. And comparing and analyzing standard marking data sets such as spectral reflectivity characteristics, vegetation indexes, texture characteristics and the like of normal rice and lodging rice. Providing a basis for characteristic selection for distinguishing normal and lodged rice; and then, segmenting the rice data set by using a deep learning convolutional neural network to construct a semantic segmentation model. The model can accurately distinguish normal rice and lodging rice areas; and finally, counting the number of pixel points in different rice areas, and calculating the areas of normal rice and lodging rice by combining the spatial resolution parameters of satellites, so as to evaluate the loss of the rice yield after disaster. By means of the characteristics of large coverage area of the remote sensing image and timely data acquisition, the method can solve the problems that the efficiency of a manual method in acquiring the position and the area of the lodging crop is low, the irregular lodging area cannot be accurately measured and the like.
assignees: INST GEOGRAPHIC SCIENCES & NATURAL RESOURCES RES CAS

title_en: Regional rapid earthquake damage prediction method based on machine learning and model updating
abstract_en: The application discloses a rapid regional earthquake damage prediction method based on machine learning and model updating, relates to the technical field of structural earthquake-resistant safety evaluation, aims at solving the problems that the prior art is difficult to identify structural internal damage and further leads to low accuracy of post-earthquake damage evaluation, has finer damage discrimination compared with the existing damage identification method based on remote sensing images, the damage state (perfect, slight damage, medium damage, serious damage and destroy) can be accurately judged by calculating the maximum interlayer response of each layer through the updated structure numerical model, and whether the structure collapses is not simply judged, so that the accuracy of post-earthquake damage assessment is improved.
assignees: HARBIN INST TECHNOLOGY;EARTHQUAKE ADMINISTRATION OF SHANGHAI MUNICIPALITY

title_en: Power grid equipment damage assessment method and device under typhoon event
abstract_en: The application provides a method and a device for evaluating damage of power grid equipment in typhoon event. The method comprises the following steps: inputting weather characteristic information and emergency response information under a target typhoon event into a typhoon disaster damage assessment model to obtain the type of power disaster damage and the corresponding number of damaged equipment under the target typhoon event; determining a power grid equipment set to be evaluated corresponding to each power disaster type according to the influence area of the target typhoon event and the position of the power grid equipment matched with the power disaster type; according to the attribute characteristic information, the wind resistance information, the typhoon grade information and the distance information of each piece of power grid equipment to be evaluated, the influence degree of the target typhoon on the corresponding damage of each piece of power grid equipment to be evaluated is obtained; and determining damaged power grid equipment according to the number of damaged equipment corresponding to the power disaster type matched with the power grid equipment set to be evaluated and the influence degree. By adopting the method, the accuracy of the damage evaluation result of the power grid equipment can be improved.

title_en: Method for segmenting and quantifying concrete structure damage after fire disaster
abstract_en: A method for segmenting and quantifying concrete structural damage after fire relates to the technical field of concrete structural damage assessment after fire, and firstly, the type of damage on the surface of an RC structural member after fire is determined and a data set is constructed. Then UperNet _ ConvNeXt was constructed for training and testing. And then performing deep quantitative analysis on the damage by using an image segmentation technology. Aiming at the problem of complicated range calculation caused by variables such as picture size, shooting distance and the like, a three-dimensional cube of 2cm multiplied by 2cm is innovatively introduced as a reference object, and the immobilization of the range of each picture is realized. Subsequently, the lesions were classified into three types of linear cracks, reticular cracks, and bursts, and detailed quantification was performed. The accuracy of the quantified network was verified by comparison with the actual fracture and burst sizes. Finally, a GUI interface is designed to realize automatic segmentation and quantification of the damage of the laminated beam after fire.

title_en: Composite flood disaster risk assessment method and system
abstract_en: The application provides a composite flood disaster risk assessment method and system, the method comprises the following steps of collecting disaster related data of a research area, calculating convergence time of a composite flood basin, constructing two composite flood sequences, calculating the coincidence year ratio of the two composite flood sequences, optimizing Copula functions based on red pond information criteria, calculating joint distribution probability of the two composite flood sequences according to the optimized Copula functions, sampling the two composite flood sequences, constructing a composite flood sampling sequence, inputting the composite flood sampling sequence into a constructed flood loss assessment model, acquiring a flood loss value, and calculating composite flood disaster risk of the research area based on expected annual loss according to the joint distribution probability of the composite flood sampling sequence and the calculated corresponding flood loss value. The application realizes accurate assessment of the risk of composite flood disasters and provides important scientific basis for flood control and disaster reduction in watercourses and scientific implementation of flood early warning.

title_en: Disaster damage assessment visualization method and device based on GIS, terminal equipment and storage medium
abstract_en: The invention discloses a disaster damage assessment visualization method, a device, terminal equipment and a storage medium based on GIS, wherein the method comprises the following steps: acquiring a survey image of a disaster area to be evaluated, image metadata corresponding to the survey image and GIS geographic coordinate data; inputting the survey image into a pre-trained disaster damage identification model for disaster damage type identification to obtain a disaster damage type and a disaster damage range of a disaster area to be evaluated; mapping the survey image onto a preset GIS layer according to the image metadata, the image data index of the image metadata, the GIS geographic coordinate data and the survey image to obtain a first layer used for representing fusion of the survey image and the GIS; marking the disaster damage type and the disaster damage range on the first layer to obtain a second layer for representing disaster damage conditions; and returns the second layer to the user interface. By implementing the method and the device for displaying the position and the type of the disaster damage and the disaster damage range, the real-time disaster damage condition is provided, and the response efficiency of disaster area assessment is improved.

title_en: A system and method for rapid damage assessment and dispatching assistance post-earthquakes
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a rapid damage detection system, which fundamentally comprising at least one main body (1) rigidly positioned on buildings, at least one battery (2) within said main body (1) that provides energy to the system, at least one communication module (3) that allows for communication with transmitters outside the building and thus with the external environment, at least one GSM-equipped microprocessor (4) that informs about the geographical location of the rapid damage detection system and thus the building, at least one IMU multi- sensor (5) that can detect whether the building or a floor of thereof has horizontally displaced, and at least one altitude sensor (6) that detects whether the building or a floor thereof has experienced sinking relative to the ground level.
assignees: SADAKAT YAPI MIMARLIK INSAAT MUTEAHHITLIK VE TICARET LTD SIRKETI

title_en: Method and system for evaluating damage of earthquake damage of frame structure
abstract_en: The invention provides a frame structure earthquake damage assessment method and system, the method comprises the steps of establishing a large number of frame structure elastoplastic numerical calculation models with different structural parameters, obtaining structural parameters of the frame structure elastoplastic numerical calculation models, obtaining an interlayer displacement angle of a target floor of the frame structure when the target floor enters different damage states under the action of an earthquake and a data set of the interlayer displacement angles of adjacent floors at the same moment through elastoplastic numerical calculation, training to obtain a machine learning model, obtaining structural parameters of a building of the target frame structure, the interlayer displacement angle of the target floor and the interlayer displacement angles of the adjacent floors at the same moment, inputting the obtained data into the machine learning model to obtain interlayer displacement angle limit values of the target building, comparing the interlayer displacement angle of each moment of the target floor with the interlayer displacement angle limit values of the target floor, obtaining damage grades at each moment, and determining the damage states of the building. The invention establishes the relation between the structural parameter and the interlayer displacement angle limit value, and improves the accuracy of judging the damage caused by earthquake.

title_en: Earthquake motion record selection method and system matched with earthquake reproduction period
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of earthquake engineering, in particular to a seismic vibration record selection method and system matched with an earthquake reproduction period; the method comprises the following steps: step one: generating a random seismic event catalog; step two: calibrating the total occurrence rate of earthquakes; step three: determining a plurality of seismic intensity indicators associated with the analysis structure; step four: determining joint probabilities of a plurality of seismic intensity indicators; step five: obtaining a simulated spectrum through an error threshold value in a Kendall reproduction period, and obtaining a mean value and a standard deviation of the simulated spectrum to obtain a target spectrum; step six: after the target spectrum distribution is known, selecting a record set meeting the requirements from a target database; according to the invention, the target spectrum is constructed according to the multivariable Kendall reproduction period, so that the problem that the traditional wave selection scheme is greatly influenced by the selection of the conditional earthquake intensity index is solved, a mathematical strict scheme is provided for constructing the wave selection target spectrum with the IM combined dangerous level as the control index, and more accurate earthquake demand estimation is provided for earthquake record.

title_en: Post-earthquake simple girder bridge network damage assessment method and device and terminal equipment
abstract_en: The application is suitable for the technical field of earthquake analysis, and provides a method, a device and terminal equipment for evaluating network damage of a post-earthquake simply supported beam bridge. The method comprises the following steps: determining a seismic source parameter, a simple support beam bridge model parameter and a geological condition parameter; performing earthquake motion simulation according to the earthquake source parameters, the geological condition parameters, the pier elevation and the pier geographical position, and processing 0-5Hz earthquake waves in the earthquake motion simulation result to obtain accelerations of each pier point of the simply supported bridge at a plurality of moments; establishing a finite element simplified model of the simply supported girder bridge according to the model parameters of the simply supported girder bridge; performing time-course analysis on the viaduct network according to the finite element simplified model and the acceleration of each pier point at a plurality of moments to obtain seismic response data of the viaduct network; determining the relative displacement of the simply supported girder bridge according to the seismic response data of the viaduct network, and determining the curvature of the bottom of the bridge pier according to the relative displacement; and determining the damage grade of the simply supported girder bridge according to the curvature of the bottom of the pier. The method and the device can improve accuracy and efficiency of the post-earthquake bridge damage grade assessment.

title_en: Manufacturing method of 3D printing model of road tunnel damage structure after fire disaster
abstract_en: The invention discloses a method for manufacturing a 3D printing model of a road tunnel damage structure after fire, which comprises the following steps: the knowledge graph and the on-site data are utilized to analyze, sort and extract the damage information of the tunnel structure; based on the damage report and a similarity criterion, establishing a 3D printing damage structure model with rigidity change, and simulating an actual damage condition; verifying and optimizing the accuracy of the 3D printing model through modeling analysis and adjusting model parameters; manufacturing an optimized structure model by using a 3D printing technology, and reproducing details and complexity of tunnel damage; and (3) carrying out mechanical property test and calibration on the 3D printing model, verifying the mechanical response of the model under different loads, ensuring that the model meets the expectations on mechanical properties and geometric accuracy, and providing guidance for post-disaster tunnel structure damage model test. The invention can be used for manufacturing the tunnel damage model with equivalent rigidity after the fire disaster based on the 3D printing technology through the tunnel deformation after the fire disaster and the structural characteristics, and provides practical guidance for the model test of the tunnel structure after the fire disaster.

title_en: Earthquake disaster damage evaluation system based on python development
abstract_en: The invention discloses a seismic disaster damage assessment system based on python development, which is used for improving the damage assessment capability of the system. It specifically includes a direct loss module for making a direct loss assessment, an indirect loss module for making an indirect loss assessment, and an insurance pricing module. The invention is based on Python language development, and develops a system based on Django frames and Vue frames, and the function module structure arranged by the system is utilized to evaluate direct loss, indirect loss and insurance pricing after earthquake, so that the evaluation can be more quickly and comprehensively performed, the capability of evaluating the loss can be improved, and meanwhile, the effective data support is provided for subsequent recovery and reconstruction work.

title_en: Electric power system toughness evaluation method and device, electronic equipment and storage medium
abstract_en: The embodiment of the invention discloses a method and a device for evaluating toughness of a power system, electronic equipment and a storage medium, wherein the method comprises the following steps: acquiring equipment damage estimation data of each power node in a target area in a seismic scene; determining a plurality of toughness assessment indicators of the target area power system based on the equipment damage estimation data of each power node; determining subjective weight and objective weight of each toughness evaluation index; and determining a toughness evaluation result of the power system of the target area based on each toughness evaluation index and the subjective weight and the objective weight of each toughness evaluation index. The embodiment of the invention can effectively evaluate the toughness of the power system of each area in a possible earthquake scene.
assignees: GUANGDONG POWER GRID CO;HUIZHOU POWER SUPPLY BUREAU GUANGDONG POWER GRID CO LTD

title_en: Typhoon disaster loss assessment method and device for offshore wind power engineering
abstract_en: The application provides a typhoon disaster damage assessment method and device for offshore wind power engineering, wherein the method comprises the following steps: the method comprises the steps of obtaining characteristic data related to economic losses caused by an offshore wind farm in typhoon disasters, wherein the characteristic data comprise central maximum wind speed, central air pressure, wind circle radius, installed scale of the wind farm, annual power generation hours of the wind farm and wind farm distance, inputting the characteristic data into a preset prediction model, and obtaining economic loss indexes output by the prediction model. From this, confirm economic loss index based on the data of a plurality of characteristic dimension such as central maximum wind speed, central atmospheric pressure, wind circle radius, wind farm installation scale, wind farm annual power generation hour number, wind farm distance, improved the accuracy of marine wind power engineering typhoon disaster loss evaluation.
assignees: HUANENG GUANGDONG SHANTOU OFFSHORE WIND POWER CO LTD;HUANENG CLEAN ENERGY RES INST;HUANENG OFFSHORE WIND POWER SCIENCE AND TECH RESEARCH CO LTD;HUANENG GUANGDONG ENERGY DEV CO LTD

title_en: River main flow ecological water demand estimation method
abstract_en: The invention discloses a river main flow ecological water demand estimation method which comprises the steps of obtaining historical hydrological data of a target river main flow river channel, establishing a relationship curve of wet circumference and flow by adopting a wet circumference method, determining minimum ecological water demand in the river channel, calculating natural vegetation ecological water demand outside the river channel, calculating repeated amounts of calculation results of the ecological water demand in the main flow river channel and the ecological water demand outside the river channel, calculating groundwater recovery amount, and estimating the ecological water demand of the target river main flow. The invention calculates the minimum ecological water demand in the river channel and the minimum ecological water demand outside the river channel respectively, eliminates the repeated amount of the ecological water demand in the river channel and the underground water recovery amount, ensures the complete hydrologic process of the dry-flow river channel in a certain period, stabilizes the natural vegetation community structure along the line, ensures the underground water to reach the target water level and maintains the total amount of water resources required by water balance.

title_en: Building earthquake damage assessment method and system based on multi-mode large model
abstract_en: The application relates to the technical field of building safety management, in particular to a building earthquake damage assessment method and system based on a multi-mode large model, wherein the building earthquake damage assessment method based on the multi-mode large model comprises the steps of acquiring a first building remote sensing image of an area to be assessed, and extracting a first building characteristic based on the first building remote sensing image; obtaining a second building remote sensing image of a geological region to be monitored within a preset time interval, obtaining a second building feature according to the second building remote sensing image, obtaining a change feature according to the first building feature and the second building feature, calculating building state data based on the change feature, and inputting the building state data into a preset building earthquake damage prediction model to obtain a building earthquake damage prediction result. The method has the effect of improving the accuracy of the building earthquake damage assessment result.
assignees: CHENGDU ACADEMY OF BUILDING RES ENGINEERING QUALITY INSPECTION CO LTD

title_en: Taylor series-based rust building structure direct economic loss assessment method
abstract_en: The invention provides a Taylor series-based corrosion building structure direct economic loss assessment method which comprises the steps of selecting a real main aftershock record as a ground shock input, adopting a mathematical method to simulate degradation of reinforced concrete structure materials caused by corrosion, carrying out finite element modeling on the reinforced concrete structure based on the mathematical method, carrying out nonlinear time course analysis under the action of a main aftershock sequence on a finite element model of the reinforced concrete structure to obtain damage data of the structure under different corrosion rates, taking logarithm of main shock intensity, aftershock intensity and structural damage parameters, adopting a Taylor series expansion mode to construct a generalized probability earthquake demand model of the structure, adopting a step-by-step method to delete parameter items with lower importance in the generalized probability earthquake demand model to obtain a practical probability earthquake demand model with both precision and simplicity, constructing a function, and further calculating to obtain earthquake median vulnerability values and intervals of the reinforced concrete structure with different corrosion rates, and further obtaining the median values and intervals of economic loss indexes of the reinforced concrete structure under different corrosion rates based on direct economic loss coefficients.

title_en: Method and system for detecting oil film of marine radar based on feature fusion and genetic algorithm
abstract_en: The invention discloses a marine radar oil film detection method and a system based on feature fusion and genetic algorithm, relates to the technical field of marine disaster prevention and reduction, and aims to solve the problems of low detection efficiency and low detection accuracy of the existing detection method. The method comprises the technical key points of cutting a preprocessed image to obtain a plurality of slice images, extracting Tamura texture characteristics of each slice image, fusing the Tamura texture characteristics of each slice image by adopting a factor analysis method to obtain fused characteristics, inputting the fused characteristics into a classifier trained in advance to classify the fused characteristics to obtain an oil spill detection effective area, and segmenting the oil spill detection effective area by utilizing an improved genetic algorithm to obtain an oil film extraction result. The invention combines texture feature fusion and machine learning optimization technology, reduces feature dimension and realizes accurate segmentation of oil film. The invention can provide important data support for the decontamination action and damage assessment of the offshore oil spill event.

title_en: Systems and methods of image extraction for effective global and local damage assessment
abstract_en: A system and method for prior and post-image analysis for damage level assessments are provided. An Image-based Prior and Posterior Conditional Probability Learning (IP2CL) system and method is provided for Human Assistance and Disaster Response (HADR) and damage assessments (DA) situational assessment and awareness (SAA). Equipped with the IP2CL, matching prior and posterior disaster/action images are effectively encoded into one image which is then ingested into deep learning (DL) approaches to determine the damage levels. Two scenarios for practical uses are provided: pixel-wise semantic segmentation and patch-based global damage classification.

title_en: Earthquake damage assessment method and system for earthquake damage reduction using earthquake risk factors
title_ko: 지진피해 저감을 위한 지진위험요소를 활용한 지진피해 평가 방법 및 시스템
abstract_en: According to the present invention, disclosed are a method and a system for evaluating earthquake damage using earthquake risk factors for reducing earthquake damage, which derive a disaster risk index in accordance with an earthquake damage case survey result such as building collapse due to earthquake occurrence, urban fire, and evacuation risk, select and analyze earthquake damage risk factors using the same, and evaluate a building collapse risk for earthquake damage reduction and a quantitative regional risk considering regional characteristics. The disclosed earthquake damage evaluation system comprises: a collection unit for collecting earthquake damage data; an analysis unit for analyzing the earthquake damage case based on the collected earthquake damage data; a deriving unit for deriving a disaster risk index and earthquake disaster risk factors based on the analyzed result; an evaluation unit for evaluating the earthquake damage in accordance with the derived disaster risk index and earthquake disaster risk factors; and a providing unit for providing the evaluation result.
abstract_ko:
본 발명은 지진 발생으로 인한 건축물 붕괴, 도심지 화재, 대피 위험 등의 지진피해 사례 조사 결과에 따라 재난 위험도 지표를 도출하고, 이를 활용해 지진피해 위험요소를 선정 및 분석하여, 지진피해 저감을 위한 건축물 붕괴 위험도와, 지역특성을 고려한 정량적 지역 위험도를 평가할 수 있도록 하는, 지진피해 저감을 위한 지진위험요소를 활용한 지진피해 평가 방법 및 시스템이 개시된다. 
개시된 지진 피해 평가 시스템은, 지진 피해 자료를 수집하는 수집부; 상기 수집된 지진 피해 자료에 근거해 지진 피해 사례를 분석하는 분석부; 상기 분석 결과에 근거해 재난 위험도 지표 및 지진재해 위험요소를 도출하는 도출부; 상기 도출된 재난 위험도 지표와 지진재해 위험 요소에 따라 지진 피해를 평가하는 평가부; 및 상기 평가 결과를 제공하는 제공부를 포함할 수 있다.

title_en: Building group earthquake loss probability assessment method based on earthquake intensity random field simulation
abstract_en: The invention provides a building group earthquake loss probability assessment method based on earthquake intensity random field simulation, and belongs to the technical field of earthquake loss assessment.
