The method provided by the invention firstly adopts the seismic intensity random field simulation technology to simulate the seismic of the area to obtain the spatial distribution of the seismic intensity of different sites, and then utilizes the building earthquake resistance model and the building vulnerability database to estimate the loss probability distribution of each building. The method can evaluate the occurrence probability of the extreme earthquake loss of a large-scale building group more quickly and accurately, and provides important support for earthquake risk evaluation and post-disaster emergency decision, so that the disaster resistance and recovery capacity of the city are enhanced, and the overall toughness of the city is improved.

title_en: River basin super-standard flood disaster cross-region compensation method, equipment, medium and product based on water engineering scheduling benefit and loss mutual feedback
abstract_en: The application discloses a river basin super-standard flood disaster cross-zone compensation method, equipment, medium and product based on water engineering scheduling benefit and loss mutual feedback, and relates to the field of flood disaster assessment, wherein the method comprises the steps of obtaining a water engineering joint scheduling scheme of a target river basin, carrying out flood control and disaster reduction benefit assessment, and determining the flood control benefit of the water engineering joint scheduling scheme; carrying out disaster damage assessment on the water project diving operation according to the water project joint scheduling scheme, and determining the disaster damage of the water project diving operation; and the compensation made by the flood control sacrifice zone under the application of the water engineering joint scheduling scheme is calculated. The application can accurately calculate the compensation of the flood control sacrificial region under the application of the water engineering joint scheduling scheme, effectively coordinate the beneficial damage relationship between the flood control protective region and the sacrificial region, realize the common public interest share and risk, improve the capacity of the water engineering for bearing flood risks and self-recovery after disaster, and have important significance for optimizing resource allocation, reducing disaster risks and guaranteeing the life and property safety of people.

title_en: Automatic discriminating method for vehicle submerged part based on image
abstract_en: The invention discloses an automatic distinguishing method for a vehicle submerged part based on an image, and belongs to the technical field of computer vision. Firstly, a water surface and vehicle instance segmentation model based on deep learning and a vehicle external part target detection model based on deep learning are constructed, and a vehicle submerged part discrimination model based on machine learning is constructed, wherein the model takes the target detection confidence of various external parts of a vehicle as input. Then, reading urban flood images, acquiring a water surface mask and a vehicle mask by using a water surface and vehicle instance segmentation model, selecting an underwater vehicle according to the water surface mask and the vehicle mask, detecting an external part from the underwater vehicle mask area range image by using a vehicle external part target detection model, and judging a vehicle submerged part by using a vehicle submerged part judgment model according to the detection confidence of various external part targets, thereby realizing automatic judgment of the vehicle submerged part. The method can provide references for emergency rescue, vehicle transfer and vehicle damage assessment.

title_en: Concrete box girder damage assessment method under high-temperature action of fire disaster
abstract_en: The application provides a concrete box girder damage assessment method under the action of fire high temperature, which belongs to the technical field of road and bridge detection and comprises the steps of determining the burning time and the fire scene temperature of a burning source based on site fire investigation information and the apparent state of concrete, determining the concrete maximum temperature, the steel bar maximum temperature and the steel strand maximum temperature of the concrete box girder according to the burning time and the fire scene temperature, calculating the elastic modulus and the compressive strength of the concrete at high temperature according to the concrete maximum temperature, determining the actual elastic modulus of the steel bar according to the steel bar maximum temperature, and determining the actual elastic modulus of the steel strand according to the steel strand maximum temperature. The method for evaluating the damage of the concrete box girder under the action of fire disaster high temperature can evaluate the condition of a fire scene more accurately, thereby providing scientific and systematic basis for reinforcing and repairing the concrete box girder structure after high temperature.
assignees: CHINA ACADEMY RAILWAY SCIENCES CORP LTD;CARS RAILWAY ENG RES INST

title_en: Agricultural meteorological disaster dynamic monitoring and yield loss assessment system
abstract_en: The application discloses a dynamic monitoring and yield loss assessment system for agricultural meteorological disasters, which relates to the field of agricultural monitoring and comprises a meteorological monitoring module, a preliminary analysis module, a monitoring point layout module, an image acquisition module, an image analysis module and a comprehensive evaluation module, wherein the agricultural meteorological disasters are used for monitoring and comprehensively analyzing the types of crops in a target area and the meteorological information of the target area, the intelligent monitoring points are selected, the accuracy and timeliness of estimating the yield loss of the target area are effectively improved, the yield loss of crops caused by diseases and meteorological environments is subdivided through comprehensive analysis of middle and abnormal crops in the target area, and the accuracy of estimating the yield loss of the crops in the target area caused by the meteorological environments is improved.
assignees: QUJING JIAWO MODERN AGRICULTURE CO LTD;YUNNAN ZHIHUI CHUANGXIANG TECH CO LTD

title_en: High earth and rockfill dam shock hazard rapid evaluation system
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of high earth and rockfill dam vibration damage assessment, in particular to a high earth and rockfill dam vibration damage rapid assessment system which comprises a cloud computing module, a fog computing module and a twin body synchronous rendering module, wherein the cloud computing module is used for acquiring and transmitting data of other servers and preprocessing the acquired data, the fog computing module is connected with the cloud computing module, the data preprocessed by the cloud computing module are analyzed and computed, the computing result is written into a database, and the twin body synchronous rendering module is connected with the fog computing module, and is used for mapping the computing result in the database by utilizing a digital twin technology to obtain a virtual detection model. The dam earthquake damage assessment is carried out by utilizing edge, fog and cloud calculation through an advanced distributed architecture, autonomous and online digital twin of the ultra-high earth-rock dam can be realized, a physical object, a virtual model and a mapping network are combined by utilizing a digital twin technology, and the digital twin of each dam can provide comprehensive and real representation, so that effective monitoring, analysis and decision making processes are realized.

title_en: Process comprehensive weather disaster risk assessment method and device
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of weather, and discloses a comprehensive process weather disaster risk assessment method and device. The method comprises the steps of obtaining a basic data set, including meteorological live monitoring, element forecasting and historical disaster situation data, obtaining a disaster risk index by means of an input index calculation model preset by the basic data, carrying out comprehensive disaster grading and comprehensive disaster damage estimation according to the disaster risk index by combining a disaster causing threshold value, hidden danger points and a risk area, and giving a process disaster causing conclusion, including process wind and rain influence, process strength, risk grade, disaster causing range and/or disaster situation estimation. The embodiment of the invention improves the accuracy of disaster risk assessment, provides more detailed and scientific assessment results for government and related decision departments, supports more accurate disaster prevention and reduction decisions, surrounds the 'full time domain response' of key time points before, during and after disasters, realizes process closed-loop management, improves disaster response efficiency and improves social benefits of disaster response.
assignees: METEOROLOGICAL BUREAU OF SHENZHEN MUNICIPALITY SHENZHEN METEOROLOGICAL OBSERVATORY;SHENZHEN NAT CLIMATE OBSERVATORY SHENZHEN ASTRONOMICAL OBSERVATORY

title_en: Apparatus and method for flood damage assessment considering intensity and route of flooding and system for establishing risk management procedure based on the same
title_ko: 침수 강도와 경로를 고려한 침수 피해평가 및 이에 기초한 위기관리 절차 수립 시스템
abstract_en: Disclosed are an inundation damage assessment considering inundation strength and a route, and a crisis procedure management establishment system based on the same. According to an embodiment of the present invention, a crisis management procedure establishment method based on inundation damage assessment considering inundation strength and a route comprises the steps of: obtaining facility information including information on major processes performed in an environmental facility; calculating a limit inundation depth of a target space in which each of the major processes is performed; deriving inundation damage prediction information in the environmental facility according to a virtual disaster situation in consideration of the limit inundation depth and rainfall aspect information associated with the virtual disaster situation for the environmental facility; and deriving a crisis management procedure to be applied to the environmental facility based on the inundation damage prediction information.
abstract_ko: 침수 강도와 경로를 고려한 침수 피해평가 및 이에 기초한 위기절차 관리 수립 시스템이 개시되며, 본원의 일 실시예에 따른 침수 강도와 경로를 고려한 침수 피해평가에 기초한 위기관리 절차 수립 방법은, 환경 시설에서 수행되는 주요 공정에 대한 정보를 포함하는 시설 정보를 획득하는 단계, 상기 주요 공정 각각이 수행되는 타겟 공간의 한계 침수심을 연산하는 단계, 상기 한계 침수심 및 상기 환경 시설에 대한 가상 재난 상황과 연계된 강우 양상 정보를 고려하여 상기 가상 재난 상황에 따른 상기 환경 시설에서의 침수 피해 예측 정보를 도출하는 단계 및 상기 침수 피해 예측 정보에 기초하여 상기 환경 시설에 대하여 적용될 위기관리 절차를 도출하는 단계를 포함할 수 있다.

title_en: Remote sensing image building damage assessment method combining global clues and local clues
abstract_en: The application relates to the technical field of building damage assessment, in particular to a remote sensing image building damage assessment method combining global and local clues, which comprises the steps of obtaining pre-disaster and post-disaster initial double-time-phase images of a building in a target area, obtaining pre-disaster and post-disaster double-time-phase images meeting certain pairing conditions based on the initial double-time-phase images, carrying out weight sharing coding on the double-time-phase images to obtain multi-scale double-time-phase characteristics, obtaining multi-scale difference enhancement fusion characteristics based on the multi-scale double-time-phase characteristics, connecting and fusing the multi-scale difference enhancement fusion characteristics based on the global and local clues to obtain output characteristics, and predicting damage assessment results and misprediction results of the building based on the output characteristics to obtain final damage assessment results of the building. Therefore, the problems of poor modeling effect, difficulty in migration application, insufficient global-local feature utilization, difficulty in sample perceptibility and the like caused by small feature difference in the related technology are solved.

title_en: Method and related device for analyzing damage of power transmission tower after flood disaster
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the field of power transmission towers, and discloses a method and a related device for analyzing damage of a power transmission tower after flood, wherein the method comprises the steps of obtaining design information and service time of the power transmission tower and flood intensity information; according to design information and service time of the power transmission tower and flood intensity information, obtaining a post-flood damage state of the power transmission tower through a preset post-flood damage machine learning model of the power transmission tower; the method comprises the steps of constructing a numerical analysis probability model of the power transmission tower under different service times, carrying out flood hydrostatic thrust analysis based on the numerical analysis probability model of the power transmission tower under different service times, obtaining the post-flood damage states of the power transmission tower under different flood intensities, generating training samples, training the machine learning model according to the training samples, and obtaining the post-flood damage machine learning model of the power transmission tower. Repeated calculation of the traditional method is avoided, and the speed of damage assessment after flood disaster of the power transmission tower group is greatly improved.
assignees: CHINA ELECTRIC POWER RES INST CO LTD;STATE GRID GANSU ELECTRIC POWER CO ELECTRIC POWER RES INST;STATE GRID GANSU ELECTRIC POWER CO;STATE GRID CORP CHINA

title_en: Rapid ship structural damage assessment method based on numerical simulation and MLP (maximum likelihood) under fire disaster effect
abstract_en: The invention provides a rapid assessment method of structural damage of a ship under the action of fire based on numerical simulation and MLP (multi-layer simulation), which comprises the steps of constructing a thermodynamic coupling model based on PyroSim software and ANSYS software, comprehensively considering the double change effects of heat conduction and structural mechanics, performing thermodynamic coupling numerical simulation under the action of fire on the ship, performing deep learning training on simulation data by adopting a multi-layer perceptron model, constructing a deep perceptron model to assess the structural damage under the action of fire on the ship, designing GPU (graphic processing unit) acceleration logic, and optimizing the calculation efficiency of key steps by GPU acceleration to achieve the aim of rapid assessment of the structural damage under the action of fire on the ship. The technical scheme of the invention not only can obviously reduce the calculation cost, but also can provide high-efficiency and accurate damage evaluation results, and provides new technical support and solution for the safety research of the ship structure in fire scene.

title_en: Agricultural insurance platform based on block chain
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of blockchains, in particular to an agricultural insurance platform based on blockchains, which comprises an acquisition module, a policy storage module, a judgment module, a damage assessment module and a data analysis module, wherein the acquisition module is mainly used for acquiring images, remote sensing and environmental information of crops and carrying out blockchain storage, the policy storage module is mainly used for storing policies and generating a damage settlement threshold value and a damage settlement level, the judgment module is mainly used for judging disaster probability, distinguishing natural and unnatural factors, removing human factors and determining natural disaster areas, the damage assessment module is mainly used for assessing actual disaster areas, the damage settlement module is mainly used for calculating damage amount and transferring the damage settlement amount to a peasant account, the early warning module is mainly used for sending disaster early warning information to peasants, and the data analysis module is mainly used for analyzing data and displaying disaster and damage settlement trends. The invention can more accurately judge natural factors and human factors in the disaster area of crops, and ensure fairness and rationality of claim settlement.
assignees: SHANDONG UNIV OF FINANCE AND ECONOMICS

title_en: Optical and SAR image change detection method and device based on twinning attention enhancement
abstract_en: The application discloses a method and a device for detecting image change of an optical and synthetic aperture radar (SYNTHETIC APERTURE RADAR, SAR) based on twinning attention enhancement, which relate to disaster loss estimation and artificial intelligence technology and comprise the steps of receiving a pre-time phase optical image and a post-time phase SAR image; the method comprises the steps of inputting processed front time phase optical images and rear time phase SAR images into a heterogeneous image translation network to output rear time phase optical images of unified feature mapping, inputting the front time phase optical images and the rear time phase optical images of the unified feature mapping into a twin attention enhanced change detection network to conduct feature extraction, and taking the category with higher binary classification probability value in corresponding pixels in the twin attention enhanced change detection network as a final prediction result of the pixels to generate a complete binary change detection result. The method can realize effective conversion and high-precision change detection of the heterogeneous images, and widens the practical application of the heterogeneous images in tasks such as disaster loss assessment, building damage analysis and the like.

title_en: Natural disaster power grid disaster damage assessment method and system based on big data analysis
abstract_en: The application provides a natural disaster power grid disaster damage assessment method and system based on big data analysis, which relate to the technical field of power grid disaster damage assessment, wherein situation evolution characteristics of a target urban power grid in natural disasters and sudden event power grid outage are determined by all fault attribute nodes, a power loss index set of the target urban power grid in disaster recovery is determined according to risk aggregation identification, loss interaction quantity of the target urban power grid in recovery strategy updating is determined by disaster damage correction information, disaster damage response decisions of the target urban power grid in sudden event influence are determined by the loss interaction quantity and situation evolution characteristics, disaster damage information of the target urban power grid is synchronously matched in a power supply database of the target urban power distribution network through disaster damage identification constraint and disaster damage response decisions, and a risk assessment report is generated.
assignees: POWER EMERGENCY CENTER OF STATE GRID SICHUAN ELECTRIC POWER CORP

title_en: Typhoon-storm flood composite disaster monitoring and evaluating method and system
abstract_en: The invention discloses a typhoon-storm flood composite disaster monitoring and evaluating method and system, belonging to the field of disaster intelligent monitoring, wherein the method comprises the following steps of establishing a disaster identification model through a machine learning algorithm based on multi-factor data to obtain a composite disaster judging result; the disaster situation assessment method comprises the steps of constructing a disaster assessment model for a region constituting a disaster based on the composite disaster assessment result, dynamically updating parameters of the disaster assessment model based on real-time monitoring data to obtain a real-time composite disaster assessment result, dynamically adjusting loss probability distribution based on the real-time composite disaster assessment result to obtain a comprehensive disaster damage assessment result, and carrying out disaster situation time-space evolution based on the comprehensive disaster damage assessment result to obtain a disaster situation development trend.

title_en: Building target damage assessment method based on multi-mode remote sensing data
abstract_en: The invention discloses a building target damage evaluation method based on multi-mode remote sensing data, which comprises the steps of constructing a text-guided two-stage building target damage evaluation module, comprising a CLIP text encoder, a Unet image encoder and a text image fusion decoder, inputting image text description information and pre-disaster/post-disaster double-time-phase remote sensing images, wherein the CLIP text encoder module extracts text description information characteristics, the Unet image encoder extracts image characteristics of the pre-disaster/post-disaster double-time-phase remote sensing images, the text image fusion decoder fuses the text description information characteristics and the image characteristics, classifying building target damage according to the fused characteristics, constructing a building target damage evaluation module fused with building vector data and post-disaster remote sensing image data, converting the building vector data into bitmaps of the pre-disaster remote sensing images by using a geographic information base or an official geographical information base (OSM) of the building vector data already constructed, and using the pre-disaster images in a text-guided two-stage building target classification network BCL-Unet as pre-disaster images, and using a text-guided two-stage building target classification network L-Unet to perform building target damage grade. The invention provides a feasible technical scheme for the efficient detection of post-disaster building target damage.

title_en: Real-time judging method for roof collapse caused by fire disaster among nuclear power station oil storage tanks
abstract_en: The invention discloses a real-time judging method for roof collapse caused by fire among nuclear power station oil storage tanks, and relates to the technical field of fire safety design of roof structures among nuclear power station oil storage tanks. The method for judging the roof collapse caused by the fire disaster among the oil storage tanks of the nuclear power station in real time can realize time sequence temperature field mapping of the heated surface of the complex roof structure between CFD numerical simulation software and FEM software under different fire disaster scenes among the oil storage tanks of the nuclear power station, simulate real-time structure response behaviors of the roof structure among the oil storage tanks of the nuclear power station under different fire disaster scenes, and can be used for fire safety design and post-disaster damage assessment of the roof structure among the oil storage tanks of the nuclear power station.

title_en: Power grid disaster damage assessment method and system based on natural disaster chain
abstract_en: The application provides a power grid disaster damage assessment method and system based on a natural disaster chain, which relate to the technical field of power grid disaster damage assessment, and are used for determining a static safety domain of a power grid of a target power grid in a disaster scene according to historical operation data, carrying out static stable identification on the static safety domain to obtain a static safety node of the target power grid in the disaster scene, carrying out balance adjustment on operation risk indexes of various power grid sites in the disaster scene of the target power grid based on transient loss indexes to obtain unstable load quantity of the operation of the target power grid in the disaster scene, determining load attenuation deviation of the target power grid after the disaster by the loss load indexes and the static safety node, carrying out collaborative quantitative assessment on disaster damage information of the target power grid according to the load attenuation deviation and the unstable load quantity, and generating a power grid disaster damage assessment report. The application can carry out intelligent scheduling monitoring and multidimensional disaster damage assessment on the power grid in a complex dynamic environment after the power grid suffers from disaster, so as to improve decision optimization capacity of the power grid disaster damage assessment.
assignees: POWER EMERGENCY CENTER OF STATE GRID SICHUAN ELECTRIC POWER CORP

title_en: Building damage assessment method
abstract_en: The invention provides a building damage assessment method which can be applied to the technical field of remote sensing image processing. The method comprises the steps of carrying out wavelet transformation processing and multi-round self-adaptive global feature extraction on a disaster image of a target building group to obtain a multi-scale first feature image set, carrying out mask processing on the multi-scale first feature image set to obtain a first image segmentation result with mask information, carrying out wavelet transformation processing, multi-round self-adaptive global feature extraction and multi-round same-dimension feature image fusion on the disaster image and the post disaster image of the target building group in parallel to obtain a multi-scale second feature image set, carrying out convolution processing and activation processing on the multi-scale second feature image set to obtain a second image segmentation result, and carrying out image fusion on the first image segmentation result and the second image segmentation result to obtain a damage evaluation result of the target building group. The invention also provides a building damage assessment device, electronic equipment and a storage medium.

title_en: Summer maize flowering phase high-temperature disaster-causing evaluation model and disaster-causing estimation system based on multi-source data fusion
abstract_en: The invention discloses a summer maize flowering phase high-temperature disaster-causing evaluation model and a disaster damage estimation system based on multi-source data fusion, and particularly relates to the field of agricultural disaster monitoring and evaluation, wherein the system comprises a data source and processing module, a characteristic factor screening module, a model construction and evaluation module and a disaster damage estimation and analysis module; the data source and processing module is used for acquiring meteorological data, remote sensing data and disaster investigation data and processing the meteorological data, the remote sensing data and the disaster investigation data respectively, the characteristic factor screening module adopts normal distribution inspection and characteristic selection to carry out characteristic factor screening, the model construction and evaluation module is used for model construction and model evaluation, and the disaster estimation and analysis module utilizes the constructed model to carry out disaster estimation and analysis. The invention realizes accurate evaluation and disaster damage estimation of summer corn high temperature heat damage and improves the comprehensiveness and reliability of the evaluation result.

title_en: Deep learning-based natural disaster damage assessment method, device and program product
abstract_en: The invention discloses a natural disaster damage assessment method, device and program product based on deep learning, and relates to the field of damage assessment. The method comprises the steps of obtaining a plurality of pieces of pre-disaster image information of a target area and a plurality of pieces of post-disaster image information of the target area, constructing a plurality of pre-disaster three-dimensional images of a plurality of buildings of the target area according to the plurality of pieces of pre-disaster image information, constructing post-disaster three-dimensional images of the plurality of buildings of the target area according to the plurality of pieces of post-disaster image information, and inputting the post-disaster three-dimensional images of each building and the corresponding pre-disaster three-dimensional images into a deep learning model to obtain loss degree of each building. The invention can improve the efficiency of loss degree estimation.
assignees: NINGXIA HUI AUTONOMOUS REGION BASIC GEOLOGICAL SURVEY INST NINGXIA HUI AUTONOMOUS REGION GEOLOGICAL

title_en: Flood economic loss graph drawing method, system, equipment and medium
abstract_en: The invention provides a flood economic loss map drawing method, a system, equipment and a medium, which belong to the field of disaster loss assessment and comprise the steps of establishing a flood evolution model of a research area, carrying out flood influence analysis according to the flood evolution model to obtain the maximum submerged water depth and the area corresponding to the maximum submerged water depth area, obtaining social economic property data of each industry of the research area, calculating economic density of each industry in the research area according to the social economic property data of each industry, calculating the economic property loss value of each industry according to the area corresponding to the maximum submerged water depth area, the economic density and the flood damage property loss rate, drawing the economic property loss value of each industry into a map layer in ArcGIS, and superposing the map layer to obtain a flood economic loss map. The subjectivity of evaluating the specific economic loss is reduced, a more scientific and reasonable flood control decision is made, and the resource allocation is optimized.
assignees: UNIV ZHENGZHOU;HENAN SHUITOU YUANWAN RESERVOIR ENG CO LTD;HENAN WATER CONSERVANCY NO 2 ENG BUREAU GROUP CO LTD;HENAN WATER CONSERVANCY FIRST ENG BUREAU GROUP CO LTD

title_en: A system comprising a mobile application for post-earthquake damage assessment in reinforced concrete structural members
abstract_en: After earthquakes, buildings experience damages at different levels depending on various parameters. The extent of damage is determined based on observations such as cracks in structural elements, material crushing, and reinforcement damages. Decisions made are crucial for ensuring human safety and preventing economic losses. The invention pertains to a system which comprises a mobile application containing an automatic decision support system capable of assisting experts conducting field observations after earthquakes and performing damage classification at the element level.
assignees: KONYA TEKNIK UENIVERSITESI OEZEL KALEM;UNIV ISTANBUL TEKNIK

title_en: Building disaster evaluation uncertainty optimization method for coupling multi-source data with random distribution
abstract_en: The invention discloses a multi-source data and random distribution coupled building disaster damage assessment uncertainty optimization method which comprises the steps of collecting historical flood data of different cities and different types of buildings, meshing an assessment area, simulating and generating high-resolution water depth data of each grid unit by using a HiPIMS model, verifying and generating disaster damage data of each grid by combining remote sensing data, generalizing the cost of the different types of buildings by using building cost data in urban statistics annual authentication, assessing the building flood vulnerability based on a meshing method, and quantifying assessment uncertainty of the building flood vulnerability by using a confidence level analysis method. The method solves the problems of multi-source data fusion and accurate classification of buildings, unifies the scale difference of flood characteristics and socioeconomic data, introduces quantitative uncertainty of a confidence level analysis method, remarkably improves evaluation accuracy and reliability, and provides scientific support for urban disaster prevention and reduction, risk management and planning.

title_en: Ultra-large-scale building group earthquake damage assessment method based on multi-batch parallel calculation
abstract_en: A method for evaluating earthquake damage of a super-large-scale building group based on multi-batch parallel computing relates to the technical field of earthquake damage response prediction, aims at the problems of low earthquake response prediction efficiency caused by slow information reading, large storage occupation and the like of the existing super-large samples (such as millions, tens of millions and even billions of samples), realizes earthquake response computing and earthquake damage evaluation of the super-large-scale building by multi-batch block parallel computing and computer resource load-storage collaborative optimization.

title_en: Dual-time-phase characteristic interaction-based change detection method for disaster response
abstract_en: The invention provides a change detection method based on double-time-phase feature interaction for disaster response, which comprises the steps of 1, collecting building remote sensing image data before and after a disaster, preprocessing, 2, sending the preprocessed building remote sensing image data into a ConvMamba coder with shared weights to extract multi-scale features of the images before and after the disaster, 3, sending the multi-scale features into a feature enhancement module based on multi-branch expansion convolution to obtain enhanced features, 4, sending the enhanced features into a double-time-phase feature interaction module based on grouping Mamba to obtain difference features, 5, sending the difference features into a multi-stage decoder to decode, and outputting a building damage grading graph to complete damage assessment. The method can well realize accurate damage evaluation on the buildings under the influence of various complex backgrounds, and effectively solves the problems of false detection, omission detection and the like.

title_en: Method and system to respond on mutlidimensional user queries on flood in an specified region
abstract_en: The embodiments of the present disclosure address unresolved problems of assigning weightage to information sources in a GenAI model for responding to user queries on flood. Embodiments herein provide a method and system for responding to multidimensional user queries on flood with remote sensing and auxiliary data integration. Herein, the user query is responded by analyzing big geospatial vector database comprising spatially distributed flood inundation maps and flood probability maps along with other auxiliary datasets in vector form provided to the GenAI model. The other auxiliary datasets include flood event history, terrain information, river and stream network, floodplain map, climatic data, previous damage reports, soil and land use data. These auxiliary datasets will be continuously updated time-to-time. Importantly, a conveyor belt weighting model is introduced to provide weights to each source of information and the response by GenAI model is prepared based on the weights assigned to the information sources.

title_en: In-room damage estimation system
abstract_en: To precisely estimate in-room damage due to an earthquake motion.SOLUTION: An in-room damage estimation system that estimates an in-room damage state in an estimation process based upon a result of a learning process executed in advance, comprises: an in-room furniture estimating process S23 of recognizing furniture included in an in-room image by the use of a model for furniture recognition, and estimating kinds, locations, and sizes of the furniture; a time history response waveform prediction process S24 of inputting a time history response waveform from the time of earthquake occurrence to a first point of time into a learnt model for floor response estimation so as to predict a time history response waveform from the first point of time to a second point of time; and a furniture behavior estimating process S25 of finding the behavior of the furniture by time from the first point of time to the second point of time based upon the response behavior information, the kinds, positions, and sizes of the estimated furniture in the room, and the time history response waveform predicted from the first point of time to the second point of time.SELECTED DRAWING: Figure 7

title_en: Building structure earthquake resistance monitoring method and system
abstract_en: The invention relates to the field of building structure safety detection, and discloses a building structure anti-seismic performance monitoring method and system. The method comprises the steps of collecting multisource response data such as acceleration, displacement, strain and inclination angle, obtaining structural standard response based on wavelet denoising and standardization processing, extracting structural dynamic characteristic parameters by adopting a multi-order modal identification algorithm, carrying out structural damage assessment based on modal change indexes, calculating the residual bearing capacity of the structure by fusing yield strength, load index and displacement margin, and finally outputting an earthquake-resistant grade early warning signal. The system comprises a structural response acquisition module, a modal identification and damage assessment module and a residual bearing capacity calculation and early warning module. The invention can realize real-time quantitative analysis of the performance of the structure under the action of earthquake or load, has high evaluation precision and strong applicability, and has wide engineering popularization value.
assignees: PINGMEI SHENMA CONSTRUCTION ENG GROUP NO 1 CONSTRUCTION ENG CO LTD;PINGMEI SHENMA CONSTRUCTION & ENG GROUP CO LTD

title_en: Method for calculating explosion damage range of ground nucleus
abstract_en: The invention provides a method for calculating the damage range of a ground-touching nuclear explosion, which comprises the steps of decomposing nuclear explosion energy into four main components, namely impact wave energy flow, heat radiation energy flow, earthquake wave energy flow and electromagnetic pulse energy flow. And constructing a heterogeneous medium model comprising an atmosphere model and a geological model, generating a joint map by fusing the topographic and geological data, and describing the spatial correlation of the topographic and the stratum. And calculating the shock wave and thermal radiation propagation by using a nonlinear wave equation and a dynamic atmospheric transmittance model, and evaluating the influence of the seismic waves and electromagnetic pulses. And establishing a damage probability mapping relation by adopting a fuzzy logic algorithm, drawing a nuclear explosion damage range diagram, and dynamically updating by a Bayesian learning module. The invention improves the accuracy of the nuclear explosion damage assessment through the multi-physical field coupling analysis and the dynamic learning mechanism.

title_en: Storm disaster loss assessment method and system based on machine learning
abstract_en: The invention discloses a method and a system for evaluating the storm disaster loss based on machine learning, wherein the method comprises the steps of taking data of a storm disaster data source of a preset area in a specified time period as data to be analyzed, dividing the preset area according to the data to be analyzed based on rainfall, taking the preset area larger than a rainfall threshold as a disaster area, otherwise taking the preset area as an uncertain area, calculating the destructive power of the uncertain area according to a hydrological mechanism and a drainage system, adding the uncertain area larger than the destructive power threshold into the disaster area, carrying out comprehensive risk analysis on the data to be analyzed of the disaster area to obtain a comprehensive risk index, calculating the damage degree index of the disaster area, carrying out real-time dynamic evaluation on the disaster area according to the damage degree index and the comprehensive risk index to obtain a loss index, constructing a storm disaster loss evaluation model according to the loss index, and outputting an evaluation result.
assignees: CMA METEOROLOGICAL DEVELOPMENT AND PLANNING INST

title_en: Building economic loss assessment method and device under coupling effect of earthquake and secondary fire
abstract_en: The invention provides a building economic loss assessment method and device under the coupling effect of earthquake and secondary fire, and relates to the technical field of earthquake engineering. The method comprises the steps of obtaining damage states of a building structure after earthquake through nonlinear time-course analysis according to earthquake input data, establishing a secondary fire CFD analysis model, determining the highest probability ignition point according to the position of inflammable and explosive components, carrying out CFD analysis, outputting temperature field data and smoke spreading data of the structural entity part, the non-structural entity part and the outer surface part of each component, carrying out analysis according to the temperature field data to obtain damage states of the structural part and the non-structural part of each component, obtaining smoke pollution conditions of the outer surface of each component according to the smoke spreading data, further calculating to obtain economic losses of each component, and summarizing losses of all components to obtain total loss of the building. The invention fills the technical blank of multi-disaster coupling loss evaluation, and provides more effective and scientific decision basis for post-earthquake emergency and reconstruction.

title_en: Precise insurance claim-bearing system and method based on satellite remote sensing and unmanned aerial vehicle
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of agricultural insurance claims, in particular to a precise insurance claim system and method based on satellite remote sensing and unmanned aerial vehicle, comprising an insurance module, a management module and a management module, wherein the insurance module is used for identifying crop information of an insurance land by using satellite remote sensing images when the insurance is applied, verifying the crop information of the insurance land by using crop images acquired by the unmanned aerial vehicle when the insurance is applied, and generating an insurance policy; and the claim settlement module is used for evaluating disaster-stricken information of the insurance land by combining satellite remote sensing images before and after disaster-stricken with crop images acquired by the unmanned aerial vehicle after disaster-stricken and generating a claim settlement form. The invention applies unmanned aerial vehicle to check the satellite remote sensing technology support data in the support stage, provides a full-flying image material support for the support, and utilizes the multi-mode image fused by unmanned aerial vehicle images and satellite remote sensing images in the damage assessment process in the claim settlement stage to more accurately judge the growth condition and the loss degree of farmlands.
assignees: ANHUI QIAN MO NETWORK TECH CO LTD

title_en: Urban earthquake disaster risk and loss big data evaluation platform
abstract_en: The urban earthquake disaster risk and loss big data evaluation platform disclosed by the application is used for modeling from three aspects of earthquake disaster factor risk, disaster-bearing body vulnerability and urban earthquake disaster response capability, evaluating the earthquake risk of the earthquake-prone city by adopting a big data analysis method based on multi-index decision, integrating a GIS technology with an earthquake disaster loss matrix evaluation method based on historical big data, establishing an earthquake disaster loss evaluation system, and evaluating and calculating the earthquake disaster loss condition in an area. Before an earthquake occurs, the method analyzes and predicts the risk degree or probability that the area is likely to suffer from the earthquake, helps government to scientifically and effectively carry out urban development planning and disaster prevention and reduction decision, improves regional disaster prevention capacity construction, reduces earthquake disaster condition loss, improves emergency rescue and response capacity after the earthquake occurs, facilitates the distribution and scheduling of disaster relief materials, and has practical significance and effect on regional earthquake risk degree and loss assessment.

title_en: Disaster site multidimensional image cooperative processing method based on unmanned aerial vehicle-satellite cooperation
abstract_en: The invention discloses a disaster site multidimensional image cooperative processing method based on unmanned aerial vehicle-satellite cooperation. The method comprises the steps of obtaining multisource heterogeneous image data, carrying out space synchronization preprocessing, achieving time stamp correction through constructing a communication delay prediction model, then adopting a segmentation processing strategy driven by boundary evidence intensity, establishing a three-dimensional evaluation system based on time evidence, space evidence and consistency evidence, carrying out differential registration processing on image boundaries, achieving balance between boundary information and continuity under a constraint optimization framework through a boundary continuity constraint propagation mechanism and a sliding window reconstruction technology, carrying out quality perception multidimensional image fusion, and outputting a high-precision disaster situation map and a loss evaluation result. The method solves the technical problems of low image registration precision and ghost boundary generated by boundary fusion under heterogeneous timestamps, and improves the accuracy and reliability of disaster loss assessment.
assignees: GANSU HUIENYUAN EMERGENCY EQUIPMENT CO LTD

title_en: Earthquake damage assessment method based on wavelet transformation and deep convolution neural network
abstract_en: The invention discloses a seismic damage assessment method based on wavelet transformation and a deep convolutional neural network, which relates to the technical field of seismic engineering and comprises the following steps that 1, building information of a target area is obtained, the target area is simulated, a plurality of seismic records are generated, and damage labels are added to the buildings recorded by the seismic records; the method comprises the steps of step 2, carrying out wavelet transformation on earthquake motion time courses in earthquake motion records to generate a multi-scale two-dimensional time-frequency energy diagram, step 3, constructing a data set by one-to-one correspondence of building information, the multi-scale two-dimensional time-frequency energy diagram and damage labels, step 4, constructing and training an earthquake damage assessment model, and step 5, carrying out earthquake damage assessment based on the trained earthquake damage assessment model. The method can realize intelligent identification of the earthquake damage level, and is suitable for application scenes such as post-earthquake rapid evaluation, key area screening, auxiliary emergency decision and the like.

title_en: Building damage assessment classification method and device
abstract_en: The invention provides a building damage assessment classification method and device, the method comprises the steps of obtaining classification information and geographical position information of a plurality of buildings according to social media data, obtaining correlation coefficients of pixel points corresponding to the buildings before and after a earthquake according to remote sensing image data, carrying out space superposition on the classification information and the geographical position information and the remote sensing image data corresponding to the buildings respectively, determining a correlation area of the buildings according to each building in the remote sensing image data after space superposition, determining a correlation coefficient value range according to the correlation coefficients corresponding to the pixel points in the correlation area, fitting the building damage degree corresponding to the correlation area and the correlation coefficient value range, and determining classification thresholds of the buildings according to fitting results to obtain damage assessment classification results of the buildings. The method provided by the invention realizes the automation of the pixel level classification combined with the building level polymerization and the damage assessment flow, and meets the rapid response requirement of a large-scale disaster area.
assignees: AEROSPACE INFORMATION RESEARCH INSTITUTE CHINESE ACADEMY OF SCIENCES

title_en: Building earthquake damage assessment method, earthquake damage assessment model training method and electronic system
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of buildings, in particular to a building earthquake damage assessment method, an earthquake damage assessment model training method and an electronic system. The building earthquake damage assessment method comprises the steps of obtaining real-time building vibration data of a target building, extracting characteristic parameters of the real-time building vibration data based on a time domain analysis and a frequency domain analysis, and inputting the characteristic parameters of the real-time building vibration data into an earthquake damage assessment model to obtain an earthquake damage assessment result of the target building. The earthquake damage assessment model training method comprises the steps of establishing a building vibration database, extracting characteristic parameters of building vibration data based on time domain analysis and frequency domain analysis methods, obtaining parameter information of an artificial neural network, and training based on the parameter information of the artificial neural network to obtain an earthquake damage assessment model. According to the method, through a mode of extracting the characteristic parameters, the key information of the real-time building vibration data can be fully reflected by the model input data, so that the reliability of the earthquake damage assessment result is ensured.

title_en: High-definition image rapid reconstruction method for concrete plastic hinge region identification
abstract_en: The application provides a high-definition image rapid reconstruction method for identifying a concrete plastic hinge region, which is particularly used for carrying out damage assessment on a plastic hinge region which is a key part of a beam column node in a reinforced concrete frame structure after an earthquake, and comprises the steps of recovering the details of a covered cross inclined crack according to the texture characteristics of a removed shelter image set and a fused dust deposition covering region to obtain a complete crack form image set; and (3) optimizing the reconstruction of the three-dimensional space by combining the updated spalling depth damage model through the point cloud data of unmanned aerial vehicle oblique photography, generating a final damage model, outputting the space spreading of the crossed oblique cracks, and outputting the visualized three-dimensional reconstruction results of the spalling depth of the concrete and the buckling form of the steel bars, and generating a damage state image of the plastic hinge region. The method provides powerful technical support for accurately evaluating the safety of the post-earthquake structure.

title_en: Building disaster damage prediction method based on deep learning and multi-scale images
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of building damage detection, in particular to a building disaster damage prediction method based on deep learning and multi-scale images. The method comprises the steps of obtaining a double-time-phase remote sensing image, an unmanned aerial vehicle image and a local image of a building group and an image of the building group to be detected, respectively building a macroscopic damage evaluation model, a mesoscopic damage evaluation model and a microscopic damage evaluation model according to the double-time-phase remote sensing image, the unmanned aerial vehicle image and the local image, carrying out damage judgment on a seismic area which has occurred to obtain a damage state and related parameters of the building, building a building damage prediction model, training the building damage prediction model according to the damage state and related parameters of the building, obtaining related parameters of an unknown area, and carrying out damage prediction on the building by utilizing the trained building damage prediction model. The invention improves the complex disaster environment characterization capability and the multi-source data collaborative analysis capability, and ensures the accuracy of the building disaster damage assessment result.

title_en: Method and system for surveying damaged area of geological disaster
abstract_en: The invention discloses a method and a system for surveying damaged areas of geological disasters, which relate to the technical field of the investigation of damaged areas, the method comprises disaster area division, light area survey analysis, heavy area survey analysis and early warning prompt, and the method comprises the steps of preliminary area division of geological disaster areas, further allocating corresponding survey equipment for different areas, carrying out the investigation of different areas, judging whether each light area has new damage forms, analyzing whether tail association damage is formed between each heavy area and adjacent side areas, the damaged areas corresponding to the light target areas and the damaged areas corresponding to the heavy areas are determined, so that the damaged areas corresponding to the geological disaster areas are defined, effective data references are provided for subsequent disaster maintenance or disaster risk prediction, the solid state thinking that only obvious damaged areas are surveyed when geological disaster damage surveys are broken, and effective survey of the geological disaster damaged areas is realized.
assignees: CHINA CHEMICAL GEOLOGY AND MINE BUREAU SHANDNG GELOGICAL PROSPECTING INST

title_en: Method for evaluating performance perception and post-earthquake functional loss of large-span transportation hub structure in high-intensity earthquake region
abstract_en: The invention discloses a method for evaluating the performance perception and the post-earthquake functional loss of a large-span transportation hub structure in a high-intensity earthquake region, and relates to the technical fields of health monitoring and damage identification of important building structures. The method comprises the steps of obtaining high-fidelity power response data and low-fidelity power response data of a large-span traffic junction structure under the action of an earthquake, constructing a multi-fidelity structure response data set, establishing a data-physical driven large-span traffic junction structure earthquake response prediction model to obtain physical damage of the structure under the action of the earthquake, establishing a correlation mechanism between the physical damage and the functional loss of a large-span traffic junction main body structure and non-structural members under the action of the earthquake, determining weight coefficients of functional damage assessment indexes, and establishing a large-span traffic junction structure post-earthquake functional loss assessment model. The method adopts a multi-source data fusion method to establish a cross-modal collaborative sensing method for the behavior of the large-span traffic junction structure, so as to realize the rapid and accurate sensing of the behavior damage state of the large-span traffic junction structure.

title_en: Multi-source collaborative remote sensing debris flow full-period monitoring and analyzing method
abstract_en: The invention discloses a full-period monitoring analysis method of multi-source collaborative remote sensing mud-rock flow, which comprises the following steps of 1, obtaining multi-source remote sensing data and land utilization vector data, establishing a full-period monitoring basic database, 2, preprocessing the collected multi-source remote sensing data and land utilization vector data to form standardized space basic data of a unified space coordinate system, 3, analyzing and processing the standardized space basic data to obtain disaster conditions, and 4, planning an emergency evacuation plan, manufacturing a disaster damage assessment report and monitoring post-disaster repair progress based on the analyzed disaster conditions. The invention builds a high-efficiency and expandable debris flow full-period technical system through four core innovations of standardized flow, dynamic collaborative monitoring, low-cost change detection and disaster-bearing body refined analysis, and has stronger popularization universality.
assignees: FUZHOU INVESTIG AND SURVEYING INSTITUTE CO LTD

title_en: Disaster damage assessment device and method
abstract_en: The invention relates to a disaster damage assessment device and method, which relate to the technical field of flood risk assessment and are characterized in that a standardized data base is constructed by integrating meteorological, hydrological, geographic and asset data, dynamic characteristics such as submerged depth, duration and the like are extracted by adopting a gridding space correlation technology, a multidimensional characteristic library is built by combining disaster-bearing body attributes, a linear, exponential, logarithmic, stair and correction exponential function family is innovatively utilized, a refined loss rate curve is generated through clustering analysis, and the loss estimation precision is remarkably improved. And various asset losses under different water depth grades are quantized by combining a spatial analysis algorithm, all elements of houses, agriculture, industry, business and infrastructure are covered, and flood evolution and loss distribution are visually displayed through a dynamic visual platform. The method breaks through the bottleneck of the traditional technology, provides space-time accurate quantitative support for flood control decisions, and effectively improves timeliness and scientificity of disaster response.
assignees: YELLOW RIVER INSTITUTE OF HYDRAULIC RES;INNER MONGOLIA AUTONOMOUS REGION FLOOD DROUGHT DISASTER PREVENTION TECH CENTER

title_en: Flood regulation and control two-stage reverse deduction method under large-scale river basin complex engineering system
abstract_en: The invention discloses a flood regulation and control two-stage reverse deduction method under a large-scale river basin complex engineering system, which comprises the steps of S1, constructing a river basin flood deduction model, constructing a flood control engineering system joint scheduling and flood control coupling model according to river basin water system and flood control engineering characteristics, carrying out flood influence and disaster loss assessment based on the coupling model, S2, constructing a calculation frame based on the flood deduction model and an intelligent optimization algorithm, taking the minimum total disasters as reverse deduction targets, taking the minimum river channel flooding and flood diversion volumes as hard constraint conditions, iteratively optimizing scheduling parameters such as dynamic adjustment water volume, opening and the like, carrying out reverse deduction by a reverse deduction mechanism, and generating an optimal scheduling scheme taking both flood control safety and disaster loss control into account. The method has the advantages that the method can realize rapid and refined reverse deduction and meet the actual demands of river basin flood evolution refined deduction, rapid and optimized generation of engineering regulation and control schemes and the like.

title_en: Disaster prevention and control refined division method based on map data
abstract_en: The invention discloses a disaster prevention and control refined region method based on map data, which comprises the following steps of S10, S20, comprehensively selecting prevention and control candidate regions through risk assessment, vulnerability assessment and disaster damage assessment, S30, constructing an index system from three dimensions of dangers, exponents and vulnerabilities, S40, quantifying indexes based on the map data and investigation data, calculating weight of each index by combining information entropy, S50, calculating comprehensive indexes of all assessment units by adopting a Jenks natural fracture method, and S60, and defining disaster prevention and control key regions by combining actual management department experience and comprehensive index refinement. The invention is convenient for later management, avoids a large number of repeated works, and has stronger objectivity and reference value.
assignees: SHANGHAI WATER ENG DESIGN & RES INST CO LTD

title_en: Bridge pier seismic damage assessment method
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the technical field of high pier damage assessment, and relates to a high pier seismic damage assessment method. The method comprises the steps of determining the number and positions of plastic hinges of a pier body of a high pier through seismic response analysis, dividing the high pier into a plurality of sections of low piers, calculating the pier top drift ratio of each section of low piers, obtaining a high pier damage index by taking the maximum value of the absolute values of the pier top drift ratios of all the low piers, counting and establishing a hollow pier damage grade threshold based on test data, and determining the damage grade of the high pier according to the corresponding relation between the high pier damage index and the damage grade threshold. The method can describe bending damage and shearing damage of the reinforced concrete bridge pier at the same time, can obtain more accurate and safer earthquake damage estimation results aiming at the reinforced concrete hollow high pier, and solves the problem of inaccurate high pier shearing effect and high-order vibration type multi-bending damage estimation.

title_en: Overhead transmission line fault loss assessment method based on spherical fuzzy and entropy weight method
abstract_en: The invention provides an overhead transmission line fault loss assessment method based on a spherical fuzzy and entropy weight method, and relates to the technical field of transmission line fault loss assessment. The method comprises the steps of S1 obtaining natural disaster data of a line area to be evaluated, S2 dividing fault loss into a plurality of evaluation dimensions, constructing a layered fault loss evaluation system by taking natural disasters as influence factors, S3 calculating fault loss cost of each evaluation dimension under different natural disasters based on the disaster data, S4 quantifying influence degree of the natural disasters on each evaluation dimension by using a fuzzy set theory and calculating subjective weight, S5 calculating objective weight of each evaluation dimension by using an entropy weight method, S6 determining comprehensive weight by using a subjective and objective weight fusion model, and evaluating fault loss of the overhead transmission line based on the comprehensive weight. In the whole life cycle cost calculation, fault loss assessment is added, so that the accurate quantification of multidimensional loss is realized, and the reliability of the circuit is improved in the later circuit design process.
assignees: CENTRAL CHINA BRANCH STATE GRID CORP CHINA;UNIV WUHAN

title_en: Multi-disaster vulnerability analysis method and system for large-span cable-supported bridge
abstract_en: The invention provides a method and a system for analyzing multi-disaster vulnerability of a large-span cable-supported bridge, and belongs to the technical field of multi-disaster vulnerability analysis of bridges based on mathematical models. According to the invention, a multi-disaster intensity-structure response sample of the large-span cable-and-socket bridge is obtained based on nonlinear time-course dynamic analysis, a KDE technology is introduced to capture data distribution characteristics and accurately establish edge cumulative distribution of the data distribution characteristics, a C-vine Copula is introduced to describe complex correlation of the data distribution characteristics and establish a multi-element joint probability distribution model, and structural damage probability is solved through inverse fitting of the joint probability distribution model. The invention can effectively overcome the defect that the existing vulnerability analysis method cannot give consideration to calculation accuracy and analysis efficiency, and provides a reliable and efficient technical means for multi-disaster damage assessment of the large-span cable-supported bridge.

title_en: Damage assessment method and system for shallow foundation bridge under flood disaster
abstract_en: The invention discloses a damage assessment method under a shallow foundation bridge flood disaster, which comprises the steps of constructing a finite element model of the shallow foundation bridge, introducing uncertainty of flood level height, foundation flushing pit length and flushing depth by using a random Pushover method, obtaining bridge pier top yield displacement of the shallow foundation bridge under a plurality of groups of flushing working conditions, calculating first two-order moment of the structure flood fighting capability logarithm, obtaining flood fighting capability, carrying out flood fighting requirement analysis on response of the shallow foundation bridge under different flood flushing environments based on a finite element reliability method, comparing the flood fighting capability with the requirement analysis, assessing failure probability of the shallow foundation bridge under different working conditions, and fitting through a least square method to generate a vulnerability curve of the shallow foundation bridge. The damage assessment method under the flood disasters of the shallow foundation bridge can quantify the influence of multiple factors such as flow velocity, scouring depth and the like on the performance of the shallow foundation bridge, and effectively assess the damage states of all levels of the shallow foundation bridge.

title_en: Rapid extraction method for zero-sample visual large-model damaged bridge in emergency scene
abstract_en: The application provides a method for quickly extracting a zero-sample visual large-model damaged bridge in an emergency scene. Relates to the technical field of disaster damage bridge extraction. The method comprises the steps of extracting bridge linear elements from road data, combining two bridge linear element lines representing double lanes into single-lane elements, obtaining bridge linear data, carrying out spatial position correction and attribute fusion by using auxiliary data, obtaining a disaster bridge linear database, extracting bridge images, inputting the bridge images and preset prompt words into a large model, outputting bridge states and bridge characteristics, judging damage conditions of a bridge based on the output bridge states, associating the disaster bridge linear database to match corresponding bridge geographic information, and obtaining the geographic information of the damaged bridge. The method can realize quick association and accurate acquisition of the geographical information of the damaged bridge in the emergency scene, greatly shortens the disaster damage assessment period, and provides high-efficiency data support for rescue and relief decisions.

title_en: Urban storm flood disaster loss assessment method and device
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of flood disaster loss evaluation, and discloses an urban storm flood disaster loss evaluation method and device, wherein the method comprises the steps of constructing an urban storm flood disaster body library; the urban storm flood disaster body library comprises a plurality of concept bodies, the plurality of concept bodies comprise disaster causing factor bodies, disaster bearing body bodies, disaster inducing environment bodies, disaster prevention and reduction capability bodies and disaster condition loss bodies, urban storm flood disaster data are obtained, knowledge extraction and knowledge fusion are carried out on the urban storm flood disaster data based on the urban storm flood disaster body library, urban storm flood disaster knowledge patterns are obtained, urban storm flood disaster loss is predicted and evaluated based on the urban storm flood disaster knowledge patterns, and urban storm flood disaster loss evaluation results are obtained by utilizing a graph roll-up neural network model. The method improves the accuracy of urban storm flood disaster loss assessment and provides a decision basis for optimization of disaster prevention and reduction decisions.

title_en: Disaster event electric pole loss assessment method, system and equipment based on image recognition
abstract_en: The invention provides a disaster event electric pole loss assessment method, system and equipment based on image identification, which are applied to the technical field of power transmission and distribution. The method comprises the steps of obtaining real-time pole images of the pole in a disaster scene, inputting the real-time pole images into a pre-trained pole loss evaluation model, determining real-time loss evaluation index values of the pole under various loss evaluation indexes based on the pole loss evaluation model, and determining a loss evaluation result of the pole according to the real-time loss evaluation index values of the pole under various loss evaluation indexes. The method can rapidly and accurately detect the real-time electric pole image in the disaster scene based on the electric pole loss evaluation model, determine the loss condition of the electric pole, provide accurate loss information for electric power companies and emergency repair personnel, and is beneficial to optimizing the emergency repair scheme and rapidly recovering the electric power supply.
assignees: CHINA ELECTRIC POWER RES INST CO LTD;STATE GRID JIANGSU ELECTRIC POWER CO RES INST;STATE GRID CORP CHINA

title_en: Flood network flood bank flooding simulation and disaster damage assessment method
abstract_en: The invention discloses a flood network flood bank flooding simulation and disaster damage assessment method, and belongs to the technical field of flood control and disaster reduction. The method comprises the steps of carrying out hydrodynamic analysis based on hydrologic geographic data to determine a potential overtop area, simulating the evolution of a bursting mouth based on accumulated scouring energy criteria aiming at the potential overtop area to generate a bursting mouth flow process, simulating flood evolution according to the bursting mouth flow process to generate a spatial disaster intensity field, and evaluating direct and indirect economic losses by combining the disaster intensity field and social economic data to generate a comprehensive disaster loss result. The invention introduces physical criteria based on accumulated scouring energy, adopts comprehensive strength indexes, three-dimensional vulnerability curved surfaces and applies graph neural networks to simulate cascade failure, and solves the problems of missing of a breach triggering mechanism, single disaster intensity measurement and static disaster damage assessment.

title_en: Multi-disaster coupling damage early warning and intelligent monitoring system for full service life of split prefabricated mixed tower
abstract_en: The invention discloses a full-life multi-disaster coupled damage early warning and intelligent monitoring system of a split prefabricated mixed tower, which relates to the technical field of structural health monitoring and damage assessment and comprises a data acquisition module, a damage transfer modeling module, a damage transfer network diagram and an intelligent monitoring system, wherein the data acquisition module is used for acquiring stress data and environmental difference expression data of each split under a complex condition, comprehensively processing the stress distribution and environmental response to obtain initial damage state distribution of each split, the damage transfer modeling module is used for constructing a damage transfer network diagram according to the initial damage state distribution and the influence of contact surfaces and connection parts among the split, and determining a damage transfer potential path.
assignees: HENAN CHENGJIAN INSPECTION AND TESTING TECH CO LTD;UNIV ZHENGZHOU

title_en: Insurance claim settlement method, device, equipment and medium based on picture identification
abstract_en: The application relates to the technical field of image recognition and discloses an insurance claim settlement method, device, equipment and medium based on image recognition, which comprise the steps of receiving a crop disaster-affected picture to be recognized, and preprocessing the crop disaster-affected picture to obtain a standardized picture; analyzing the standardized pictures through a pre-trained image recognition model to obtain analysis results, wherein the analysis results comprise a plurality of disaster characteristic indexes, damage assessment information is generated based on the plurality of disaster characteristic indexes through preset damage assessment judging logic, the damage assessment information comprises disaster types and loss area proportions, insurance claim settlement amount corresponding to the crop disaster-affected pictures is determined according to the damage assessment information, and the insurance claim settlement amount is increased to a claim settlement platform for claim settlement processing. The application can be applied to a financial science and technology business program system, and can improve the accuracy and efficiency of claim settlement processing and reduce the period of claim settlement and the operation cost.
assignees: CHINA PING AN PROPERTY INSURANCE CO LTD

title_en: Artificial intelligence-based natural disaster damage intelligent assessment method and system
abstract_en: The application discloses an artificial intelligence-based natural disaster damage intelligent assessment method and system, which are characterized by acquiring images and disaster sensitive factors in a restoration period through a satellite remote sensing technology, performing intelligent interpretation of land utilization types, generating a grid layer, simultaneously automatically extracting geological disaster stress factors, innovatively coupling InVEST an ecological environment quality assessment model and an AI disaster damage assessment engine, synchronously calculating an ecological environment quality index and a disaster damage risk index, generating an ecological quality thermodynamic diagram and a disaster sensitive dynamic map, analyzing an ecological quality space pattern evolution rule by adopting a space-time-space diagram convolution network, combining a natural disaster damage degree-disaster resistance correlation matrix to quantify a synergistic effect, and finally realizing multi-dimensional visual deduction of natural disaster damage degree and disaster resistance in a three-dimensional digital twin platform to form an ecological restoration-disaster toughness double-target intelligent assessment loop.
assignees: SICHUAN HUADI CONSTRUCTION ENG CO LTD;SICHUAN GEOLOGICAL SURVEY RES CENTER

title_en: Photovoltaic power station disaster damage assessment method and system
abstract_en: The invention discloses a method and a system for evaluating disaster damage of a photovoltaic power station, which comprise the steps of generating a simulated wind speed working condition set matched with a current photovoltaic power station based on strong wind speed and photovoltaic power station data, traversing the simulated wind speed working condition set, calculating loss probability contribution of each simulated wind speed working condition when acting on the current photovoltaic power station, counting loss probability contribution corresponding to all simulated wind speed working conditions to obtain loss ratio probability of the photovoltaic power station, carrying out Bayesian updating iteration on photovoltaic vulnerability priori distribution by using the loss ratio probability of the photovoltaic power station to obtain photovoltaic vulnerability posterior distribution as post-disaster loss probability distribution, and providing reference for typhoon disaster evaluation and typhoon prevention measures of the photovoltaic power station.
assignees: HEFEI INST PUBLIC SAFETY RES TSINGHUA UNIV

title_en: Typhoon disaster risk assessment method for quantifying wind and rain combined loss
abstract_en: The invention discloses a typhoon disaster risk assessment method for quantifying wind and rain combined loss, which belongs to the field of typhoon disaster risk early warning and loss assessment and comprises the steps of determining a typhoon core disaster area grid range based on typhoon center path data and wind circle size data, constructing a typhoon wind and rain comprehensive index by utilizing a wind speed and rainfall rasterization data sequence, scientifically distributing the counted county-level typhoon disaster direct economic loss to a grid scale, and constructing a typhoon disaster vulnerability curve model by adopting a four-parameter Logistics function to fit by taking the calculated typhoon wind and rain comprehensive index as an independent variable and the rasterized typhoon disaster direct economic loss statistical data as a dependent variable.
