According to the invention, the mathematical relationship between the economic loss and the disaster intensity is established by constructing the typhoon vulnerability curve model considering the wind and rain disaster causing capability, so that the limitation of the traditional qualitative assessment method is overcome, and a scientific and accurate quantitative basis is provided for the economic influence of typhoon disasters.

title_en: Rural building group flood disaster loss assessment method and system
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the technical field of building group flood influence analysis, and provides a method and a system for evaluating the flood disaster loss of a rural building group, aiming at the problem that the accuracy of an evaluation result is low due to the fact that uncertainty factors in the loss evaluation process are not fully considered in the existing building flood loss function; comparing the submerged depth map with SAR image water body extraction data and social media data to obtain a flood simulation result, combining building classification information and the maximum submerged depth map to obtain submerged depth of each building, calculating component information of the building, analyzing building flood vulnerability according to the component information and the submerged depth to determine total loss of all buildings, and evaluating the effect of the current disaster prevention measures according to the total loss under different disaster prevention measures. The invention can provide scientific basis for building flood loss assessment and disaster prevention decision.
assignees: NO 4 ENG CORP LTD OF CR20G;UNIV XIAN ARCHITECTUR & TECH;CHINA RAILWAY 20 BUREAU GROUP CORP

title_en: Space-time spectrum combined super-resolution reconstruction method based on giant remote sensing star group
abstract_en: The invention discloses a space-time spectrum combined super-resolution reconstruction method based on a huge remote sensing star group, which comprises the steps of collecting time sequence, multi-view and multi-spectrum data of the same area from a plurality of heterogeneous satellites, carrying out radiometric calibration and atmospheric correction, adopting a combined registration model to realize sub-pixel level alignment of multi-source data, utilizing three-dimensional convolution to extract time variation characteristics, two-dimensional convolution to extract space structure and texture characteristics, one-dimensional convolution to extract and dimension-reduction spectrum characteristics, carrying out self-adaptive weighted fusion on the time, space and spectrum characteristics through a attention mechanism to generate a combined characteristic tensor, and carrying out super-resolution reconstruction to obtain a target image with high space resolution, high time resolution and high spectrum fidelity. The method gives consideration to resolution improvement and spectrum authenticity, and is suitable for high-precision remote sensing application scenes such as fine city mapping, agricultural monitoring, ecological environment assessment, disaster emergency and battlefield situation sensing, remote reconnaissance, target change detection, damage assessment and the like.

title_en: Method and system for rapidly generating reservoir flood control scheduling temporary inundation area based on DEM
abstract_en: The invention discloses a method and a device for rapidly generating a temporary flooding area of reservoir flood control scheduling based on a DEM (digital elevation model), and relates to the field of defining the temporary flooding area of hydraulic and hydroelectric engineering. The method comprises the steps of dividing a river channel higher than a reservoir inundation area into a plurality of units by obtaining or generating a water return table of the reservoir section DEM, a river channel section line, a normal water storage level inundation area range and different working conditions, calculating the grid water level of each unit by interpolation through an inverse distance weighting method, comparing the grid water level with the DEM elevation to determine a grid conforming to the condition, merging the units after boundary tracking and smoothing treatment, and erasing the normal water storage level inundation area to obtain a temporary inundation area. The method solves the problems of long time consumption and insufficient precision of the existing method, combines efficiency and precision, and provides reliable support for flood control scheduling decision, flood loss assessment and the like.
assignees: CHANGJIANG INST SURVEY PLANNING DESIGN & RES CO LTD

title_en: Distribution network fault disaster analysis and intelligent disposal decision system based on big data and artificial intelligence
abstract_en: The invention discloses a distribution network fault disaster analysis and intelligent treatment decision-making system based on big data and artificial intelligence, and relates to the technical field of distribution network fault treatment of power systems. The system integrates multi-source heterogeneous data through a data intelligent acquisition module and realizes topology communication of a main distribution network, and utilizes a disaster damage analysis module to combine algorithms such as random forests, CNNs, graph convolution neural networks and the like to realize accurate fault identification and positioning, influence range evaluation and economic loss quantification, and relies on an intelligent decision module to construct a closed-loop management system and generate an optimal disposal strategy and preventive maintenance suggestion. The invention solves the problems of delay in disaster damage assessment, insufficient positioning precision, dependence on manual experience in traditional distribution network fault treatment, and the like, realizes quick and accurate positioning of faults, dynamic disaster damage assessment and intelligent decision support, remarkably improves the response efficiency and the power supply reliability of the faults, and promotes the distribution network operation and maintenance to be transformed to an active defense and intelligent decision mode.
assignees: ZHENGZHOU POWER SUPPLY CO OF STATE GRID HANAN ELECTRIC POWER CO

title_en: Rapid evaluation method for building seismic losses
abstract_en: S1, collecting and integrating multi-source seismic intensity data, including seismic intensity images issued by Chinese emergency management departments and seismic authorities and related data provided by USGS, breaking through the limitation of traditional seismic disaster loss assessment in terms of data singleness and timeliness through deep fusion and dynamic adaptation of the multi-source data, comprehensively utilizing remote sensing observation, field investigation, real-time dynamic monitoring information and building full life cycle parameters to ensure the reliability of the data, optimizing a building vulnerability curve by means of an intelligent model, correcting by combining regional space heterogeneity, and effectively improving the assessment precision of the building seismic damage degree. Further, by fine quantification of building damage distribution and economic loss, closed loop from data acquisition to building seismic loss evaluation to auxiliary decision making is realized.

title_en: Regional earthquake building group assessment and resource allocation method, device and system
abstract_en: The invention discloses a regional earthquake damage building group assessment and resource allocation method, device and system, and belongs to the technical field of earthquake disaster emergency management and building safety assessment. Aiming at the problems of long assessment period, single standard, lack of global optimization of resource allocation and strong network dependence in the prior art, the invention constructs a regional feature matrix by fusing multi-source data and generates a self-adaptive assessment parameter set to dynamically select an optimal building earthquake damage assessment model, adopts an improved multi-objective evolutionary algorithm to generate a local Pareto optimal resource scheduling scheme at an edge node, and realizes global fusion and real-time dynamic update of the scheme by relying on a cloud side collaborative architecture. The method can be used for rapid damage evaluation and intelligent optimization scheduling of rescue resources of regional building groups after earthquake disaster.

title_en: Fine detection method for three-dimensional structure damage of post-disaster building by air-ground combination
abstract_en: The invention discloses a post-disaster building three-dimensional structure damage fine detection method by air-ground combination, which belongs to the technical field of post-disaster emergency building damage assessment and comprises the steps of collecting post-disaster building air-map images and preprocessing, registering and fusing point clouds of a fast point characteristic histogram FPFH characteristic and iterative closest point ICP, carrying out data enhancement by using CT-3DGAN, and carrying out fine segmentation on the building three-dimensional damage based on CD-PointNet ++. The invention provides an improved iterative closest point ICP algorithm based on ground and aviation data to ensure high-precision registration, particularly under the scene of large point cloud noise and low overlapping rate, a CT-3DGAN model integrates three-dimensional convolution and three-dimensional transform in a generation contrast network GAN frame, a three-dimensional building damage data set is expanded, representativeness is enhanced, training of a deep learning model is promoted, a CD-PointNet ++ model effectively identifies complex three-dimensional damage characteristics, and accurate segmentation of post-disaster building facade and roof damage is realized.

title_en: Transmission tower earthquake damage assessment and emergency response method and system based on multi-source data fusion
abstract_en: The invention discloses a transmission tower earthquake damage assessment and emergency response method and system with multi-source data fusion, wherein the method comprises the steps of collecting multi-source data of geological disasters of a transmission tower and preprocessing; establishing a dynamic transmission tower earthquake damage assessment model of multi-mode fusion-digital twin driving, assessing the preprocessed multi-source data, and generating a corresponding emergency response strategy based on an assessment result. According to the method, the multi-source data of the geological disasters of the transmission tower are analyzed and processed by utilizing the dynamic transmission tower earthquake damage assessment model driven by multi-mode fusion-digital twin, so that the current damage can be comprehensively assessed according to the multi-source data, the evolution trend under the aftershock and the secondary disasters can be accurately predicted, and the prospective early warning can be realized.
assignees: CSG EHV TRANS COMPANY BOSE BUREAU

title_en: Vibration loss assessment method and system based on gas pipeline and earthquake motion time course data
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of earthquake damage assessment, and provides an earthquake damage assessment method and system based on gas pipeline and earthquake motion time-course data, wherein gas pipeline parameters and actual measurement earthquake motion time-course data of a target area are obtained, preprocessed to obtain data to be assessed, and data accuracy is improved; the method comprises the steps of constructing a gas pipeline model library, collecting historical earthquake motion time course data, calculating based on the historical earthquake motion time course data and the gas pipeline model library to obtain a training sample set, training to obtain an earthquake damage assessment model, guaranteeing assessment accuracy and comprehensiveness of the earthquake damage assessment model, inputting to-be-assessed data into the earthquake damage assessment model to generate damage indexes of a target area, obtaining earthquake damage assessment results according to the damage indexes, guaranteeing instantaneity of the earthquake damage assessment results, obtaining geographic position information of the target area, and generating a thermodynamic diagram for intuitively displaying the earthquake damage severity distribution condition of the gas pipeline based on the geographic position information and the earthquake damage assessment results corresponding to the target area, so that timely maintenance and rescue are facilitated.

title_en: Post-earthquake structure assessment and restoration method and device based on two-stage time course analysis
abstract_en: The invention provides a post-earthquake structure assessment and repair method and device based on two-stage time-course analysis, and relates to the technical field of structure damage assessment. The method comprises the steps of carrying out two-stage elastoplastic time-course analysis on a multi-layer structure through a fiber beam model to obtain structural response data, constructing a deep learning model based on MLP and LSTM, predicting the structural response data of the second stage, carrying out weighted summation dimension reduction treatment on the predicted structural response data of the second stage through an evaluation index dimension reduction method to obtain a one-dimensional damage evaluation index after structural vibration, calculating 95% of the score of a probability density curve, constructing a one-dimensional damage evaluation index limit value of a structural mechanical response state as a damage grade division basis, and obtaining a post-vibration structural safety evaluation result and a repair decision according to the 95% score and the damage grade division basis.

title_en: Non-terrestrial narrow-band internet-of-things based integrated sensing and communication system focused on post-disaster building damage assessment and search and rescue
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a system (1) for determining the physical damage to structures or critically important buildings where living beings are present as a result of disasters, and for proposing a solution based on a high altitude International Mobile Telecommunications (IMT) base station with Integrated Sensing and Communications (ISAC) capability (6) for the detection of living beings that may be trapped under the debris of these structures due to the disaster.
assignees: TURKCELL TECHNOLOGY RESEARCH AND DEVELOPMENT CO;TURKCELL ILETISIM HIZMETLERI ANONIM SIRKETI

title_en: Flood loss assessment method and system based on carrier attribute and flooding characteristics
abstract_en: The invention discloses a flood loss evaluation method and a flood loss evaluation system based on carrier attributes and submerged characteristics, comprising the steps of acquiring carrier space data, submerged characteristic data and socioeconomic data, performing three-dimensional coordinate space transformation to realize space-time alignment, calculating to obtain a submerged overlapping area based on the aligned carrier space data and submerged characteristic data, constructing a four-dimensional enhancement layer for the submerged overlapping area, and calculating to obtain the enhancement strength of the four-dimensional enhancement layer Calculating submerged population by using space metering economic model in combination with aligned socioeconomic data And submerged area Creating a multi-scale assessment model to enhance the intensity Submerged population And submerged area Obtaining flood loss values as input evaluation . Compared with the traditional method, the method has the advantages that the coverage is improved, the whole process quantification from physical damage during disaster occurrence, social and economic linkage influence caused by the disaster to the post-disaster reconstruction cost is realized, and the traditional method is avoided to only pay attention to the unilateral property of direct loss in the disaster.
assignees: JIANGSU WATER CONSERVANCY SCI RES INST;NANJING HYDRAULIC RES INST

title_en: Typhoon claim disaster damage assessment method, device, equipment and medium
abstract_en: The application relates to the technical field of artificial intelligence, which is applied to a financial or medical insurance claim settlement scene, in particular to a typhoon claim disaster damage assessment method, a typhoon claim settlement device, typhoon disaster damage assessment equipment and a typhoon disaster damage assessment medium, and carrying out characteristic data identification on the multi-source typhoon data set, constructing a target claim settlement knowledge base according to the characteristic data, and inputting the acquired real-time typhoon data and early warning city information into a target claim settlement evaluation model based on the target claim settlement knowledge base to obtain a claim settlement evaluation result. Therefore, the application realizes the accurate assessment of typhoon settlement damage and promotes the insurance settlement efficiency by carrying out characteristic data identification on the multi-source typhoon dataset and constructing the target settlement knowledge base according to the characteristic data, and then inputting the acquired real-time typhoon data and early warning city information into the target settlement assessment model according to the target settlement knowledge base, thereby providing insurance settlement reference of typhoon disasters for insurance companies.
assignees: CHINA PING AN PROPERTY INSURANCE CO LTD

title_en: Post-disaster damage assessment method and device for power grid equipment, unmanned aerial vehicle and storage medium
abstract_en: The application relates to the technical field of power grid detection and discloses a post-disaster damage assessment method of power grid equipment, which comprises the following steps of collecting image data with a time stamp through an unmanned plane and synchronously receiving sensor time sequence data of a monitoring device; and dynamically calculating weights based on data quality, obtaining a final damage detection result through space-time registration and weighted fusion, and generating a visual report. The application fuses multi-source data and adopts a quality self-adaptive weighting mechanism, thereby effectively solving the problems of insufficient identification of the power grid detail structure and poor robustness of complex environment in the traditional visual detection, and remarkably improving the accuracy and reliability of post-disaster evaluation.
assignees: NUJIANG POWER SUPPLY BUREAU YUNNAN POWER GRID CO LTD

title_en: Dam flood discharge safety protection method and system based on earthquake response analysis
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the field of dam flood discharge safety, and provides a dam flood discharge safety protection method and system based on seismic response analysis, wherein S1, multisource environment and structure data are acquired in real time, S2, the multisource environment and the structure data are preprocessed to form a unified time sequence multidimensional data set, S3, structural dynamics response of a dam and a flood discharge gate is simulated and analyzed based on the unified time sequence multidimensional data set, potential damage is estimated, S4, comprehensive risk assessment is conducted by combining seismic response analysis and damage assessment results, hydrological data and flood discharge gate operation state data, early warning information is generated, S5, a dynamically adapted flood discharge gate opening and closing strategy is generated according to the comprehensive risk assessment results and the early warning information, S6, the flood discharge gate opening and closing strategy is executed, the flood discharge gate actual operation state is monitored in real time, the flood discharge gate actual operation state and the prediction strategy are analyzed in a comparison mode, and updating and optimizing are conducted according to analysis results.
assignees: POWERCHINA GUIYANG ENGINEERING CORP LTD;HUANENG LANCANG RIVER HYDROPOWER CO LTD;HUANENG LANCANG RIVER UPSTREAM HYDROPOWER CO LTD

title_en: Real-time modeling method and system for power transmission line disaster scene unmanned aerial vehicle
abstract_en: The invention discloses a real-time modeling method and a real-time modeling system for a disaster scene unmanned aerial vehicle of a power transmission line, relates to the technical field of power operation and maintenance, and aims at a global positioning system signal loss scene to solve the problems of pose drift and difficult alignment of subgraphs in the case of weak common vision in the traditional method. The global pose optimization model fuses the historical constraint of preprocessing training data, the single machine positioning result of local pose data and the visual characteristics of an operation key frame image set, an internal constraint system without external positioning signals is constructed, pose errors are corrected, strong dependence on an image common view area is broken, efficient fusion of multi-unmanned aerial vehicle pose stability and local data is realized, early data preprocessing, pose resolving and later three-dimensional reconstruction are combined, a real-time dense map generating period is shortened, support is provided for positioning faults after power transmission line disasters, damage assessment and emergency repair scheme formulation, and emergency response efficiency and reliability are improved.
assignees: FOSHAN POWER SUPPLY BUREAU GUANGDONG POWER GRID CORP

title_en: Intelligent identification method and equipment for dynamic damage of tunnel and underground structure
abstract_en: The invention provides an intelligent identification method and equipment for dynamic damage of a tunnel and an underground structure, wherein the method comprises the steps of collecting dynamic response signals of the underground structure under the dynamic actions of earthquake, blasting, traffic load and the like and preprocessing; the method comprises the steps of adopting a group intelligent optimization algorithm to automatically optimize self-adaptive signal decomposition parameters, utilizing optimal parameter decomposition signals to obtain a plurality of Inherent Mode Functions (IMFs), carrying out high-order time-frequency spectrum analysis on the effective IMFs, extracting characteristic indexes to construct a frequency modulation-carrier frequency coupling spectrogram, and identifying the occurrence time, the position and the grade of damage based on spectral characteristics and combining a discriminant rule or a machine learning model. The device consists of a signal acquisition and preprocessing module, a group intelligent optimization module, a signal decomposition module, a high-order time spectrum analysis module, a damage identification module, a damage assessment module and a result output module, and has the advantages of strong adaptability, high identification precision, flexible deployment and the like, and is suitable for on-line monitoring and rapid assessment of tunnels and underground structures under multiple working conditions.

title_en: Snow-melting flood disaster loss assessment method, system and medium based on multi-source remote sensing and deep learning
abstract_en: The embodiment of the invention discloses a snow-melting flood disaster loss assessment method, a system and a medium based on multi-source remote sensing and deep learning. A snow-melting flood disaster loss assessment method based on multi-source remote sensing and deep learning comprises the steps of obtaining time sequence data of a target area based on multi-source remote sensing, carrying out feature extraction on data of each moment in the time sequence data to obtain feature vectors representing space distribution of the time sequence data at the moment, constructing a graph structure according to a river network topological relation of the target area, inputting the graph structure and the feature vectors into a graph neural network, predicting a diameter value of each node in the graph structure by utilizing the graph neural network, and determining economic loss assessment results based on the predicted diameter value and ground asset distribution data of the target area, so that important areas of disaster risk and loss are intuitively revealed, and a more accurate and more time-efficient scientific basis is provided for disaster prevention and reduction decisions, emergency resource allocation and post-disaster recovery planning.
assignees: YUNNAN POWER GRID CO LTD ELECTRIC POWER RES INST

title_en: Method, device, computer equipment, storage medium and program product for evaluating disaster damage of transformer substation
abstract_en: The application relates to a method, a device, computer equipment, a storage medium and a program product for evaluating disaster damage of a transformer substation. The method comprises the steps of taking collected disaster parameters, calculating and obtaining target debris flow speed, target debris flow impact force and target stone impact force according to the disaster parameters, obtaining target impact force ratio factors according to the target debris flow impact force and the target stone impact force, inquiring and obtaining target failure probability of each device from three-dimensional vulnerability curved surfaces corresponding to each device in a pre-built transformer substation according to the target debris flow speed, the target impact force ratio factors and the target debris flow height in the disaster parameters, wherein the three-dimensional vulnerability curved surfaces are used for representing mapping relations among the failure probability of the device, the debris flow speed, the impact force ratio factors and the debris flow height, and determining disaster damage estimated values of the transformer substation based on the target failure probability of each device. The disaster damage estimation efficiency can be improved by adopting the method.
assignees: ELECTRIC POWER RES INST CO LTD CSG

title_en: Building damage estimation method, building damage estimation system, and program
abstract_en: To provide a method for estimating the degree of damage of a building, a system for estimating the degree of damage of the building, and a program, capable of improving accuracy.SOLUTION: First earthquake information at a plurality of first observation points and second earthquake information of fewer types than the first earthquake information at a plurality of second observation points including the first observation points and other points are acquired. At each of the first observation points, first result information is acquired as output information by a first output derivation function using the first earthquake information as input information and predetermined earthquake result information as output information, and second result information is acquired as output information by a second output derivation function using the second earthquake information as input information and the predetermined earthquake result information as output information. A correction function of the second result information is derived from the first result information and the second result information at the first observation position. At the second observation point, the second result information is corrected by the correction function to acquire second corrected result information.SELECTED DRAWING: Figure 1

title_en: Elastic plastic damage measuring and calculating device and method based on deformation record of steel frame column
abstract_en: The invention discloses an elastoplastic damage measuring and calculating device and method based on deformation records of steel frame columns, and relates to the technical field of structural anti-seismic monitoring and damage assessment, and a measuring assembly which is arranged on the outer wall of a frame assembly in a wrapping mode; the method comprises the steps of arranging connecting pieces in a steel frame, allowing a wallboard to freely slide relative to a beam in a horizontal plane, preventing the wallboard from being unstable in a direction perpendicular to a structural plane, arranging supporting pieces, enabling a reference wallboard to keep that the in-plane peak value side shift is not more than 5% of the column peak value side shift under the action of an earthquake, constructing a stable and reliable deformation-free reference standard, arranging distributed displacement recording pieces which do not need external energy along the column height on the basis of the deformation-free reference standard, accurately acquiring peak value side shift data at each height of the column after the earthquake, and further combining spline interpolation, numerical differentiation, elastoplastic beam column theory and node balance conditions to realize quantitative inversion and evaluation of column end and beam end internal force and damage states.

title_en: Underground station earthquake vulnerability analysis method based on probability damage weight
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of underground structure damage assessment, in particular to an underground station earthquake vulnerability analysis method based on probability damage weight, which comprises the steps of collecting a geological survey report and underground structure materials, generating random earthquake motion, determining corresponding probability of occurrence, establishing random earthquake motion with the same model input intensity, adjusting earthquake motion intensity, and carrying out incremental dynamics analysis; solving generalized probability density equation, calculating cumulative probability density function of each structural member earthquake performance index extremum, deducing each structural member vulnerability curve, calculating damage weight coefficient of each structural member, deducing whole station structure vulnerability curve, compared with classical vulnerability method, the method fully considers the randomness characteristic of earthquake, does not need presupposing earthquake intensity and structure damage degree to obey specific probability distribution, and can reflect contribution of different structural member damage to whole structure damage.

title_en: Agricultural insurance management system and method based on block chain
abstract_en: The invention discloses an agricultural insurance management system and method based on a blockchain, and relates to the technical field of insurance management, wherein the system comprises the steps of collecting crop image data and disaster data, calculating standardized agricultural loss factors, namely, no-loss down-regulating insurance fee and returning to monitoring; if slight or serious loss occurs, the premium is not regulated or up regulated, and the whole-course block chain storage certificate is used for realizing intelligent claim settlement and dynamic premium regulation. The method and the system accurately calculate the loss factors by fusing the crop images and the disaster data, improve the damage assessment accuracy, distinguish natural disasters from artificial management inadequacies, dynamically adjust the premium based on the loss results, realize the intellectualization of risk pricing, ensure the transparency and credibility of the flow by combining the blockchain storage certificate, and improve the insurance efficiency and the trust of agricultural workers.

title_en: Tunnel earthquake direct economic loss assessment analysis method
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of tunnel earthquake resistance evaluation, in particular to a method for evaluating and analyzing direct economic loss of tunnel earthquake, which comprises the following steps of 1, analyzing earthquake risk according to an existing earthquake risk curve of a tunnel site, 2, evaluating the earthquake vulnerability by using the vulnerability curve to reveal the damage degree of tunnels under different earthquake intensities, 3, evaluating the direct economic loss of the earthquake, including quantifying the overrun probability of different economic loss of the earthquake and evaluating the expected average earthquake loss, and reasonably considering the influence of key parameters such as site conditions, tunnel burial depth, tunnel construction quality or lining aging phenomenon on the evaluation of the tunnel earthquake.

title_en: Unmanned plane cooperation-based disaster damage assessment method and system
abstract_en: The application discloses a disaster damage assessment method and system based on unmanned plane cooperation, and relates to the technical field of road network disaster damage intelligent management, wherein the method comprises the steps of determining damage potential and importance factors of each road section by constructing a road network disaster influence priori model based on road basic data, geological environment information and disaster information, and realizing task priority division and dynamic planning of a multi-unmanned plane inspection path; the unmanned plane collects road visual data in cooperative flight, generates structural damage scores based on semantic feature extraction, calculates traffic adjustment damage indexes by combining road section importance factors, quantitatively characterizes the influence of structural damage on traffic operation, and obtains toughness indexes reflecting the overall traffic capacity reduction degree of a road network by summarizing the traffic adjustment damage indexes of all road sections. Therefore, the full-flow intelligent evaluation from disaster perception to road network toughness quantification is realized, and the accuracy and timeliness of road monitoring after disaster are obviously improved.
assignees: SHANDONG HIGHWAY & BRIDGE CONSTRUCTION GROUP CO LTD;RES INST HIGHWAY MINI TRANSP

title_en: Urban waterlogging disaster economic loss quantitative evaluation method based on IBWO-IRCNN-Informer
abstract_en: The invention relates to the field of waterlogging disaster damage assessment, and particularly discloses a quantitative assessment method for urban waterlogging disaster damage based on IBWO-IRCNN-Informer, which comprises the steps of constructing a model of urban waterlogging disaster simulation by utilizing a InfoWorks ICM model, carrying out coupling simulation on a one-dimensional hydrodynamic process of an urban pipe network and a two-dimensional water accumulation and overflow process of the ground surface, constructing a waterlogging flooding prediction model by combining IRCNN, informer and an improved white whale optimization algorithm, constructing a data set based on a simulation result of the model of waterlogging disaster prediction, training and evaluating the model of waterlogging flooding prediction, identifying and dividing each disaster-bearing body region by utilizing a geographic information system technology, carrying out superposition analysis on a flooding region obtained by the model of waterlogging flooding prediction, determining exposure disaster-bearing body information, combining a waterlogging disaster damage rate function and a maximum economic damage amount of each disaster-bearing body, partitioning the region and considering the occurrence probability of waterlogging, and calculating the possible economic damage amount of the partition based on the economic damage amount, and realizing a risk region based on possible economic damage amount.

title_en: System
abstract_en: A system includes a processor that is configured to detect occurrence of a disaster, activate a plurality of unmanned aerial vehicles and collect image and video data of a disaster-affected area, analyze the collected image and video data and generate a damage assessment as a three-dimensional map, visualize the generated three-dimensional map and distribute countermeasure instructions, receive information from residents of shelters and rescue workers, and extract important information by natural language analysis, and determine rescue activity instructions and support goods transport routes based on the extracted information.

title_en: system
abstract_en: A system is provided.SOLUTION: A system including means for a user to report a damaged portion due to a disaster using a terminal, means for receiving a damage report and acquiring a three-dimensional model of a target facility from a database, means for specifying a damaged portion on the three-dimensional model, means for estimating an influence range centered on the damaged portion, means for estimating a recovery cost and a recovery time using a generative AI, means for performing estimation in consideration of external environment prediction in cooperation with another system, and means for generating a recovery plan and presenting the recovery plan to a user.SELECTED DRAWING: Figure 1

title_en: Base station antenna damage evaluation method, device and medium
abstract_en: The application provides a base station antenna damage assessment method, a base station antenna damage assessment device and a base station antenna damage assessment medium, and relates to the technical field of communication. The method comprises the steps of obtaining pre-disaster performance index data and post-disaster performance index data of a cell according to a plurality of preset indexes, obtaining the significance difference of each index before and after disaster according to the pre-disaster performance index data of the cell and the post-disaster performance index data of the cell, obtaining the variation amplitude of each index before and after disaster according to the pre-disaster performance index data of the cell and the post-disaster performance index data of the cell, obtaining the disaster affected score of each index according to the significance difference and the variation amplitude, and obtaining the comprehensive evaluation score of the base station antenna damage caused by disaster according to the disaster affected score of each index. According to the method, the influence of the disaster on the antenna is estimated from the multiple indexes by calculating the significance difference and the change amplitude before and after the disaster, the damage of the antenna is estimated by integrating the influence of the disaster on the multiple indexes, and the accuracy of quantitative estimation of the damage of the base station antenna is improved.

title_en: Earthquake scenario simulation system, method and computer equipment
abstract_en: The application provides a seismic scene simulation system, a seismic scene simulation method and computer equipment, and relates to the technical field of seismic emergency. The system comprises a natural language interaction layer, a central scheduling module, a multi-source data fusion layer, a professional computing layer and a visualization and decision support layer, wherein the earthquake scene simulation system is used for receiving natural language instructions based on the natural language interaction layer under the condition of earthquake scene simulation, the central scheduling module is used for sequentially sending trigger instructions to other layers of the system based on structural instructions, the multi-source data fusion layer is used for inquiring earthquake data and obtaining a unified earthquake feature data set based on association and integration of knowledge maps, the professional computing layer is used for generating a structural decision scheme and determining earthquake intensity and earthquake loss assessment results, and the visualization and decision support layer is used for constructing urban three-dimensional scenes and generating multi-class earthquake thematic diagrams. The system can improve the scientificity and timeliness of the earthquake disaster coping decision.
assignees: CHENGDU CITY SAFETY AND EMERGENCY MANAGEMENT RESEARCH INST

title_en: RC structure earthquake damage assessment method based on damage segmentation map
abstract_en: The invention provides an RC structure earthquake damage assessment method driven by a damage segmentation map. The method comprises the steps of 1, constructing a brand-new multi-mode picture data set of a vibration damage RC component, 2, constructing a light SAM damage segmentation module integrating knowledge distillation driving structured pruning, dynamic parameter sharing and low-rank tensor decomposition, 3, constructing a light LLaVA damage understanding module integrating a space attention mechanism driven by a damage segmentation map, full-parameter fine tuning and knowledge distillation, 4, constructing a lightweight weight generation sub-network, receiving category statistical characteristics of the damage segmentation map as input, outputting the multi-scale space attention weight coefficient provided in the step 3, and 5, organically integrating algorithm modules to form a brand-new technical solution, and realizing the sensing-recognition-segmentation-evaluation-description full-flow output of the structural damage.

title_en: Post-earthquake damage state identification method and device System, storage medium
abstract_en: The invention discloses a post-earthquake damage state identification method, a post-earthquake damage state identification device, a post-earthquake damage state identification system and a storage medium, wherein the post-earthquake damage state identification method comprises the following steps of 1, obtaining nonlinear effective energy dissipation factors of piers; and 2, replacing the maximum displacement by adopting residual displacement as a deformation damage item, and leading in a nonlinear effective energy dissipation factor to redefine an energy damage item to obtain a post-earthquake damage assessment model, 3, fitting key parameters of the post-earthquake damage assessment model, and 4, verifying the post-earthquake damage assessment model after parameter fitting by adopting pseudo static test data. By adopting the technical scheme of the invention, the rapid, quantitative and accurate identification of the damage state of the bridge pier can be realized.

title_en: Data evaluation method, device, computer equipment and medium based on artificial intelligence
abstract_en: The application belongs to the technical field of artificial intelligence, and relates to a data evaluation method, a device, computer equipment and a storage medium based on artificial intelligence, wherein the method comprises the steps of carrying out mask generation on a flood damage clothing image to obtain a damage area mask; the method comprises the steps of processing a damaged area mask based on an original state restoration model to obtain an original state image, carrying out damage process backtracking on the original state image and a flood damaged clothes image based on a damage process backtracking model to obtain damage process information, carrying out damage evaluation on the flood damaged clothes image and the original state image based on a multi-scale evaluation strategy to obtain a damage evaluation result, generating a damage evaluation report based on the flood damaged clothes image, the original state image, the damage process information and the damage evaluation result, and outputting the damage evaluation report. Further, damage-assessment reports may be stored in the blockchain. The method can be applied to the clothing flood damage assessment scene in the field of financial science and technology, and improves the processing efficiency and accuracy of data evaluation.
assignees: CHINA PING AN PROPERTY INSURANCE CO LTD

title_en: Agricultural insurance damage assessment method, apparatus, computer device and readable storage medium
abstract_en: The application provides an agricultural insurance damage assessment method, an agricultural insurance damage assessment device, computer equipment and a readable storage medium, and relates to the fields of data processing and financial science and technology. The method comprises the steps of obtaining agricultural data of different sources of an applied farmland, extracting characteristic information of the agricultural data of different sources, determining characteristic fusion weights of the agricultural data based on target data, carrying out characteristic fusion on a plurality of characteristic information according to the characteristic fusion weights corresponding to the agricultural data to obtain a first comprehensive characteristic vector, inputting the first comprehensive characteristic vector into a trained damage assessment prediction model, and outputting damage assessment data of the applied farmland, wherein the damage assessment data comprises damage assessment amount and disaster factors.
assignees: CHINA PING AN PROPERTY INSURANCE CO LTD

title_en: Finite element method-based structural multiscale dynamic damage assessment method
abstract_en: The invention discloses a finite element method-based multi-scale dynamic damage assessment method for a structure, which comprises the steps of combining the finite element method, calculating multi-scale potential energy and kinetic energy states of materials, sections, members, floors, structures and the like of the structure under the action of power, considering the influence of high-order vibration modes of all scales on dynamic damage of the structure, and assessing the damage evolution rule of all scales and the influence of the damage evolution rule of all scales on each other. The method can quantitatively evaluate the multi-scale damage evolution rules of materials, sections, members, floors, structures and the like of various structure types (such as reinforced concrete structures, steel-concrete combined structures, wood structures and the like) under the action of power (such as earthquake action, wind load and the like), reveal the inherent damage mechanism of the structure, comprehensively evaluate the damage performance of the structure, and provide scientific basis for optimizing the design of the structural performance and evaluating the safety of the structure.

title_en: System and method of geometrical information analysis for explainable damage assessment
abstract_en: A method and system for geometrical and topological information analysis for an explainable damage assessment are developed. The system stores pre-disaster and post-disaster point cloud data in computer memory which is connected to a server via a network. The portions of the pre-disaster and post-disaster point cloud data corresponding to the regions of interest are segmented out using geometrical analysis. Features based on topological data analysis techniques for these portions are extracted and stacked as the index reflecting the innate geometrical and topological properties for potential damage assessment. A collection of classifiers are trained to group the damage levels for each region of interest. The damage assessment results identified by the classifiers and a set of explainable items justifying the classification results are reported to a human-readable device.

title_en: Power grid composite chain disaster multi-source monitoring damage assessment method and system
abstract_en: The invention provides a multi-source monitoring damage evaluation method and a system for a composite chain disaster of a power grid, and relates to the technical field of data processing, wherein the method comprises the steps of dividing a reference geographic coverage area to generate a plurality of independent analysis units, attributing each three-dimensional discrete point to a corresponding independent analysis unit, and calculating to obtain a unit space calibration coefficient; the method comprises the steps of carrying out regional correction on a fused disaster monitoring image data set by using a unit space calibration coefficient to obtain calibrated disaster monitoring image data, extracting disaster damage characteristics through a deep learning semantic segmentation network based on the calibrated disaster monitoring image data, carrying out space diffusion path simulation and time evolution process analysis of disaster influence based on the disaster damage characteristics to obtain disaster space-time evolution characteristics, carrying out comprehensive quantitative evaluation on damage degree and risk level of power grid facilities, and generating a comprehensive damage evaluation result. The method and the system improve the accuracy of monitoring and evaluating the disaster damage of the power grid and enhance the risk early warning and coping capacity of the power grid facilities.
assignees: POWER EMERGENCY CENTER OF STATE GRID SICHUAN ELECTRIC POWER CORP

title_en: Flood influence population assessment method based on three-dimensional building features and spatial indexes
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the technical field of natural disaster assessment. A flood influence population assessment method based on three-dimensional building features and spatial indexes comprises the steps of building a three-dimensional building response model, calculating the effective base area of a building through height/floor conversion, calculating population density based on the effective base area and population data, building multi-level water depth submerged area statistics, achieving rapid spatial analysis of submerged elements and the building through an R-tree spatial index technology, calculating the submerged area through layer intersection, and generating a submerged population statistics table by taking administrative region as a unit. The method is used for solving the technical problems that the existing disaster damage assessment method cannot reflect the limitation of the three-dimensional characteristics of the building and the existing flood disaster damage assessment method is low in calculation efficiency and precision.
assignees: JIANGSU WATER CONSERVANCY SCIENTIFIC RESEARCH INST;JIANGSU PROVINCE WATER ENG SCI TECH CONSULTING CORP LTD

title_en: Visible light remote sensing building damage assessment method based on mixed visual state space and ordinal regression
abstract_en: The invention discloses a visible light remote sensing building damage evaluation method based on mixed visual state space and ordinal regression, which relates to the technical field of remote sensing image processing and disaster evaluation, and comprises the steps of obtaining pre-disaster and post-disaster high-resolution visible light remote sensing images of an area to be evaluated; the method comprises the steps of inputting pre-disaster images and post-disaster images into a mixed feature coding network, extracting local visual features of a building through a convolutional neural network module, establishing global space dependence relation based on the local visual features by a visual state space module to generate hidden state features containing physical damage semantics, inputting the hidden state features into an ordinal state decoding network, generating a continuous damage intensity graph through single-channel continuous real space projection, and outputting a building damage assessment result based on the continuous damage intensity graph. The invention obviously improves the identification precision of severely damaged and collapsed buildings, and ensures the space smoothness and the calculation efficiency of the evaluation result.

title_en: Building functional damage assessment method based on lifting rail InSAR
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the technical field of remote sensing monitoring and disaster assessment, and particularly relates to a building functional damage assessment method based on lifting rail InSAR, which comprises the following steps of 1, lifting rail InSAR data acquisition and damage information collection before and after damage; the method comprises the steps of step 2, reconstructing and fusing digital surface models DSM before and after damage, step 3, detecting and quantifying building change based on differential DSM, step 4, quantitatively extracting building damage characteristic parameters, step 5, evaluating and grading building functionality based on multidimensional characteristics, and step 6, generating a building functional damage evaluation report. The method realizes the evaluation and upgrading from two-dimensional change to three-dimensional refined structure change, maps the extracted three-dimensional geometric change characteristics to the direct influence on the core function of the building, effectively solves the mapping problem from deformation to function, and improves the automation degree and objectivity of evaluation.
assignees: BEIJING RESEARCH INST OF URANIUM GEOLOGY

title_en: Space-borne SAR building damage assessment method based on double-domain feature fusion
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the technical field of remote sensing image processing and damage evaluation, and in particular relates to a satellite-borne SAR building damage evaluation method based on double-domain feature fusion, which comprises the steps of acquiring co-orbit satellite-borne SAR image pairs of the same area before and after a disaster, and collecting details of damage events; the method comprises the steps of processing single-view complex images to generate preprocessed pre-disaster SAR image data and post-disaster SAR image data, adopting a double-branch architecture to extract spatial domain features and frequency domain features to construct a double-domain feature fusion network model, utilizing the double-domain feature fusion network model to extract and optimize a damage area, calculating the total damage area, each partition area and the occupation ratio based on a damage distribution map, classifying damage grades based on the back scattering coefficient variation of the pre-disaster and post-disaster, and generating a damage evaluation report. The invention can realize accurate extraction, grading and quantitative analysis of the damaged area, improves the accuracy and reliability of damage identification, and meets the high timeliness requirement of disaster emergency response.
assignees: BEIJING RESEARCH INST OF URANIUM GEOLOGY

title_en: Vibration damage RC component damage assessment method based on eye movement attention
abstract_en: The invention provides an eye movement attention-based earthquake damage RC component damage assessment method, which comprises the steps of constructing damage building image data sets containing different damage types and scenes, performing standard treatment, performing damage assessment under an eye movement tracking device through a professional engineer, synchronously collecting eye movement data, performing cleaning, track correction and thermodynamic diagram generation on the eye movement data, constructing an attention map, designing a deep learning model integrating eye movement attention, splicing and inputting an original image and the attention map, extracting features through an encoder-decoder structure, constructing a feature pyramid, performing model training and optimization by adopting a cross entropy loss function and an Adam optimizer, and outputting damage levels. By introducing an expert eye movement attention mechanism, the reliability and the interpretability of the deep learning model in post-earthquake evaluation are obviously improved, and an effective technical means is provided for quick and accurate earthquake damage evaluation.

title_en: An air quality prediction system that combines forecasts using climate variables and electricity demand forecasts
title_ko: 기후 변수를 사용한 예측과 전력 수요 예측을 결합한 대기질 예측 시스템
abstract_ko: 본 고안은 지역 맞춤형 대기질 예측 및 관리 시스템에 관한 것으로, 계절별 기후 변수와 전력 수요 예측 정보를 결합하여 장·단기 대기질 상태를 정확히 예측한다. 이 시스템은 기후적 요소와 배출량 변화를 동시에 고려함으로써 특정 지역에서 대기 오염 농도가 기준치를 초과할 가능성을 조기에 감지하고, 다양한 예측 기간에 따른 대기질 정보를 제공한다. 이를 통해 환경 재난 예방, 건강 보호, 및 대기질 관리 효율성을 높이는 데 기여할 수 있다.

title_en: Method, system, equipment and medium for monitoring and early warning of earthquake safety of dam and evaluating earthquake damage
abstract_en: The invention discloses a dam earthquake safety monitoring and early warning and earthquake damage assessment method, a system, equipment and a medium, which belong to the technical field of dam safety monitoring and comprise the steps of adopting a time domain time-varying mode identification method to process vibration observation data in real time, extracting time-varying mode parameters of a dam and storing the time-varying mode parameters into a time-varying mode library, assessing the safety state of a dam structure according to the time-varying mode parameters, extracting earthquake source information according to earthquake early warning information, predicting earthquake vibration characteristic parameters, judging whether the earthquake source information is in a strong earthquake simulation library, directly calling a corresponding dam earthquake response simulation result when the earthquake source information is in the library, determining optimal input earthquake vibration through similarity matching when the earthquake source information is not in the library, calling the corresponding simulation result to serve as early warning information, extracting earthquake vibration time course characteristics according to dam foundation actual measurement earthquake vibration data, and carrying out earthquake damage rapid assessment by combining the time-varying mode parameters and an earthquake vulnerability function. The method realizes real-time monitoring of the structural state of the dam, rapid early warning of earthquake disasters and rapid evaluation after earthquake.
assignees: FUJIAN HUADIAN FURUI ENERGY DEV CO LTD ANSHA HYDROELECTRIC POWER PLANT

title_en: Millimeter wave linear array three-dimensional imaging radar system
abstract_en: The invention provides a millimeter wave linear array three-dimensional imaging radar system which comprises a W-band receiving and transmitting antenna array, a W-band receiving and transmitting channel, a radar signal processor and a clock/local oscillator frequency source, wherein the W-band receiving and transmitting antenna array is arranged by using a MIMO architecture and is connected to one side of a carrier platform facing a target. The invention adopts the MIMO architecture for array, and performs special treatments such as period extraction and the like on a sparse array method aiming at W frequency bands. In addition, the sparse array increases the array size under the condition of the same antenna unit number, improves the system resolution and reduces the cost of the radar system, the system combining the downward-looking line-of-sight array technology and the downward-looking synthetic aperture radar technology greatly improves the resolution in the elevation direction, enhances the reliability, can continuously operate in a long-distance, large-range and high-efficiency manner, and provides effective means for mountain deformation and landslide monitoring, earthquake disaster damage assessment, agriculture and forestry disease and insect pest monitoring and the like under severe weather conditions.
assignees: AEROSPACE LONG MARCH LAUNCH VEHICLE TECHNOLOGY CO LTD
